Omuliro gufuula buli kintu, nga bwe gusobola, omuliro; bwe kityo ekisa kifuba okuzaala akabonero ke kamu mu balala, n’okufuula abangi nga bwe kisobola abalungi: era ekisa kikozesa mu ngeri ey’ekisa n’ebintu eby’obutonde n’eby’ensi, ne kibifuula eby’omwoyo: omuntu omulala ky’akola nga kya mpisa bupisa, omuntu ow’ekisa akikola mu butukuvu. Oba alya oba anywa, oba kyonna ky’akola, byonna abikola olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda, ng’afuula buli kintu ekiyamba okutuuka ku kigendererwa ekisembayo.

Ensasi mu butonde bwazo zibuuka waggulu; bwe kityo omwoyo ow’ekisa atwala emmeeme eri eggulu, n’ateeka mu maaso gaffe ebigendererwa ebitukuvu era eby’omu ggulu: nga bwe kyakoleezebwa kuva mu ggulu, bwe kityo kitukomyawo mu ggulu. Ekitundu kigoberera ekyo kyonna: omuliro gulinnya waggulu, bwe kityo na buli nsasi eri ekika kyayo. Okulowooza n’okwegomba kw’emmeeme we biba eri Katonda, eyo waliwo ekisa, newaakubadde nga kiwakanyizibwa. Ekigero ekisinga obutono eky’ekisa kwe kwegomba okutukuvu okusibuka mu kukkiriza n’okwagala, kubanga tetuyinza kwegomba kintu kye tutasoose kukkiriza nti weekiri, era okwegomba kwakyo kusibuka mu kwagala. Noolwekyo okwegomba kubalibwa ng’ekitundu ky’ekintu ekyegombebwa mu kigero ekimu, naye nga kuteekwa okuba, ekisooka, okunywevu ; kubanga obunywevu bulaga nti kwa butonde obusukka obutonde, so si kwa kukakibwa : eky’okubiri, kuteekwa okulaga ku bintu eby’omwoyo, ng’okukkiriza, okwagala Katonda, n’ebirala. so si olw’obwetaavu obw’enjawulo, kubanga balowooza nti singa kaakano babadde n’ekisa, bandiwonye akabi akamu, wabula ng’omutima ogwagala bwe gusikirizibwa eri ekintu kye gwagala olw’obulungi obumu obukirimu: era eky’okusatu, wamu n’okwegomba wabaawo ennaku nga kuziyizibwa, ekisikiriza okusaba: Ayi Mukama, nsaba mbeerenga munywevu bulijjo; nga nkuuma bye walagira. (Zabbuli 119:5). Nga ndi muntu munaku! Ani alindokola? n’ebirala. (Abaruumi 7:24): eky’okuna, okwegomba kututwala mu maaso bulijjo, Singa nsobola okuweereza Katonda n’eddembe erisingawo; Singa nali nnemerezebwa okuva mu kwegomba kuno okunyiiza, okutawooma, era okw’akabi.

Omuliro, bwe guba n’eky’okulya, gwegaziya ne gutuuka ewagazi, era gulinnya waggulu ne waggulu, era gye gukoma okulinnya waggulu, ennimi zaagwo gye zikoma okuba ennongoofu. Bwe kityo ekisa ekituufu we kiri, kikula mu kigero ne mu bulongoofu. Olutambi olunyooka lulikula ne lufuuka ennimi z’omuliro; era (nga bwe lweyongera, bwe lutyo lugoba ekirukontana nalwo, ne lwerongoosa ne lweyongera. Noolwekyo kiraga omutima ogw’obulimba okwessaako ekigero mu kisa, n’okuwummulira mu ntandikwa; nga twewolereza nti Kristo talizikiza lutambi olunyooka. Naye embeera eno ey’okusaasira mu Kristo yeegasse n’obutukuvu obutuukiridde, obulagibwa mu bukyayi obutuukiridde eri ekibi; kubanga mu kifo ky’okuleka ekibi nga tekifunye kibonerezo ekikigwanira, ye yennyini yafuuka ssaddaaka olw’ekibi, mwe mwasinga okwakira obutukuvu bwa Kitaawe n’obubwe. Era ng’oggyeko ekyo, mu mulimu gw’okutukuzibwa, newaakubadde ng’asaasira omulimu gwe mu ffe, naye tasaasira kibi mu ffe; kubanga talijja mukono gwe ku mulimu gwe, okutuusa lw’aliba aggyeewo ekibi, ddala n’okubaawo kwakyo kwennyini, mu butonde bwaffe: Omwoyo oyo yennyini eyatukuza omubiri ogwo omutukuvu mwe yakolebwa, atutukuza mpola mpola tulyoke tusaanire omutwe omutukuvu bwe gutyo, era akola okusalawo n’okwagala kw’abo bonna b’alaga okusaasira, kukkiriziganye n’okukwe, mu kufuba okutuukiriza ebigendererwa bye, mu kuggyawo ekibi mu butonde bwaffe.

fields.title: Okubuusabuusa okuziyiza okubudaabudibwa kuggibwawo
fields.body_html:
OKUVA mu kufumiitiriza ku mateeka gano n’obubonero buno, okubudaabudibwa kungi kuyinza okuleetebwa mu mmeeme z’abo abasinga obunafu ; era olw’okwagala kubeere kungi nnyo, ka nneeyongereko ekintu ekimu okubayamba okuvvuunuka empaka entono eza bulijjo, n’ebirowoozo eby’ekyama bye balowooza ku bo bennyini, ebyo, bwe biyingira mu mutima, emirundi mingi bibakkakkanya wansi.

Abamu balowooza nti tebalina kukkiriza n’akatono, kubanga tebalina bukakafu bujjuvu ; so ng’omuliro ogusinga okuba omulungi gubaako omukka ogumu. Ebikolwa ebisinga obulungi biwunya omukka. Ensekuro omusekulwa katungulu ccumu ebeera ewunya bulijjo: bwe kityo n’ebikolwa byaffe byonna biwunyamu katono omuntu ow’edda.

Mu bunafu bw’omubiri abamu balowooza nti ekisa kifa, kubanga bye bakola binafu, emyoyo gyabwe, egiri ebikozesebwa mu bikolwa by’emmeeme zaabwe, nga gikoze; nga tebalowooza nti Katonda afaayo ku kusinda okwo okukwese okw’abo abatalina maanyi kukwolesa kungulu ; oyo agamba nti Alina omukisa asaasira omunaku, naye yennyini alifaayo mu kusaasira ku bantu ng’abo.

Abamu nate batawaanyizibwa ebifaananyi eby’entiisa ebireetebwa mu birowoozo byabwe, n’ebirowoozo ebibi era ebitasaanye ku Katonda, ku Kristo, ku kigambo, n’ebirala. ebyo, ng’ensowera ezeetawaanya, bitabula era biteganya emirembe gyabwe; bino Setaani abikasuka ng’omuliro ogw’omu nsiko, nga bwe kiyinza okutegeerwa mu, 1. obuggya bwabyo obw’ekyewuunyo, 2. amaanyi n’obukambwe bwabyo, 3. obubi bwabyo obw’entiisa ne mu butonde obwonoonese bwennyini. Emmeeme etya Katonda terina musango gwabyo, okusinga Benyamini bwe yalina omusango gw’ekikopo kya Yusufu ekyateekebwa mu nsawo ye. Mu buyambi obulala abawandiisi abatya Katonda bwe baalagira, ng’okubyetamwa, n’okukyusa ebirowoozo okuva ku byo okudda ku bintu ebirala, n’ebirala. kino kibeere kimu ku byo, okwemulugunya eri Kristo ku byo, n’okuddukira wansi w’ebiwaawaatiro by’obukuumi bwe, n’okumwegayirira atuyimirire mu lutalo n’omulabe we era owaffe. Buli kibi na buli kuvvoola kw’omuntu kulisonyiyibwa, naye ebirowoozo bino eby’obuvvoozi, ebirina Setaani nga kitaabwe, bireme kusonyiyibwa? So nga Kristo yennyini yatawaanyizibwa mu ngeri eyo olw’ensonga eyo, alyoke abeere omuyambi wa buli mmeeme ennaku eri mu mbeera ng’eyo.

Naye waliwo enjawulo wakati wa Kristo naffe mu mbeera eno, kubanga Setaani yali talina kintu kyonna kikye mu Kristo, okusendasenda kwe tekwaleka kabonero n’akatono mu butonde bwe obutukuvu; wabula, ng’ensasi ezigwa mu nnyanja, amangu ddala ne kuzikizibwa. Ebikemo bya Setaani eri Kristo byali kusendasenda bwokka ku ludda lwa Setaani, n’okutegeera obubi bwabyo ku ludda lwa Kristo; okutegeera ekibi ekireeteddwa omulala, si kibi; kyali kizibu kya Kristo, naye ekibi kya Setaani; naye bw’atyo yakkiriza okukemebwa, alyoke atusaasire mu ntalo zaffe, era atutendeke okukozesa ebyokulwanyisa byaffe eby’Omwoyo nga ye bwe yakola. Kristo yandimuwangudde n’obuyinza, naye yakikola mu kuwoza; naye Setaani bw’ajja gye tuli, asanga mu ffe ekintu ekikye, ekikwatagana naye era ekimuwa amawulire; mu butonde bwaffe mulimu obulabe bwe bumu eri Katonda n’obulungi mu kigero ekimu, obuli mu Setaani yennyini; kye kiva ebikemo bye emirundi mingi bituleka n’enziro. Era ne bwe wandibadde nga tewali Setaani asendasenda, naye ebirowoozo ebibi byandisituse okuva munda mu ffe ; newaakubadde nga tewali kikasukibwa kuva bweru, tulina eggwanika lyabyo munda: ebirowoozo bino, emmeeme bw’ebirwamu ekiseera ekiwanvu ekimala okunuuna oba okuggya mu byo n’okuyita mu byo essanyu lyonna ery’ekibi, olwo bireka omusango omuzito ku mmeeme, ne biziyiza okussa kimu kwaffe okw’essanyu ne Katonda, ne bitaataaganya emirembe gyaffe, ne biteeka obuwoomi obukontana mu mmeeme, ne bigiteekateeka eri ebibi ebisingako obunene. Ebibi byonna eby’ekivve ebyeyoleka kungulu bibeera birowoozo bulowooza ku ntandikwa. Ebirowoozo ebibi biri ng’ababbi abato, abayingirira mu ddirisa, ne baggulirawo ababbi abanene oluggi; ebirowoozo ensigo z’ebikolwa. Bino, naddala nga biyambibwako Setaani, bifuula obulamu bw’Abakristaayo bangi abalungi kumpi okubonaabona kw’abajulizi. Mu mbeera eno kubudaabuda okutali kwa nnamaddala abamu kwe bawa, nti ebirowoozo ebibi bisibuka mu butonde, era ekya butonde kisonyiyibwa; naye tuteekwa okumanya nti obutonde, nga bwe bwava mu mikono gya Katonda ku ntandikwa, tebwalina kusituka ng’okwo; emmeeme, nga Katonda bwe yagifuuwamu, teyalina mukka gutawooma ng’ogwo ; naye okuva lwe yeelyamu olukwe olw’ekibi, kifuuse kya butonde gy’ali mu ngeri emu okuweesa ebiteeso eby’ekibi, n’okuba ekikoomi ky’ensasi ng’ezo; era kino kyongera obubi bw’obwonoonefu obw’obutonde, nti bulina emirandira emiwanvu bwe gityo, era nti busaasaanidde bwe butyo mu butonde bwaffe bwonna.

Kiyamba okwetoowaza okumanya obugazi n’obuwanvu bwonna obw’ekibi; kyokka kino, nti obutonde bwaffe kaakano, nga bwe bukyali obutazzibwa buggya, bubala bubi nnyo ebirowoozo ebibi, kituwa okubudaabudibwa kuno, nti si ffe ffekka abali mu mbeera eno, ng’embeera yaffe mu kino eyawukanye n’ey’abalala, ng’abamu bwe baakemebwa okulowooza, ne kumpi okuggwaamu essuubi; tewali, bwe bagamba, alina butonde bwa kivve nga nze; kino kisibuka mu butamanya bwa ngeri ekibi ekyasikirwa gye kisaasaanamu, kubanga kiki ekiyinza okuva mu kintu ekitali kirongoofu, okuggyako ekitali kirongoofu? Ng’amazzi bwe galaga omuntu bw’afaanana, (Engero 27:19), awo ekisa we kitannaleetawo njawulo. Nga mu kutawaanyizibwa Setaani, bwe kiri ne wano, ekkubo erisinga obulungi kwe kwanjula okwemulugunya kwaffe eri Kristo, n’okukaaba wamu ne Pawulo Omutukuvu, Nga ndi muntu munaku! Ani alindokola mu mubiri guno ogugenda okufa? (Abaruumi 7:24, 25): bwe yamala okwanjula emmeeme ye ennumwa bw’etyo, amangu ddala n’afuna okubudaabudibwa; kubanga atandika okwebaza, Katonda yeebazibwe, n’ebirala. Era kirungi okukozesa omukisa guno okweyongera okukyawa omubiri guno ogw’okufa ogw’akabi, n’okusemberera Katonda, nga omusajja oyo omutukuvu bwe yakola oluvannyuma lw’ebirowoozo bye eby’obusirusiru n’eby’ensolo, (Zabbuli 73:22 ne 28), n’okukuumira emitima gyaffe okumpi ne Katonda, nga tugiwoomesa n’okufumiitiriza ku by’omu ggulu ku makya, nga tutereka ebintu ebirungi omutima gwaffe gulyoke gube eggwanika eddungi, era nga twegayirira Kristo atuwe Omwoyo we Omutukuvu aggale ensulo eyo ekolimiddwa, era abeere ensulo ennamu ey’ebirowoozo ebisinga obulungi mu ffe. Tewali kintu ekisinga okukkakkanya emyoyo gy’abantu abatukuvu abaagala okusanyukira mu Katonda oluvannyuma lw’okuwona obucaafu obwa bulijjo obw’ensi, okusinga ebikulukuta bino ebitali birongoofu eby’omwoyo, kubanga bisinga okukontana ne Katonda, oyo Omwoyo omulongoofu : naye okubeetamwa kwennyini kuleeta ensonga ez’okubudaabudibwa ku byo - biwaliriza emmeeme okwenyigira mu bikolwa byonna eby’omwoyo, okutunula, n’okutambula ne Katonda okumpi okusingawo, n’okwesitula okulowooza ebirowoozo eby’engeri eya waggulu, amazima ga Katonda, ebikolwa bya Katonda, okussa kimu kw’abatukuvu, ekyama ky’okutya Katonda, okulowooza ku ntiisa ya Mukama, ku bulungi obw’ekitalo obw’embeera y’Omukristaayo, n’empisa ezigituukirako, bye biwa mu bungi. Bitulaga nti twetaaga buli lunaku ekisa ekirongoosa era ekisonyiwa, n’okunoonya okusangibwa mu Kristo, era bwe bityo emirundi mingi bifukamiza abasinga obulungi.

Naye okubudaabudibwa kwaffe okusinga obukulu kuli nti Omulokozi waffe omutendereze, nga bwe yagamba Setaani nti Vvaawo, genda Setaani okumuvaako, oluvannyuma lw’okumuleka ekiseera ky’obuzibu bwe, (Matayo 4:10); bw’atyo bw’alimulagira okutuvaako, bwe kiriba kirungi gye tuli; ateekwa okugenda ku kigambo kimu. Era asobola era alinenya mu kiseera kye ekituufu okusikasikana okw’obujeemu n’okw’obutafugibwa okw’emitima gyaffe, n’okuleeta ebirowoozo byonna eby’omuntu ow’omunda bimugondere.

Abamu balowooza nti bwe batandika okutawaanyizibwa omukka gw’obwonoonefu okusinga bwe baali edda, noolwekyo babi okusinga bwe baali. Kya mazima, nti obwonoonefu kaakano bulabika okusinga edda, naye bukendedde.

Kubanga, ekisooka, ekibi gye kikoma okulabika gye kikoma okukyayibwa, era bwe kityo kikendeera. Enfuufu entono eba mu kisenge omusana nga tegunnaayaka, naye olwo lwokka lw’erabika.

Eky’okubiri, ebikontana gye bikoma okuba okumpi ennyo ekimu n’ekinnaakyo, olutalo wakati wabyo gye lukoma okuba olukambwe: kaakano mu balabe bonna omwoyo n’omubiri bye bisinga okuba okumpi ekimu n’ekinnaakyo, kubanga byombi biri mu mmeeme y’omuntu azaalibwa omulundi ogw’okubiri, ne mu busobozi bw’emmeeme, ne mu buli kikolwa ekisibuka mu busobozi obwo, noolwekyo si kya kwewuunya nti emmeeme, ekifo olutalo luno we lubeera, bw’eyawukanamu bw’etyo, ebeera ng’olutambi olunyooka.

Eky’okusatu, ekisa gye kikoma okuba ekingi, obulamu obw’omwoyo gye bukoma okuba obungi, era obulamu obw’omwoyo gye bukoma okuba obungi, okukyawa ekikontana nabwo gye kukoma okuba okungi ; noolwekyo tewali n’omu awulira obwonoonefu nga abo abalina emmeeme ezisinga okuba ennamu.

Era eky’okuna, abantu bwe beewaayo eri eddembe ly’omubiri, obwonoonefu bwabwe tebubatawaanya, kubanga tebusibiddwa era tebuziyiziddwa; naye ekisa bwe kimala okunyigiriza obusukkirivu bwabwe obw’obutafugibwa n’obw’obugwagwa, olwo omubiri ne guseeba, nga gunyiigira okusibibwa ; naye kaakano basingako obulungi okusinga bwe baali edda. Ekintu ekireeta omukka kyali mu muwuuta nga tegunnakoleezebwa; naye tekinyiiza okutuusa omuwuuta lwe gutandika okwaka. Abo bamanye nti omukka bwe gubanyiiza, kabonero nti waliwo ekitangaala. Kirungi okufuna emiganyulo gy’ekitangaala, newaakubadde n’omukka, okusinga okubeera mu kizikiza kyokka.

Era omukka tegunyiiza nga ekitangaala bwe kitubudaabuda, kubanga kiwa obujulizi nti ekisa kya mazima mu mutima; noolwekyo, newaakubadde nga kizibu mu lutalo, naye kibudaabuda mu bujulizi. Kirungi obwonoonefu butunyiize kaakano, okusinga okubuwa ekkubo okugula emirembe mitono ne tufiirwa okubudaabudibwa oluvannyuma. Noolwekyo abo abali mu kukaayana n’okulwana n’obwonoonefu bwabwe, batunuulire ekyawandiikibwa kino ng’omugabo gwabwe ogw’okubudaabudibwa.

fields.title: Okwenyigira mu Buvunaanyizibwa wadde nga waliwo Obunafu
fields.body_html:
WANO waliwo enkozesa ey’okuzzaamu amaanyi mu buvunaanyizibwa, nti ; Kristo talizikiza lutambi olunyooka, wabula alufuuwa ne lwaka. Abamu batya okukola emirimu emirungi egy’obuvunaanyizibwa, kubanga bawulira emitima gyabwe nga gijeema, n’emirimu egyo ne gigenda bubi. Tetwandyewaze bikolwa birungi olw’obunafu obubyegattako: Kristo atunuulira nnyo ekirungi ekibirimu ky’ayagala, okukuza, okusinga ekibi ekibirimu ky’ayagala okuggyawo. Omuntu omulwadde, newaakubadde nga mu kulya ayongerako katono ku bulwadde, naye alya, obutonde bwe bulyoke bufune amaanyi okulwanyisa obulwadde : bwe kityo newaakubadde ng’ekibi kyegatta ku bye tukola, naye ka tubikole, kubanga tukolagana ne Mukama omulungi bw’atyo, era gye tukoma okusanga okulwana okungi, gye tukoma okukkirizibwa : Kristo ayagala okuwooma ku bibala ebirungi ebiva gye tuli, newaakubadde nga bulijjo biriwoomamu ku kikolo eky’edda.

Omukristaayo yeemulugunya nti tasobola kusaba ; Ai, ntawaanyizibwa ebirowoozo bingi ebintaataaganya, era tebinnaba kuba bingi nga kaakano. Naye Katonda akuteeka mu mutima okwegomba okusaba? ajja kuwulira okwegomba kw’Omwoyo we yennyini mu ggwe. Tetumanyi kusaba nga bwe kitugwanira (era tetukola kintu kyonna nga bwe kitugwanira), naye Omwoyo atubeera mu bunafu bwaffe, n’okusinda okutayogerekeka, (Abaruumi 8:26), okutali kukwekebwa Katonda. Mukama, n’okusinda kwange okuwulira (Zabbuli 38:9). Katonda asobola okulondamu amakulu mu kusaba okutabuddwatabuddwa. Okwegomba kuno kukaaba mu matu ge n’eddoboozi ery’omwanguka okusinga ebibi byo. Oluusi Omukristaayo aba n’ebirowoozo ebitabuddwatabuddwa ennyo, n’atasobola kwogera kintu kyonna, wabula ng’omwana bw’akaaba, Ai Kitange, nga tasobola kulaga ky’ayagala, nga Musa bwe yali ku Nnyanja Emmyufu.

Okusikasikana kuno okw’omwoyo kukwata ku nda ya Katonda, ne kumusaasiza gye tuli, bwe kuva mu mwoyo ogw’okufuulibwa abaana, ne mu kufuba okubeera abalungi okusingawo.

Ai, naye kiyinzika, omutima ogubuusabuusa bwe gulowooza, Katonda omutukuvu bw’atyo okukkiriza okusaba ng’okwo ?

Weewaawo, alikkiriza ekyo ekikye, era alisonyiwa ekyo ekyaffe. Yona yasaba ng’ali mu lubuto lw’ekyennyanja, (Yona 2:1), ng’azitoowereddwa omusango gw’ekibi, naye Katonda n’amuwulira: noolwekyo obunafu bwe butatumalamu maanyi. Yakobo Omutukuvu aggyawo empaka eno.

Abamu bayinza okuwakanya nti, singa nali mutukuvu nga Eriya, olwo okusaba kwange kwandifiiriddwako: naye, bw’agamba, Eriya yali muntu ddala nga ffe, (Yakobo 5:17), yalina enneewulira nga ffe; kubanga tulowooza nti Katonda yamuwulira kubanga yali talina kamogo? Nedda ddala. Naye ka tutunuulire ebisuubizo; Bw’obanga mu buzibu, nnaakuwonyanga, (Zabbuli 50:15); Musabe, munaaweebwa, (Matayo 7:7), n’ebirala ebiri ng’ebyo: Katonda akkiriza okusaba kwaffe newaakubadde nga kunafu ; 1. Kubanga tuli baana be, kuva mu Mwoyo we yennyini; 2. Kubanga kukwatagana n’okwagala kwe yennyini; 3. Kubanga kuweebwayo mu butabaganya bwa Kristo, era akutwala, n’akutabika n’obubaane bwe; (Okubikkulirwa 8:3). Tewali kusinda kutukuvu na kumu, tewali zziga na limu lye tukulukusa, libula. Era nga buli kisa bwe kikula olw’okukikozesa, bwe kityo bwe kiri n’ekisa ky’okusaba; mu kusaba tuyiga okusaba. Mu ngeri y’emu twandyekuumye omwoyo ogw’okuggwaamu amaanyi mu buvunaanyizibwa obulala bwonna obutukuvu, kubanga tulina Omulokozi ow’ekisa bw’atyo. Tusabe nga bwe tusobola, tuwulire nga bwe tusobola, tufube nga bwe tusobola, tukole nga bwe tusobola, ng’ekigero ky’ekisa kye twaweebwa bwe kiri; Katonda mu Kristo alitunuulira n’eriiso ery’ekisa ekyo ekikye. Pawulo Omutukuvu yandirese okukola ekintu kyonna, kubanga yali tasobola kukola kirungi kye yayagala? (Abafiripi 3:14). Nedda, Nduubirira okutuuka awawakanirwa. Tuleme kwebonyaabonya ffekka nga Kristo wa kisa bw’atyo.

Waliwo obuwombeefu obw’omwoyo, mwe twebaliza Katonda olw’obusobozi bwonna obutono, ne tuwummula mu mirembe n’ekigero ky’ekisa kye twaweebwa, kubanga Katonda bw’asiima bw’atyo, oyo atuwa okwagala n’okukola ; naye mu ngeri nti tetulekera awo kufuba okusingawo, Naye, bwe tufuba n’obwesigwa ne tutatuuka ku kye twandyagadde okuba, ne tutatuuka ku balala kye bali, olwo tumanye olw’okubudaabudibwa kwaffe, nti Kristo talizikiza lutambi olunyooka ; era nti obwesimbu n’amazima, nga bwe kyayogeddwa edda, wamu n’okufuba okukula, bwe butuukirivu bwaffe. Kibudaabuda Katonda ky’ayogera, (1 Bassekabaka 14:13). Ye yekka aliziikibwa mu mirembe, kubanga mu ye mulimu akalungi. ; newaakubadde nga kalungi katono bukozi: Mukama, Nzikiriza, naye nnyamba okukkiriza kwange kweyogereko!, (Makko 9:24), n’okukkiriza okunafu, naye nga kwe kukkiriza ; nkwagala n’okwagala okunafu, naye nga kwe kwagala ; mfuba mu ngeri ennafu, naye nga mfuba; omuliro omutono gwe muliro, newaakubadde nga gunyooka. Okuva bwe wanzingiza mu ndagaano yo okuba owuwo nga nali mulabe, onoonsuula olw’obunafu buno, obukunyiiza era nga bwe bunakuwaza omutima gwange ?

fields.title: Ensonga y’Obutaba na Mwoyo ogw’okukola egonjoolwa, n’Okuggwaamu Amaanyi
fields.body_html:
OKUVA ku ebyo ebyogeddwa, nga twongerako katono, tekijja kuba kizibu kugonjoola nsonga eyo abamu gye beetaagamu obuyambi, kwe kugamba, oba nga tuteekwa okutuukiriza obuvunaanyizibwa bwaffe, emitima gyaffe nga tegyagala n’akatono. Okumatizibwa tuteekwa okumanya nti, 1. Emitima gyaffe gyokka gyegomba eddembe, era tegyangu kuleetebwa wansi w’ekikoligo ky’obuvunaanyizibwa ; era obuvunaanyizibwa gye bukoma okuba obw’omwoyo, obutagonda bwagyo gye bukoma okuba obungi. Obwonoonefu bufuna ettaka, emirundi egisinga, mu buli kulagajjalira; kiri ng’okuvuga eryato ng’olwana n’amayengo, omuggo gumu ogulekeddwa tegukomezebwawo mu misatu; noolwekyo kirungi okukuumira emitima gyaffe okumpi n’obuvunaanyizibwa, n’obutawuliriza nsonga ze gyetegefu okugunjaawo.

Bwe tutandika okukola obuvunaanyizibwa, Katonda anyweza ekibiina kye ky’alina mu ffe: tusanga ebbugumu mu mutima, n’amaanyi agagenda geeyongera, Omwoyo ng’agenda naffe, ng’atusitula mpola mpola, okutuusa lw’atuleka ng’olwatuuka mu ggulu. Katonda emirundi mingi asanyuka okukozesa omukisa gw’obutaba na mwoyo gwaffe, alyoke alage omulimu gwe obulungi ennyo ; era ekitiibwa kyonna eky’omulimu kibeere kikye, oyo nannyini maanyi gonna.

Obuwulize businga okuba obw’amazima nga tewali kirala kiwoomesa kikolwa; newaakubadde ng’essaddaaka si nnungi bulungi, naye obuwulize bw’eweebwayo nabwo bukkirizibwa.

Ekyo ekiwangulwa ng’omunyago okuva ku bwonoonefu bwaffe, kiriba n’okubudaabudibwa okw’ekigero ekyenkanyankanya n’obuzibu bwe kirina mu kiseera kino. Okuwulira n’eddembe ery’omwoyo emirundi mingi biterekebwa okutuusa obuvunaanyizibwa lwe bumala okutuukirizibwa : empeera egoberera omulimu. Mu buvunaanyizibwa ne nga bumaze, tusanga okumanya okwo okw’okubeerawo kwa Katonda, kwe tuyinza okulindirira ebbanga eddene nga tetulina buwulize, ne tutakufuna. Kino tekiziyiza ddembe ly’Omwoyo mu kufuuwa ku mmeeme zaffe nga bw’ayagala, Empewo ekuntira gy’eyagala (Yokaana 3:8). Kubanga twogera ku mbeera y’emmeeme yokka ennyeenyeewo empewo, era eteekwa okuvuga, ng’olwatuuka, ng’ewakana n’amayengo. Nga mu kuseeyeeya, omukono gubeera ku nkasi ekyusa eryato, n’eriiso ku mmunyeenye: bwe kityo ne wano, ka tuteeke amaanyi amatono ge tulina mu buvunaanyizibwa, era tutunule waggulu eri obuyambi, Omwoyo bw’alituwa ku bwereere, era mu kiseera ekituufu.

Kyokka mu buvunaanyizibwa obwo, obwetaaga omubiri nga bwe bwetaaga emmeeme, wayinza okubaawo okuwummulamu okutuusa amaanyi lwe gakomawo : okuwagala tekuziyiza wabula kutegeka. 2. Mu busungu obujja amangu, walina okubaawo ekiseera eky’okutereeza n’okukkakkanya emmeeme, n’okulongoosa emiguwa gy’ennanga: nnabbi yayagala omukubi w’ennanga okuleeta emmeeme ye mu mbeera ennungi. Bwe kityo era tufuna okuggwaamu amaanyi mu kubonaabona, olw’obutagumiikiriza obuli mu ffe: zinsanze, sirivvuunuka musaalaba gwe nti! Naye Katonda bw’atuleeta mu musaalaba, aliba naffe mu musaalaba; era oluvannyuma alituggyamu nga tulongooseddwa okusingawo ; tetulifiirwa kintu kyonna okuggyako ebisaaniiko, (Zekkaliya 13:9). Mu maanyi gaffe ffekka tetuyinza kugumira buzibu businga butono, naye olw’obuyambi bw’Omwoyo tusobola okugumira obusinga obunene: Omwoyo alissaako ebibegabega bye okutuyamba okusitula obunafu bwaffe. Mukama aliteekako omukono gwe okutusitula, omukono gwa Mukama gumuwanirira (Zabbuli 37:24). Mwawulira ku bugumiikiriza bwa Yobu, bw’agamba Yakobo, (essuula 5:11), twawulira era n’obutagumiikiriza bwe: naye Katonda yasiima mu kusaasira kwe okububuuka. Kituwa okubudaabudibwa ne mu mbeera ez’okwesulirayo, ng’endwadde ezisiigibwa, n’ebiringa ebyo, mwe tubeera mu ngeri ey’enjawulo wansi w’omukono gwa Katonda. Olwo Kristo aba n’entebe ey’okusaasira ku mabbali g’ekitanda kyaffe, n’abala amaziga gaffe n’okusinda kwaffe. Era, okudda ku nsonga gye tulimu kaakano, essakramentu teryateekebwawo lwa bamalayika, wabula lwa bantu ; era si lwa bantu abatuukiridde, wabula lwa bantu abanafu; era si lwa Kristo, oyo amazima gennyini, okumusiba, wabula kubanga tuli beetegefu, olw’emitima gyaffe egirina omusango era egitakkiriza, okubuusabuusa amazima gennyini; noolwekyo tekyamala bulungi bwe okutulekera ebisuubizo bingi eby’omuwendo, wabula atuwa n’obubonero okutunyweza: era, ne bwe tutaba nga twetegese nga bwe kitugwanira, ka tusabe nga Keezeekiya bwe yasaba: Mukama omulungi asonyiwe buli muntu amaliridde mu mutima gwe okunoonya Katonda, Mukama Katonda wa bajjajjaabe, newaakubadde nga tabadde mulongoofu okusinziira ku mateeka g’awatukuvu. (2 Ebyomumirembe 30:19). Olwo tujja eri essakramentu lino ettukuvu nga tubudaabudibwa, era n’ebibala bingi. Kino kyandituyisizza mu buvunaanyizibwa bwonna n’essanyu lingi, nti, bwe tukyawa obwonoonefu bwaffe, ne tubulwanyisa, tebulibalibwa nga bwaffe. Noolwekyo si nze nkola ebintu ebyo ebibi, wabula ekibi ekiri mu nze., bw’agamba Pawulo Omutukuvu, (Abaruumi 7:17); kubanga ekitunyiiza tekiritulumya n’akatono, era Katonda alitubala nga bye twagala, era bye twegomba, era bye tufuba okuba; kye twegomba okuba, kye tuliba; era kye twegomba mu mazima okuwangula, tuliwangula; kubanga Katonda alituukiriza okwegomba kw’abo abamutya, Abo bonna abamussaamu ekitiibwa abawa bye baagala (Zabbuli 145:19); okwegomba kwe kusasula okusooka okw’ekintu ekyegombebwa. Okuzzibwamu amaanyi okutono ennyo nga kututwala mangu mu mirimu gy’obulamu buno? naye obuyambi bwonna Katonda bw’atuwa tebwangu kuwangula butonde bwaffe obulwawo. Kale okuggwaamu amaanyi kuva wa? 1. Si eri Kitaffe, kubanga yeesiba mu ndagaano okutusaasira, Kitaawe w’abaana nga bw’asaasira abaana be (Zabbuli 103:13); n’okukkiriza ng’omuzadde okufuba kwaffe okunafu ; era ekibulamu mu maanyi g’obuvunaanyizibwa, atuwa olukusa okukijjuza mu kusonyiwa kwe okw’ekisa, mwe tunaawa ekitiibwa ekisa ekyo ky’asanyukiramu, nga bw’asanyukira ebikolwa ebisingako okutuukirira.

2. Si eri Kristo, kubanga ye olw’omulimu gwe talizikiza lutambi olunyooka. Tulaba Kristo bw’awa ebibala ebisinga obulungi eby’okwagala kwe eri abantu, abali mu mbeera eya wansi, abanafu mu busobozi, abanyiiza olw’obunafu bwabwe, nedda, olw’okugwa okusingako obubi ; ekisooka, bw’atyo bw’asiima okutabula amalala g’omubiri, agatera okupima okwagala kwa Katonda ng’okulaga obulungi obumu obw’okungulu. Eky’okubiri, bw’atyo bw’asanyuka okulaga obwereere bw’ekisa kye n’obuyinza bwe obw’obwakabaka, nti eyeenyumiriza yeenyumirizenga mu Mukama waffe.

Mu ssuula ey’ekkumi n’emu ey’Abaebbulaniya, mu kire ekyo eky’abajulirwa, tulaba Lakabu, Gidyoni, ne Samusooni, nga babaliddwa wamu ne Ibulayimu, jjajja w’abo abakkiriza. Omulokozi waffe omutendereze, nga bwe yali ekifaananyi kya Kitaawe, bw’atyo ne mu kino yalina endowooza y’emu, ng’agulumiza Kitaawe olw’okubikkulira abantu ab’omwoyo ogwangu ekyama ky’Enjiri, ng’abuusa amaaso abo abaalina erinnya ery’amagezi erisinga mu nsi, (Abaebbulaniya 11:31, 32).

Si kitasaanye kujjukira ekyo Augustine Omutukuvu ky’ayogera ku musajja omusirusiru ow’omu kiseera kye, eyali kumpi abulwa ddala okukozesa amagezi, oyo, newaakubadde nga yali agumiikiriza nnyo ebisobyo byonna ebyamukolebwako; naye, olw’okussa ekitiibwa mu ddiini, teyagumiikirizanga kisobyo kyonna ekikolebwa ku linnya lya Kristo; n’atuuka n’okukasuka amayinja ku abo abavvoola, era mu mbeera eyo teyasaasiranga wadde abafuzi be ; ekiraga nti tewali muntu alina busobozi bwa wansi bwe butyo, nti buli wansi w’okufaayo okw’ekisa kwa Kristo; awo w’asiima okulonda, n’okugulumiza okusaasira kwe, tabuusa maaso kigero kyonna kya magezi, ne bwe kiba kya wansi kitya.

3. Era okuggwaamu amaanyi tekuva eri Omwoyo, atubeera mu bunafu bwaffe, era olw’omulimu gwe ye Mubeezi, (Abaruumi 8:26). Bw’atulumiriza ekibi, n’atwetoowaza bw’atyo, kiri bwe kityo alyoke aggulewo ekkubo ery’okulaga omulimu gwe ogw’okutubudaabuda. Kale okuggwaamu amaanyi kuteekwa kuva mu ffe ffennyini ne mu Setaani, oyo afuba okutussaamu okwetamwa obuvunaanyizibwa.

fields.title: Ku bunafu. Si nsonga ya kuggwaamu amaanyi eri abo be buliko, n’engeri y’okuddamu emirembe egyabula
fields.body_html:
ERA mu nsonga endala eziggya abantu amaanyi, abamu batawaanyizibwa nnyo okubuusabuusa okw’omunda, ne ku buvunaanyizibwa obusinga obulungi; ekitundu olw’obulwadde bw’omubiri, Setaani mu ttima lye ng’abwongerako, ng’abafuuwa enfuufu mu maaso nga bali mu kkubo erigenda mu ggulu; n’ekitundu olw’obutamanya obukyasigaddewo, obuzaala okutya ng’ekizikiza bwe kikola; era nga bwe batamanyi bintu birala, okusingira ddala tebamanyi ngeri eno ey’okusaasira eri mu Kristo; singa bakikakasa, okutya okw’obulimba kwandigobeddwa mangu: bamulowooza ng’omuntu atudde ng’alindirira buli kakisa okubakwatako ; mu kino bandirabye nga tebakola bubi bo bokka, naye n’obulungi bwe. Okubuusabuusa kuno okw’omunda emirundi egisinga kabonero ka mmeeme etya Katonda, ng’omuddo ogumu bwe gulaga ettaka eddungi: n’olwekyo basaanidde okusaasirwa ennyo, kubanga kibonoobono kizito, era ensibuko yaakyo mu bangi si kutawaana kwa muntu wa munda nnyo, wabula bulwadde bwa birowoozo: Kristo yajja kutuggyako okutya kwonna okwo okutaliiko musingi.

Wakyaliwo mu bamu obutamanya bwe butyo ku mbeera ennungi ennyo gye tulimu wansi w’endagaano ey’ekisa, ne kibaggyamu nnyo amaanyi. N’olwekyo tusaanye okumanya, 1. nti obunafu tebumenya ndagaano ne Katonda: tebugimenya wakati w’omwami ne mukyala we; kale tunaayinza okwefuula abasaasizi okusinga Kristo, eyeefuula ekyokulabirako ky’okwagala eri abaami abalala bonna ?

2. Obunafu tebutuziyiza kusaasirwa; nedda, bwe bweyongera okukwata ku mutima gwa Katonda. Okusaasira kitundu ku byobugagga Ekkanisa by’eweebwa mu bufumbo, Kristo agiwasa mu kusaasira (Zabbuli 78:39). Omwami ateekwa okugumiikiriza mukyala we, kubanga ye kibya ekinafu (Koseya 2:19); kale tunaalowooza nti ye yennyini alyeggya wansi w’etteeka lye, n’atagumiikiriza mugole we omunafu ?

3. Singa Kristo teyandisaasidde bunafu bwaffe, teyandibadde na bantu bamuweereza.

Kale ka tugambe nti tuli banafu nnyo; naye kasita tetusangibwa mu balabe ab’ettima abawakanya amazima ga Katonda n’abagasimira obunnya, tuleme kukkiriza birowoozo bya kuggwaamu ssuubi : tulina Omulokozi omusaasizi, Naye tuleme okwebuzaabuza awatali musingi, tusaanye okumanya nti obunafu bubalibwa bwe buti, 1. Obutatuukirira obwekwata ku bikolwa byaffe ebisinga obulungi; oba, 2. Ebikolwa ebiva mu butakula mu Kristo, nga tukyali baana bawere; oba, 3. Ebiva mu butaba na maanyi, awali obuyambi obutono; oba, 4. Okubuuka okw’amangu okutategekeddwa, okukontana n’ekyo kye tutera okwagala n’okumalirira, ng’okusalawo kwaffe kubisiddwa ekire ky’okukemebwa okw’amangu. Oluvannyuma lw’ekyo, 1, Tutegeera obunafu bwaffe ; 2. Tubunakuwalira; 3. Era olw’okunakuwala, twemulugunya, era 4. Mu kwemulugunya tufuba era tutegana okwerongoosa, era mu kutegana tufunako obuwanguzi ku bwonoonefu bwaffe.

Obunafu bwe butunuulirwa bwe butyo, newankubadde nga nsonga ya kwetoowaza, era kye tufubirira okutta buli lunaku; naye busobola okubeerawo awamu n’obuvumu eri Katonda, era omulimu omulungi tegusaanyizibwawo bwo, wadde okwonoonebwa okutuusa ku butasiimibwa Katonda n’akatono. Naye okuwolereza obunafu kusinga obunafu ; okwekkiriza okusigala mu bunafu kusinga obunafu. Okuwolereza ekibi kusiba emimwa, emmeeme n’eremwa okuyita Katonda Kitaffe n’eddembe ery’omwana, oba okunyumirwa okussa ekimu naye okw’essanyu, okutuusa emirembe lwe gikolebwa nga twekwasa ensonyi, era nga tuzzaawo okukkiriza kwaffe. Abo abaali babetenteddwa olw’ekibi, bwe bagwa bazzibwawo mangu. Peetero yazzibwawo Kristo bwe yamutunuulira n’ekisa ; Dawudi n’ebigambo bya Abbigayiri. Gamba omubbi oba omutambuze atalina w’abeera nti avudde mu kkubo, tafaayo, kubanga ekigendererwa kye si kutambulira mu kkubo lyonna ttongole, wabula ng’ekyo bwe kimuganyula ye, Okwongera okutangaaza kino, tusaanye okutegeera, 1. Nti buli wonna awali ebibi eby’obunafu, mu muntu oyo walina okubaawo obulamu bw’ekisa nga bwatandika. Tewayinza kubaawo bunafu awatali bulamu. 2. Walina okubaawo okwagala okw’amazima era okwa bulijjo eri ebintu ebisinga obulungi ; newankubadde omuntu atya Katonda okumala akaseera asikibwa oba asindikibwa ebbali mu bintu ebimu, naye olw’omugabo Omwoyo wa Kristo gw’alina mu ye, era kubanga ebigendererwa bye bituufu mu bikulu, alizzibwawo ku bubwe, oba alikkiriza okubuulirirwa abalala. 3. Walina okubaawo okusalawo okutuufu okukkiriza amakubo agasinga obulungi, oba si ekyo omutima guvundu, era guyingiza obwonoonefu mu mpisa zonna, ebikolwa byabwe byonna ne byonooneka okuva ku nsulo yaabyo; bawolereza obugwenyufu, ne basalira amakubo ga Katonda omusango nti gakakali nnyo ; emisingi gye bakoleramu si mirungi. 4. Walina okubaawo okwagala okw’obufumbo eri Kristo, nga tebalikyusa Mukama waabwe era Bba waabwe ku kakwakkulizo konna, ne beewaayo ddala okufugibwa okwegomba kwabwe oba okwegomba kw’abalala.

Empisa y’Omukristaayo eri Kristo eyinza mu bintu bingi okunyiiza ennyo, n’ereeta okweyawula okumu: naye ajja kwatula Kristo, ne Kristo amwatule ; tajja kumalirira kkubo lyonna ly’amanyi nti lirimwawukanya ne Kristo.

Omutima bwe gubeera n’engeri zino, tusaanye okumanya kino, nti Kristo akitwala nga kitiibwa kye okubuusa amaaso obunafu bungi, nedda, mu bunafu mw’atuukiririza amaanyi ge. Waliwo obunafu obumu obukaluba ennyo okuwangulwa, ng’okwerabira, obuzito bw’omwoyo, obusungu obubuuka amangu, okutya, n’ebirala, obwo newankubadde bwa buzaaliranwa, emirundi egisinga bwonoonebwa ekibi; obwo, obanga obulamu bwa Kristo buli mu ffe, butukooya, era twandyagadde okubwekunkumulako ng’omulwadde bw’ayagala okwekunkumulako omusujja gwe; bwe kitaba bwe kityo, tekisaana kuyitibwa bunafu wabula bukakanyavu, era gy’okoma okwagala, n’ekibi gye kikoma: n’ebibi ebitono, Katonda bw’alizuukusa omuntu ow’omunda, n’abiteeka mu maaso gaffe mu nnyiriri (Zabbuli 50:21), birifuuka emigugu emizito, ne bitabetenta lumuli lwokka, naye ne binyeenya n’omuvule, Naye abaana ba Katonda tebakola kibi n’okwagala okujjuvu,. kubanga mulimu etteeka ery’ebirowoozo erikontana nakyo, obufuzi bw’ekibi mwe bumenyekera, era bulijjo lirina engeri ey’ekyama gye likola okulwanyisa etteeka ly’ekibi. Wabula wayinza okubaawo okwagala kungi mu kikolwa eky’ekibi, ne kitwonoonera nnyo okubudaabudibwa kwaffe oluvannyuma, ne kitulwisa ebbanga ddene ku kibonoobono ky’omuntu ow’omunda atateredde, Katonda mu nfuga ye ey’ekitaffe ng’ayimiriza okuwulira okwagala kwe. Nga bwe tuwa okwagala kwaffe ebbanga mu kwonoona, mu kigera ekyo kye kimu bwe tweteeka ewala n’okubudaabudibwa. Ekibi ekikolebwa ng’omuntu ow’omunda akiwakanya kiri ng’omubbi mu musubbaawa, amalawo essanyu lyaffe, era bwe kityo ne kinafuya amaanyi gaffe. N’olwekyo tusaanye okumanya nti okumenya okw’obugenderevu mu kutukuzibwa, kuliziyiza nnyo okuwulira nti tuweereddwa obutuukirivu.

Abo bakwata kkubo ki okuddamu emirembe gyabwe ?

Abo balina okwesalira omusango omukakali, naye ne beesuula ku kusaasira kwa Katonda mu Kristo, nga bwe baakola we baakyukira omulundi ogwasooka. Era kaakano kibeetaagisa okwenywereza ku Kristo okusinga bwe baali, nga bwe balaba obwetaavu obusingako mu bo bennyini, era bajjukire obukkakkamu bwa Kristo wano, atalizikiza lutambi lunyooka. Emirundi mingi tulaba nti oluvannyuma lw’okwetoowazibwa ennyo, Kristo ayogera emirembe mingi okusinga edda, okukakasa amazima g’okutabagana kuno, kubanga amanyi enkwe za Setaani ez’okusuula abo wansi n’okusingawo; era kubanga abo be basinga okwetoowaza mu bo bennyini, era bakwatibwa ensonyi okutunula Kristo mu maaso olw’obutaba na kisa kwabwe. Tulaba nga Katonda teyakoma ku kusonyiwa Dawudi kyokka, naye oluvannyuma lw’okubetentebwa ennyo, n’amuwa Sulemaani ow’amagezi okumusikira ku bwakabaka. Tulaba mu Luyimba lwa Sulemaani, essuula 6:44, nti ekkanisa bwe yamala okwetoowazibwa olw’okunyooma Kristo, Kristo n’agyaniriza nate mu kwagala, n’atandika okutendereza obulungi bwayo ; tusaanye okumanya olw’okubudaabudibwa kwaffe nti Kristo teyafukibwako mafuta olw’omulimu guno omunene ogw’Omutabaganya olw’ebibi ebitono byokka, naye n’olw’ebisinga obunene, kasita tuba n’akasasi k’okukkiriza okw’amazima okumunywerezaako. N’olwekyo bwe wabaawo olumuli olubetentefu lwonna, aleme kwegoba, Kristo bw’atamugoba; mujje gye ndi mmwe mwenna abakooye era abazitoowereddwa, n’ebirala (Matayo 11:28). Lwaki tetukozesa ngeri ey’ekisa bw’etyo ? kale tuli baavu lwa kuba tetumanyi bugagga bwaffe mu Kristo. Mu kiseera eky’okukemebwa, kkiriza Kristo okusinga Setaani, kkiriza amazima okuva eri Amazima yennyini, towuliriza mulimba, mulabe, era mutemu.

fields.title: Setaani tasaana kukkirizibwa, nga bw’atulaga Kristo
fields.body_html:
OBANGA Kristo atuweereddwa mu ngeri ebudaabuda bw’etyo, tuleme okukkiriza Setaani by’atulaga ku ye. Bwe tutawaanyizibwa mu muntu ow’omunda olw’ebibi byaffe, Setaani olwo amulaga eri emmeeme ennakuwavu ng’omulamuzi omukakali ennyo, eyeesibye obwenkanya okutulwanyisa : naye olwo ffe tumulage emmeeme zaffe, nga Katonda yennyini bw’amututeeka mu maaso, ng’agolola omuggo ogw’obwakabaka ogw’okusaasira, era ng’ayanjuluza emikono gye okutwaniriza. Bwe tulowooza ku Yusufu, Danyeri, Yokaana omubuulizi w’enjiri, n’abalala, tubalowoozaako n’essanyu, ng’abantu abakkakkamu era abawoomu ; kale okusingawo bwe tulowooza ku Kristo, tusaanye okumulowooza ng’endabirwamu y’obukkakkamu bwonna. Singa akawoowo k’ebimuli byonna kaali mu kimuli kimu, ekimuli ekyo kyandibadde kiwooma kitya? Mu Kristo obutuukirivu bwonna obw’okusaasira n’okwagala mwe bukuŋŋaanira; kale okusaasira okubeera mu mutima ogw’ekisa bwe gutyo kunene kwenkana wa? buli kisa ekisaasaanidde mu mwami, mu taata, mu muganda, mu mutwe, kyonna kye kimu ku bitangaala ebiva gy’ali; mu ye kiri mu ngeri esingira ddala. Tuli banafu, naye tuli babe; tulina obulema, naye era twetisse ekifaananyi kye. Taata tatunuulira nnyo bulema bwa mwana we, wabula engeri ye ye gy’alaba mu ye ; bw’atyo Kristo afuna ensonga y’okutwagala mu ekyo ekiri ekikye mu ffe. Alaba obuntu bwe mu ffe: tuli balwadde, naye era tuli bitundu bye; ani yali alagajjalidde ebitundu bye, kubanga birwadde oba binafu ? Tewali n’omu yali akyaye omubiri gwe. Omutwe guyinza okwerabira ebitundu ? Kristo ayinza okwerabira yennyini? tuli bujjuvu bwe nga ye bw’ali obujjuvu bwaffe. Yali kwagala kwennyini nga kwambadde obuntu, bwe yeegattako ennyo, alyoke atugabire obulungi bwe mu ddembe erisingawo; era teyatwala buntu bwaffe nga buli mu mbeera yaabwo esinga obulungi, wabula nga bwetoowaziddwa, n’obunafu bwonna obw’obuzaaliranwa n’obwa bulijjo bwe bwali bufugibwa. N’olwekyo tukyawe ebirowoozo byonna eby’okuteebereza obubi, nga bisuulibwamu oba nga bikuzibwa omwoyo ogwo ogwakolimirwa, ogwo nga bwe gwafuba okwawula Kitaffe n’Omwana mu kuleeta obuggya, Obanga oli Mwana wa Katonda, n’ebirala (Matayo 4:6). Bw’atyo bulijjo kye yeemalirako, kwe kwawula Omwana naffe, ng’atuzaalamu endowooza enkyamu ku Kristo, ng’alinga atalina kwagala kwa kisa bwe kutyo eri abantu nga ffe. Kino kye kyali obukodyo bwe okuva ku lubereberye, okufuula Katonda atasaana kwesigibwa mu maaso g’omuntu, ng’abuusabuusa okwagala kwa Katonda, nga bwe yakola ne jjajjaffe ow’olubereberye Adamu: obuwanguzi bwe yafuna olwo bumufuula omwetegefu okukozesa ekyokulwanyisa ekyo n’okutuusa kati.

Naye wadde nga bino byonna biri bwe bityo, simuwulira Kristo bw’atyo gye ndi, bw’ayogera olutambi olunyooka, wabula mu ngeri ekontana ddala, alabika nga mulabe wange, ndaba era mpulira obubonero bw’obusungu bwe obw’obwenkanya.

Kristo ayinza okweyisa ng’omulabe okumala akaseera katono. nga Yusufu bwe yakola, naye kiba kya kuteekateeka kkubo lya kweyoleka mu kusaasira kwe nga bw’ali ddala mu kiseera ekisaanidde ; tayinza kuziyiza kisa kye kiri munda ebbanga ddene, alabika ng’ameggana naffe, nga bwe yameggana ne Yakobo, naye atuwa amaanyi agakwekeddwa, oluvannyuma tuwangule. Okukkiriza kumuggyako ekibikka ku maaso, ne kulaba omutima ogw’okwagala wansi w’endabika ekontana nagwo. Mu kusooka omukazi Omukanani bwe yamukaabirira, n’atamuddamu kigambo na kimu; 2. Oluvannyuma n’amugaana; 3. N’amuddamu ekimuswaza, ng’amuyita embwa, kubanga yali bweru wa ndagaano, naye teyakkiriza kugobebwa bw’atyo; kubanga yalowooza ku kigendererwa ky’okujja kwe, Nga Kitaawe bwe yali tabangako kumpi naye nnyo mu maanyi okumuwanirira, okusinga lwe yali ewala ennyo mu kuwulira okusiimibwa okumubudaabuda; bw’atyo Kristo tabangako kumpi naffe mu buyinza okutuwanirira, okusinga bw’alabika ng’asinga okutukweka okubeerawo kwe. Amaanyi g’enjuba ey’obutuukirivu gayingira wala okusinga ekitangaala kyayo. Mu mbeera ng’ezo, Kristo k’abe ng’atuyisa atya kaakano, tumuteeke mu maaso engeri ye n’omulimu gwe, tayinza kwegaana yennyini, tayinza butatuukiriza mulimu Kitaawe gw’amukwasizza. Tulaba wano nga Kitaffe yeeyamye nti talizikiza lutambi lunyooka ; era Kristo naye yeeyama ku lwaffe eri Kitaffe, ng’alabika mu maaso ge ku lwaffe, okutuusa lw’alitwanjula mu maaso ge nga tetuliiko kya kunenyezebwa (Yokaana 17:6, 11). Kitaffe yatuwa Kristo, ne Kristo atuzzaayo eri Kitaffe.

Kino kyandibadde kibudaabudo kirungi, singa nnali wadde olutambi olunyooka.

Okuddamu. Kirungi nti okwemulugunya kwo kukukwatako ggwe, so si Kristo; kirungi nti omuwa ekitiibwa ky’okusaasira kwe eri abalala, newankubadde si gy’oli: naye tokola bubi mulimu gwa Mwoyo we mu mutima gwo; Setaani nga bw’awaayiriza Kristo gye tuli, bw’atyo atuwaayiriza gye tuli ffe bennyini. Obanga toli wadde olutambi olunyooka, kale lwaki tolekayo mugabo gwo mu Kristo, n’owakanya endagaano ey’ekisa? kino tokyesobola kukikola; lwaki teweewaayo ddala eri ebisanyusa ebirala ? kino omwoyo gwo tegukukkiriza. Okusinda kuno okutaliiko kuwummula n’okwemulugunya biva wa? teeka embeera yo eno ey’olwaleero wamu n’omulimu guno ogwa Kristo eri abali bwe batyo, era tonyooma kubudaabudibwa kwa Ayinzabyonna, wadde okugaana okusaasirwa kwo. Weesuule mu mikono gya Kristo, era bw’onoozikirira, ozikirire eyo ; bw’otokikola, toliiko kubuusabuusa nti olizikirira, Obanga okusaasira kusangibwa wonna, kuli eyo; mu kino Kristo mw’alagira nti akufaako, kubanga akuwadde omutima oguwulira mu kigera ekimu: yandikuwaddeyo eri obukakanyavu, obutefiirayo n’obutatya Katonda mu mutima, nga bwe bisinga mu kubonereza kwonna okw’omwoyo. Eyafiirira abalabe be, aligaana abo abeegomba ye mu mmeeme zaabwe? oyo atusaba okutabagana naye ng’ayita mu babaka be, alitugoba bwe tukinoonya n’obunyiikivu ku mukono gwe ? Nedda, awatali kubuusabuusa; bw’atusooka ng’atukoleezaamu okwegomba okutukuvu, aba mwetegefu okutusisinkana mu makubo ge ye. Omwana omujaajaamya bwe yamalirira okuddayo ewa kitaawe, kitaawe teyamulindirira, wabula n’amusisinkana mu kkubo; bw’agumya omutima okunoonya, alitega okutu kwe okuwulira (Zabbuli 10:17). Takyesobola mu mutima gwe okwekweka gye tuli ebbanga ddene. Singa Katonda atuleeta mu mbeera ey’ekizikiza ennyo, ne tutalaba kitangaala kyonna okuva gy’ali, oba mu bitonde, olwo tujjukire ky’ayogera ng’ayita mu nnabbi Isaaya, Oyo atambulira mu kizikiza, atalina kitangaala (Isaaya 50:10), nga talina kitangaala kya kubudaabudibwa, wadde ekitangaala ky’amaaso ga Katonda, naye yeesige erinnya lya Mukama. Tetuyinza kubeera mu mbeera nga waliwo ensonga entuufu ey’okuggwaamu ddala essuubi ; n’olwekyo tukole ng’abavuzi b’amaato bwe bakola, basuula ennanga mu kizikiza. Kristo amanyi okutusaasira mu mbeera eno; nga bwe yawulira okubudaabudibwa okuva eri Kitaawe mu kubetentebwa kwe (Isaaya 53:5), bwe tutyo naffe bwe tuliwulira okuva gy’ali mu kubetentebwa kwaffe.

Okusinda kw’omutima ogubetenteddwa kulimu obujulirwa, ng’obw’okwagala kwaffe eri Kristo, bwe kutyo obw’okufaayo kwe gye tuli. Amaaso g’emmeeme zaffe tegayinza kutunula gy’ali, nga ye tasoose kututunuulira na kisa; okwagala okutono ennyo kwe tulina gy’ali kye kitangaala ky’okwagala kwe ekyasooka okutwakako. Nga Kristo bwe yakola mu kyokulabirako kye buli ky’atulagira okukola, bw’atyo bwe yabonaabona mu mubiri gwe buli ky’atuyita okubonaabona, alyoke ayige obulungi okutuyamba n’okutusaasira mu kubonaabona kwaffe. Bwe yalekebwa yekka mu nnimiro, ne ku musaalaba, yakkiriza okubulwa okubudaabudibwa okutayogerekeka okw’okubeera ne Kitaawe, okwetikka obusungu bwa Mukama okumala akaseera ku lwaffe, era n’okumanya obulungi engeri y’okutubudaabuda mu buzibu bwaffe obusingirayo ddala ; Katonda alaba nga kisaanidde tulegeko ku kikompe kiri Omwana we kye yanywako ennyo bw’atyo, tulyoke tuwulireko katono ekibi kye kiri, n’okwagala kw’Omwana we bwe kwali; naye okubudaabudibwa kwaffe kwe kuno, nti Kristo yanywa ebisigalira by’ekikompe ku lwaffe, era alituyamba, emyoyo gyaffe gireme okuggwaamu ddala amaanyi wansi w’okulegako okwo okutono okw’obusungu bwe kwe tuyinza okuwulira. Teyafuuka muntu kyokka, naye n’afuuka ekikolimo, omuntu ow’ennaku ku lwaffe; yabetentebwa, ffe tuleme kubetentebwa; yeeraliikirira, ffe tuleme kweraliikirira okutuusa ku kuggwaamu ssuubi ; yafuuka ekikolimo, ffe tuleme kukolimirwa. Buli kyonna ekiyinza okwegombebwa mu mubudaabuzi atuukiridde kiri mu Kristo. 1. Obuyinza, kubanga Kitaffe yamuwa obuyinza bwonna. 2. Amaanyi mu ye yennyini, ng’erinnya lye ye Katonda Ayinzabyonna (Isaaya 9:6). 3. Amagezi, n’ago agava mu kwerabirako kwe ye, engeri n’ekiseera eky’okuyambamu. 4. Okwagala okuyamba, kubanga ye nnyama ey’omu — nnyama yaffe, era eggumba ery’omu magumba gaffe.

fields.title: Okunenya abo aboonoona ku ngeri eno ey’okusaasira eri mu Kristo. Ku kuzikiza Omwoyo
fields.body_html:
KAAKANO tusaanye okwetegereza ebika by’abantu eby’enjawulo abasobya ennyo ku ngeri eno ey’okusaasira eri mu Kristo: nga, 1. Abo abeeyongera mu makubo gonna amabi ag’obulamu nga balowooza nti tekigasa kugenda eri Kristo, kubanga obulamu bwabwe bubadde bubi nnyo; so nga amangu ddala nga tutunuulidde eggulu, buli kizzaamu maanyi kiba kyetegefu okutusisinkana n’okutusika mu maaso. Mu birala, kino kye kimu ku bisikiriza, nti Kristo mwetegefu okutwaniriza n’okutukulembera okweyongerayo. Tewali azikirizibwa mu kkanisa — wabula abo abaagala. Abo abeekakaatikako endowooza enkakali ku Kristo, balyoke babeere n’ensonga ezirabika ng’entuufu ez’okunoonya okumatira mu bintu ebirala: nga omuddu oyo ataliiko ky’agasa (Matayo 25:30), eyeemalira ku ndowooza nti mukama we yali muntu muzibu ; asobole okwebuzaabuza mu makubo ge agatabala, mu butakozesa ttalanta eyo gye yalina. 2. Abo abeetondera essuubi lyabwe bo, nti Kristo alibaleka ne batambulira mu makubo agagenda mu ggeyeena, n’abatuusa mu ggulu: so nga okubudaabudibwa kwonna kwandibadde kutusembeza kumpi ne Kristo, bwe kitaba bwe kityo kiba kubudaabudibwa kwa bulimba, oba mu kwo kwennyini oba mu ngeri gye tukweteekako. Era 3. Abo abeeyiira amazzi bokka ku busasi Kristo bw’afuba okukoleeza mu bo, kubanga tebaagala kutawaanyizibwa kitangaala kya Abo balina okumanya nti Omwana gw’Endiga ayinza okusunguwala, era abo abatagenda wansi w’omuggo gwe ogw’obwakabaka ogw’okusaasira, balibetentebwa n’omuggo gwe ogw’obuyinza (Zabbuli 2:9). Newankubadde alikuuma n’ekisa era alibeezaawo akasasi akasinga obutono ak’ekisa eky’amazima, naye w’atasanga kasasi ka kisa, wabula okuziyiza Omwoyo we ogulwanagana nabo, obusungu bwe bwe bulikoleezebwa bulyaka okutuuka mu ggeyeena. Tewali kisunguwaza kisinga ekisa bwe kigaanibwa mu bukambwe. Katonda bwe yayagala okuwonya Babulooni, n’atayagala kuwonyezebwa, olwo n’aweebwayo okuzikirizibwa (Yeremiya 51:9). Yerusaalemi bwe kyagaana okukuŋŋaanyizibwa wansi w’ekiwaawaatiro kya Kristo, olwo ennyumba yaabwe n’esigalidde awo, kifulukwa (Matayo 23:37, 38). Amagezi bwe gagolola omukono abantu ne bagaana, olwo Amagezi galisekerera okuzikirira kw’abantu (Engero 1:26). Obulokozi bwennyini tebulirokola abo abayiwa eddagala ne basuula eky’okusiba ku kiwundu. Nga mbeera ya nnaku, Omulokozi ono omusaasizi bw’alisanyukira okuzikirira kwabwe: oyo eyakola abantu bw’atalibasaasira (Isaaya 27:11). Ayi, abajeemu b’omu kiseera kino bagamba nti, Katonda teyatutonda kutuzikiriza. Weewaawo, bwe mutasisinkana Kristo mu makubo g’okusaasira kwe, kisaanidde mulye ebibala eby’ekkubo lyammwe ebbi, era mujjule ebibala eby’enkwe zammwe (Engero 1:31); Eno ye eriba ggeyeena wa ggeyeena, abantu bwe balirowooza nti baayagala ebibi byabwe okusinga emmeeme zaabwe ; bwe balirowooza okwagala n’okusaasira bwe byabakakaatikibwako kumpi ku mpaka, naye ne beeroboza okuzikirira. Gye tukoma okwenyigira mu kwereetako omusango, omuntu ow’omunda gy’alikoma okutabukira munda mu ye, bwe balikkiriza nga Kristo taliiko kya kunenyezebwa, ate bo nga tebalina kya kwewolereza.

Abantu bwe banaabuuza omuntu waabwe ow’omunda, alibagamba nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu emirundi mingi abadde akonkona ku mitima gyabwe, ng’ayagala okukoleeza mu bo okwegomba okutukuvu. Kiyinza kitya okugambibwa nti baziyiza Omwoyo Omutukuvu, okuggyako nti Omwoyo yali mwetegefu okubasika okutuuka ku kigera ky’obulungi ekisingawo okusinga bo bwe baali baagala? n’olwekyo abo mu Kkanisa abazikirizibwa baba beesalidde dda omusango. Bwe kityo wano tetwetaaga kulinnya ku nsonga ez’ewala, abantu bwe beetisse mu bifuba byabwe ensonga emala.

4. Era abasinga obulungi mu ffe ffenna bayinza okusobya ku ngeri eno ey’okusaasira, bwe tutegendereza ddembe empisa zaffe ez’omubiri lye zinaaba zeetegefu okwetwalira okuva mu yo. Bwe tutyo bwe tulowooza ; Kristo talizikiza lutambi lunyooka, kale twandityidde ki nti obulagajjavu bwonna ku ludda lwaffe buyinza okututuusa mu mbeera etaliimu kubudaabudibwa? Obanga Kristo tajja kukikola, kiki ekiyinza okukikola ?

Okuddamu. Omanyi nga waliwo omutume ky’agaana, wadde biri bityo (1 Abasessaloniika 5:19), Temuzikizanga Mwoyo Mutukuvu. Okulabula kuno okw’obutazikiza Omwoyo akutukuza ng’ekkubo ery’obutazikiza. Kristo atuukiriza omulimu gwe ogw’obutazikiza, ng’atuzuukusaamu okufuba okusaanidde; era tewali basinga kunyiikira mu kukozesa amakubo okusinga abo abasinga okukakasa nti biriggwa bulungi. Omusingi gwe guno: amakubo Katonda ge yayawulawo okutuukiriza ekintu kyonna, gali mu kigendererwa kye kimu ky’alina eky’okutuukiriza ekintu ekyo; era kino musingi ogukkirizibwa, ne mu bintu by’ensi; nga, ani, singa yamanya nga bukyali nti omwaka gujja kubaamu amakungula amangi, kyeyava awanika ekyuma kye ekirima n’alagajjalira okulima? Omutume kyeyava atuzzaamu amaanyi okuva mu kusuubira okukakafu okw’omukisa (1 Abakkolinso 15:57, 58); era okuzzibwamu amaanyi kuno wano okuva mu kuwangula okw’enkomerero okulungi kugendereddwa kutuzuukusa, so si kutuggyako kufuba: bwe tulagajjalira okukozesa ekisa kye twaweebwa, n’amakubo agaalagirwa, ne tuleka emyoyo gyaffe okunyigirizibwa obungi n’enjawulo y’okweraliikirira kw’obulamu buno, ne tutegendereza bunnyogovu bw’ebiseera, olw’okusobya okwo Katonda mu kufaayo kwe okw’amagezi atuleka emirundi mingi okugwa mu mbeera embi ennyo mu kuwulira, okusinga abo abataatangaazibwangako bwe batyo; naye mu kusaasira kwe talituleka kufuuka balabe ba ffe bennyini okutuusa ku kulagajjalira ddala obusasi buno obwakoleezebwa edda. Singa kyali kisoboka ffe okuweebwayo okulekera ddala okufuba kwonna, olwo tetwandisuubidde nkomerero ndala wabula okuzikizibwa; naye Kristo alirabirira akasasi kano, era alikuza ensigo eno entono, n’akuuma mu mmeeme bulijjo ekigera ky’okufaayo. Bwe tuba twagala okukozesa kino mu ngeri ebudaabuda, tulina okulowooza ku makubo gonna Kristo mw’ayita okukuuma ekisa ekyatandika; ng’ekisooka, okussa ekimu okutukuvu, Omukristaayo omu mw’abuguumiriza munne: ababiri basinga omu, n’ebirala (Omubuulizi 4:9). Emitima gyaffe tegyabuguumiridde ? (Lukka 24:32), abayigirizwa bwe baagamba. Eky’okubiri, okussa ekimu ennyo ne Katonda mu buvunaanyizibwa obutukuvu, ng’okufumiitiriza n’okusaba, ebitakoma ku kukoleeza kyokka, naye ebyongera okumasamasa ku mmeeme. Eky’okusatu, tuwulira mu kwerabirako omukka gw’Omwoyo nga gugenda wamu n’omukka gw’obuweereza, omutume kyeyava agatta ebintu bino ebibiri: Temuzikizanga Mwoyo Mutukuvu: era temunyoomanga abo aboogera eby’obunnabbi (1 Abasessaloniika 5:19, 20). Nasani mu bigambo bitono yafuuwa obusasi obwali buggwaawo mu Dawudi ne bubuuka. Mu kifo ky’okuleka omuliro gwe mu ffe okuzikira, Katonda alituma Nasani omu oba omulala, era bulijjo mu ffe mubaamu ekisigaddewo ekyegatta n’ekigambo ng’ekikwatagana nakyo mu buzaaliranwa; ng’ekisiriiza ekirimu omuliro bwe kikwata mangu omuliro omulala: olutambi olunyooka lukwata mangu omuliro. Eky’okuna, ekisa kinywezebwa nga kikozesebwa: tandikirawo okukola era Mukama akuluŋŋamye, Dawudi bwe yagamba mutabani we Sulemaani: seesa ekisa ekiri mu ggwe, kubanga bwe kityo ebikubirizibwa ebitukuvu bifuuka okumalirira, okumalirira ne kufuuka ebikolwa, n’ebikolwa ne bifuuka obwetegefu obw’okukola buli mulimu omulungi (1 Ebyomumirembe 22:17). Naye tumanye nti ekisa kyeyongera nga kikozesebwa, si lwa maanyi ga kukozesa kwennyini, wabula nga Kristo ng’ayita mu Mwoyo we akulukutira mu mmeeme, n’atusembeza kumpi naye, ensulo, n’atonnyeza mu kikolwa okubudaabudibwa okugaziya omutima okweyongerayo. Omutima gw’Omukristaayo lwe lusuku lwa Kristo, n’ebisa bye biri ng’ebyakawoowo n’ebimuli ebiwunya obulungi, Omwoyo we bw’abifuuwako ne biwunya akawoowo akalungi: n’olwekyo mukuume emmeeme ng’eggule okwaniriza Omwoyo Omutukuvu, kubanga bulijjo aleeta amaanyi amaggya okuwangula obwonoonefu, era kino okusingira ddala ku lunaku lwa Mukama waffe. Yokaana yali mu mwoyo ku lunaku lwa Mukama waffe, ne mu Patumo, ekifo kye yawaŋŋangusibwamu (Okubikkulirwa 1:10); olwo empewo z’Omwoyo zikunta n’amaanyi era n’obuwoomi okusingawo. N’olwekyo nga bwe tusuubira okubudaabudibwa okw’enjigiriza eno, tuleme kusiima bugayaavu bwaffe obw’obuzaaliranwa, wabula twemanyiizenga okutya Katonda (1 Timoseewo 4:7), era tufube okukuuma omuliro guno nga gwaka bulijjo ku kyoto ky’emitima gyaffe, tulongoose ettaala zaffe buli lunaku, tuteekemu amafuta amaggya, era tulinnyise emmeeme zaffe waggulu na waggulu: okusigala awo mu mbeera ennungi kukontana n’ekisa, ekitayinza butakula okutuuka ku kigera ekisingawo: tewabaawo akyusa kisa kino okukifuula obugwenyufu (Yuda 4). Obunafu nsonga ya kwetoowaza, so si kya kwewolereza mu bulagajjavu, wadde ekizzaamu amaanyi okwetulinkiriza. Twandibadde wala nnyo n’okuba ababi olw’okuba Kristo mulungi, wabula amanda ago ag’okwagala gandituyozezza; n’olwekyo abo okulowooza ku bukkakkamu buno obwa Kristo mwe kutakolera bwe kutyo bayinza okwebuusaabuusa ddala: mazima ddala awali ekisa, obwonoonefu buba ng’omukka mu maaso gaabwe, era ng’omususa ku mannyo gaabwe (Engero 10:26). N’olwekyo balifuba olw’okubudaabudibwa kwabwe, era n’olw’erinnya ery’eddiini, n’ekitiibwa kya Katonda, ekitangaala kyabwe kibalukewo. Obanga akasasi k’okukkiriza oba okw’okwagala kalina omuwendo bwe kati, kiriba kitiibwa kyenkana wa okuba omugagga mu kukkiriza ? Ani ataagale kutambulira mu kitangaala, ne mu kubudaabudibwa kw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, okusinga okubeera mu mbeera ey’ekizikiza eyeeraliikiriza ? era ataagale kutwalibwa mu ggulu n’amatanga gonna nga gagaziye, okusinga okusuukundibwa bulijjo okutya n’okubuusabuusa? Obuzibu bwa kaakano mu kulwanyisa ekibi si bunene ng’okutabulwa obwonoonefu bwonna bwe tuwagira kwe bulituleetera oluvannyuma: emirembe egy’amazima giri mu kuwangula, so si mu kugonda. Okubudaabudibwa okugendereddwa mu kyawandiikibwa kino kwa abo abandyagadde okukola obulungi, naye ne basanga obwonoonefu bwabwe nga bubaziyiza; abali mu lufu olw’engeri eyo, emirundi mingi ne batamanya kye bayinza kulowooza ku bo bennyini ; abandyagadde okukkiriza, naye emirundi mingi ne batya nti tebakkiriza, ne balowooza nti tekiyinzika Katonda okuba omulungi bw’atyo eri aboonoonyi abanaku nga bo; naye nga tebeekkiriza kusigala (mu kutya kuno n’okubuusabuusa. Era mu birala, abo abaagala okubeera n’abatabaganya abalala eri Katonda ku lwabwe okuggyako ye, nga beerumya bo bennyini era nga bamulumya naye! Waliwo n’omu asinga ye okusaasira, eyafuuka omuntu olw’ekigendererwa ekyo, alyoke asaasire omubiri gwe? Ka bonna buli kiseera bajje eri Omulokozi ono omukkakkamu, tuteeke okwegayirira kwaffe kwonna mu linnya lye eriwangula. Twetaaga ki okukonkona ku luggi olulala lwonna? waliwo n’omu ayinza okutulumirirwa okusinga Kristo? Tulina kizzaamu maanyi ki okukwasa embeera y’Ekkanisa okutwalira awamu, oba ey’Omukristaayo yenna alina omutima ogumenyese, mu mikono gye mu kusaba kwaffe? Abo tuyinza okubayogerako eri Kristo, nga bali bwe baayogera ku Laazaalo, Mukama waffe, Ekkanisa gy’oyagala ennyo, era gye weewaayo ku lwayo, eri mu nnaku : Mukama waffe, Omukristaayo ono omwavu, gwe wabetentebwa ku lwe (Isaaya 53:5), abetenteddwa era atuusiddwa wansi nnyo. Tekiyinza butakwata ku kisa kye ekiri munda, ennaku y’abo abaagalwa be ab’omunda bw’eyanjululwa mu maaso ge.

Nate, nga tulowooza ku buntu buno obw’ekisa obuli mu Kristo, ka tulowooze bwe tuti mu ffe bennyini : bw’atyo bw’atukolera ekisa, ffe tunaamukambuwalira mu linnya lye, mu mazima ge, mu baana be? abo abasanyukira okutiisa ennyo abawombeefu ab’omu nsi (Zeffaniya 2:3), banaasuubira batya okutunula mu maaso g’Omulokozi ow’ekisa bw’atyo? abo abakambuwalira ennyo omugole we, olunaku lumu balimanya nti baali bakolagana naye yennyini mu Kkanisa ye. Bwe kityo tekiyinza butasala mutima gw’abo abaawulira okwagala kuno okwa Kristo, okuwulira ng’afumitibwa oyo obulamu bw’obulamu bwabwe, era emmeeme y’emmeeme zaabwe: kino kye kikaabya abo abaasaasirwa nga bakaabira Kristo gwe baafumita n’ebibi byabwe ; tekiyinzika obutabaawo kuwulira awamu okw’amangu wakati w’omutwe n’ebitundu. Bwe tukemebwa okukola ekibi kyonna, bwe tuba nga tetwesaasira ffe bennyini, naye twandisaasidde Kristo, nga tetumuleetera kubonyaabonyezebwa kuggya. Omutume teyasobola kufuna nsonga emenya omutima okusinga eyo, okutukubiriza okwewaayo nga ssaddaaka eri Katonda, okuggyako okutwegayirira olw’okusaasira kwa Katonda mu Kristo.

Okusaasira kuno okwa Kristo era kwanditukubirizza okusaasira embeera y’Ekkanisa ennaku, eyuzibwayuzibwa abalabe ab’ebweru, era eyeeyuza yokka olw’enjawukana munda. Tekiyinza butakwata ku mmeeme yonna eyali ewulidde okubudaabudibwa okuva eri Kristo, okulowooza ku kwegayirira okw’omutima omutume kw’akozesa okukubiriza okukkiriziganya mu ndowooza ne mu kwagala. Kale bwe wabaawo okubazaamu endasi kwonna mu Kristo, oba okusanyusa kwonna okw’okwagala, oba okussa ekimu mu mwoyo, oba okwagala okw’engeri yonna, oba okusaasira, mutuukirize essanyu lyange, mulowoozenga bumu (Abafiripi 2:1): ng’alinga agamba nti, Okuggyako nga mwagala okwegaana okubudaabudibwa kwonna mu Kristo, n’ebirala, munyiikirenga okukuuma obumu obw’Omwoyo mu kwegatta awamu okw’emirembe. Nga kino kyerolerwa kya ssanyu eri Setaani n’ekibiina kye, okulaba abo abaayawulibwa okuva mu nsi nga beeyawulayawula bokka mu bo! Obutakkaanya bwaffe kye kiyimba eky’essanyu ky’omulabe waffe.

Abo kyebava basinga okunenyezebwa abaagala enjawukana n’abalala olw’ebigendererwa byabwe ku bwabwe, ne batakkiriza biwundu bya Kkanisa kuwona n’okugattika. Kino tekiteekwa kutegeerwa ng’abantu bwe basaanye okukweka endowooza yaabwe ku mazima gonna, awali ensonga entuufu ey’okwogera ; kubanga amazima agasinga obutono ga Kristo so si gaffe, n’olwekyo tetusaanye kwetwalira ddembe kukakasa oba okwegaana nga bwe twagala: ne mu kasente akatono waliwo ebbanja nga bwe liri mu ssente ennyingi, n’olwekyo tusaanye okuba abeesigwa ne mu mazima agasinga obutono; ekiseera bwe kikyetaaga, olwo ebigambo byaffe bibeera nga zaabu gwe batonye mu bintu bye bakoze mu ffeeza. Ekigambo kimu ekyogeddwa mu kiseera ekituufu kiganyula okusinga enkumi mu kiseera ekitali kituufu. Naye mu mbeera ezimu emirembe, nga tukuuma okukkiriza kwaffe nga kwa kyama (Abaruumi 14:22), gya mugaso munene okusinga okwasanguza ebintu ebimu bye tulowooza nti bya mazima; nga tulowooza nti obunafu bw’obuntu buli bwe butyo; nti tekiyinzika kwolesa njawulo yonna mu ndowooza, awatali kweyawulamu mu kwagala. Abantu gye bakoma obutaba na ndowooza emu, gye bakoma obutaba na mutima gumu, okuggyako ekisa n’emirembe gya Katonda (Abakkolosaayi 3:15) bwe bifuga ennyo mu mutima: n’olwekyo okwolesa enjawukana mu lwatu tekuba kulungi okuggyako nga kyetaagisa ; newankubadde abamu, olw’okwagala okulabika ng’abakulu, bakyamira mu makubo ag’ebbali, ne bagondera omwoyo gw’okuwakanya mu bo bennyini ; naye, singa Pawulo Omutukuvu y’aba omulamuzi, temufugibwa mubiri? (1 Abakkolinso 3:3); obanga ga magezi, magezi agava wansi ; kubanga amagezi agava mu ggulu okusooka byonna malongoofu, era ga mirembe (Yakobo 3:17). Omulokozi waffe omutendereze, bwe yali anaatera okuva mu nsi, kiki kye yakubiriza abayigirizwa be okusinga emirembe n’okwagala? Era mu kusaba kwe okw’enkomerero, yeegayirira Kitaawe n’obunyiikivu bwenkana wa babeere bumu, nga ye ne Kitaffe bwe bali omu ? (Yokaana 17:21). Naye kye yasabira ku nsi, tulikinyumirwa mu bujjuvu mu ggulu mwokka. Kino kifuule okufumiitiriza ku kiseera ekyo okuwooma ennyo gye tuli.

Era okweyongera okwasanguza aboonoonyi ab’engeri eno, tunaabalowooza okuba ab’Omwoyo ki, abeeyambisa okubetentebwa n’obunafu bw’emyoyo gy’abantu okubawa emirembe egy’obulimba olw’ebigendererwa byabwe eby’ensi? Omwoyo ogufumitiddwa gulekawo buli kintu, Ensonga ez’amagoba ezisinga obungi mu ddiini ya Paapa, ng’okwatulira kabona, okwesasulira ebibi, okusiimibwa olw’ebikolwa, pulugatoli, n’ebirala, biva wano, naye basawo abatalina mugaso, oba si ekyo babonyaabonya okusinga okuba abasawo. Mukisa mungi nnyo okuwonyezebwa okuva ku busagwa bw’enjaba zino okusinga bwe tusiima. Okunyigiriza okw’omwoyo kwe kunyigiriza okusinga, era okusingira ddala nga kuli awo awandibadde awasinga okulagibwa okusaasira ; naye ne wano abamu, ng’abasawo b’ebiwundu abakambwe, basanyukira okulwisa obujjanjabi, okwefunira mu nnaku y’abalala. Kireeta abantu wansi w’ekikolimo eky’entiisa, bwe batajjukira kulaga kisa, naye ne bayigganya abaavu n’abeetaaga, balyoke batte n’abalina omutima ogumenyese (Zabbuli 109:16).

Bwe kityo n’abo abeefunira amagoba ag’ensi okuva mu nnaku ey’omwoyo ey’abalala: wamu n’abo abeegaggawaza nga balyamu Ekkanisa olukwe, era abatali beesigwa mu bwesigwa bwe baakwasibwa: abaana bwe balikaabira emmere ey’obulamu, ne wataba abawa, bwe batyo ne baleeta ku bantu ba Katonda omusango ogwo omuzito ogw’enjala ey’omwoyo, nga balumya Kristo enjala mu bitundu bye. Tunaasasula bwe tutyo Omulokozi omulungi bw’atyo, atwala okwagala n’okusaasira okulagibwa mu kuliisa abaana b’endiga ze (Yokaana 21:15), ng’okulagibwa gy’ali yennyini?

Ekisembayo, beeyisa bubi nnyo eri Kristo abo abeesittala ku kukka kuno wansi ennyo gye tuli mu bufuzi bwe ne mu ebyo Katonda by’ateekawo, abakwatibwa ensonyi olw’enjiri okubeera ennyangu bw’etyo, ababala okubuulira ng’obusirusiru.

Bo olw’amalala g’omutima gwabwe balowooza nti basobola okukola obulungi ne batayambibwa kigambo n’amasakramentu ; era balowooza nti Kristo teyeetwalira kitiibwa kimala, n’olwekyo bagenda kulongoosa ensonga n’enkwe zaabwe bo, mwe basobola okusanyusa obulungi omubiri n’omusaayi, nga mu ddiini ya Paapa. Butasiima ki obusinga obwo, okunyooma obuyambi bwonna Kristo bwe yatuteekerateekera mu kusaasira kwe ? Mu nnaku ez’omubiri gwe, Abafalisaayo ab’amalala beesittala olw’okukolagana kwe okw’omukwano n’abantu aboonoonyi, so nga yakikolanga ng’omusawo okuwonya emmeeme zaabwe. Pawulo Omutukuvu yawalirizibwa okwewolereza atya olw’okunnyonnyola enjiri mu ngeri etaliimu kwewunda? Kristo gy’akoma okukka, mu ye yennyini ne mu baweereza be, okutugulumiza, naffe gye tusaanye okukoma okwaniriza okwagala okwo n’obwetoowaze bwonna n’obwetegefu, n’okugulumiza obulungi bwa Katonda eyateeka omulimu omunene ogw’obulokozi bwaffe, n’akwasa obufuzi, ku Mulokozi omukkakkamu bw’atyo, aneeyisanga n’obukkakkamu mu bintu byonna by’alina okukolako wakati wa Katonda naffe, naffe ne Katonda. Kristo gy’akoma okukka wansi gye tuli, naffe gye tukoma okumugulumiza waggulu mu mitima gyaffe: bwe batyo bwe balikola bonna abaali bawuliddeko okukola kwa Kristo mu mitima gyabwe.

fields.title: Ku kusalawo kwa Kristo mu ffe, n’obuwanguzi bwakwo: kye kuli
fields.body_html:
TUTUUSE ku kitundu eky’okusatu, okweyongera mu maaso obutasalako okw’amaanyi ga Kristo ag’ekisa, okutuusa lw’alimala okuteekawo mu ffe obufuzi obujjuvu obuliwangula obwonoonefu bwonna. Kyogerwa wano nti alikuza entandikwa ze ez’ekisa mu ffe, okutuusa lw’alireeta obwenkanya ne buwangula. Obwenkanya buno, oba okusalawo, wano kitegeeza obwakabaka bw’ekisa mu ffe, obufuzi obwo Kristo mw’assaawo entebe ey’obwakabaka mu mitima gyaffe. Abafuzi mu Bayudaaya baasooka kuyitibwa balamuzi, oluvannyuma bakabaka : obufuzi buno obw’omunda kyebuva buyitibwa okusalawo ; era kubanga bukwatagana n’okusalawo kw’ekigambo, omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli kw’atera okuyita okusalawo (Zabbuli 72:1, 2), kubanga kukwatagana n’okusalawo kwa Katonda: abantu bayinza okusoma omusango gwabwe mu kigambo kya Katonda, ekyo kye kibasalira, Katonda ky’abasalira. Olw’okusalawo kuno okuteekeddwawo mu ffe, ekirungi kyawulwamu, kikkirizibwa, era kikolebwa; ekibi kisalirwa omusango, kinenyezebwa, era kittibwa. Omwoyo gwaffe bwe guba wansi w’Omwoyo wa Kristo, gufugibwa ye, era gye gukoma okufugibwa Kristo, gye gukoma okutufuga mu kisa.

Kristo naffe tuli ba ndowooza emu era ba kwagala kumu ; alina by’ayagala mu ffe, n’ensala ze ziteekeddwa mu ffe bwe zityo, ne zifuuka okusalawo kwaffe, nga twetisse etteeka lye mu mitima gyaffe, eriwandiikiddwa Omwoyo we (Yeremiya 31:33): etteeka eriri mu muntu ow’omunda n’etteeka eriwandiikiddwa byanukulagana ng’ebiwandiiko bibiri eby’endagaano emu.

Amakulu kale gali nti, entegeka ey’ekisa ey’obutukuvu eteekeddwawo mu mitima gyaffe Omwoyo wa Kristo, erigenda mu maaso okutuusa obuyinza bwonna obukontana nayo lwe bulifugibwa. Omwoyo ogusala ensonga gulibeera omwoyo ogwokya (Isaaya 4:4), okwokya obwonoonefu bwonna obuziyiza, obulya emmeeme ng’obusagwa bwe bulya ekyuma. Abazimbi ba Katonda bwe bagwa mu nsobi, ne bazimba ebisasiro ku musingi omulungi, Omwoyo wa Katonda ng’omuliro ogw’omwoyo alikiraga mu kiseera kyakyo (1 Abakkolinso 3:13), n’akyokya: balisalira ensobi zaabwe n’amakubo gaabwe omusango nga bayita mu mwoyo ogw’okusalawo. Omulimu gwonna ogw’ekisa mu ffe gwogerwako mu linnya ery’okusalawo, era oluusi amagezi, kubanga okusalawo kye kitundu ekikulu era ekikulembera mu kisa; omulimu ogwo ogw’ekisa ogw’okwenenya kyeguva guyitibwa okukyusa endowooza, n’amagezi ag’oluvannyuma. Ate ku ludda olulala, mu nnimi ez’abayivu, ebigambo ebyogera ku magezi era bitegeeza okuwoomerwa n’okuwunyirwa kw’emmeeme yonna: era okusingako okusalawo kw’okuloza, okusinga okw’okulaba oba okw’okuwulira okulala kwonna, kubanga okuloza kwe kuwulira okusinga okwetaagisa, era kwetaaga ekintu okusembera ennyo okusinga engeri endala zonna ez’okuwulira. Bwe kityo mu bulamu obw’omwoyo, kyetaagisa nnyo Omwoyo okukyusa okuloza kw’emmeeme, ebintu eby’Omwoyo bigiwoomere nnyo, ebintu ebirala byonna ne bitagiwoomera, Era nga bwe kiri ekituufu eri buli Mukristaayo kinnoomu, nti okusalawo kwa Kristo mu ye kuliwangula, bwe kityo era eri omubiri gwonna ogw’Abakristaayo, Ekkanisa. Obufuzi bwa Kristo, n’amazima ge, by’afugisa ng’omuggo ogw’obwakabaka, birimaliriza nga biwangudde newankubadde Setaani, Omulabe wa Kristo, n’abalabe bonna. Kristo ng’eebagadde embalaasi ye enjeru (Okubikkulirwa 6:2), alina omutego ogulasa akasaale, era agenda ng’awangula (Okubikkulirwa 19:11), mu buweereza, alyoke awangule, oba olw’okukyuka oba olw’okutabulwa. Naye nze okusalawo nkutwala okusingira ddala nga bwakabaka bwa Kristo n’obufuzi bwe munda mu ffe. 1. Okugatta ku ekyo, Katonda okusingira ddala ayagala emmeeme n’omuntu ow’omunda bimugondere ng’entebe ye entuufu. 2. Kubanga singa okusalawo kwawangula mu birala byonna ebitwetoolodde naye si mu mitima gyaffe, tekwandituleetedde kubudaabudibwa; n’olwekyo kye kintu ekisooka kye twegomba bwe tusaba, Obwakabaka bwo bujje, Kristo ajje afuge mu mitima gyaffe: obwakabaka bwa Kristo mu ebyo Katonda by’ateekawo bugasa kuleeta Kristo waka mu kifo kye ye, emitima gyaffe.

Ebigambo bwe bimala okunnyonnyolwa bwe bityo, nti okusalawo wano kuzingiramu obufuzi bw’endowooza, n’okwagala, n’enneewulira, waliwo ebisalibwawo eby’enjawulo ebiva mu byo mu ngeri ey’obutonde.

fields.title: Kristo mukkakkamu nnyo, naye era alifuga abo abanyumirwa okubudaabudibwa kw’obukkakkamu bwe
fields.body_html:
EKISOOKA ekiva mu kuyungibwa kw’ekitundu kino eky’olunyiriri n’ekyo ekikisooka kiri nti Kristo mukkakkamu ku bukwakkulizo buno: abo b’akwatirwa ekisa n’obugonvu bwe batyo, mu bo mw’anaateeka obufuzi bwe. Asonyiwa mu ngeri nti agonderwe nga kabaka; atutwala okuba omugole we mu ngeri nti agonderwe ng’omwami; omwoyo gwe gumu ogutulumiriza nti twetaaga obutuukirivu bwe okutubikka, gwe gutulumiriza nti twetaaga n’obufuzi bwe okutufuga. Okwagala kwe gye tuli kumukubiriza okutubumba tumufaanane, n’okwagala kwaffe gy’ali kutukubiriza okuba ab’engeri gy’ayinza okusanyukira; so tetulina kukkiriza wadde essuubi okusinga bwe tufaayo okulongoosebwa nga ye bw’ali omulongoofu. Atufuula abafuzi abali wansi we, weewaawo, bakabaka abali wansi we, ng’atuwa ekisa si kya kulwanyisa kyokka, naye n’okuwangula mu kigero ekimu okwegomba kwaffe okwa wansi. Kye kimu ku bibala ebikulu eby’okugulumizibwa kwa Kristo, abe buli omu ku mmwe ng’akyuka okuva mu bibi bye (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 3:26). Kristo kyeyava afa, n’azuukira, era ali mulamu, alyoke abeere Mukama w’abo abaafa era n’abalamu (Abaruumi 14:9). Katonda yeesiba n’ekirayiro nti alituwa awatali kutya, tulyoke tuweereze mu maaso ge mu butukuvu ne mu butuukirivu ennaku zonna ez’obulamu bwaffe (Lukka 1:75), so si mu maaso g’ensi gokka. 1. Kino kiyinza okuba ekigezo eky’okwawula ani ayinza okwewolereza mu butuufu okusaasira kwa Kristo; abo bokka abanaakkiriza ekikoligo kye, ne babala nti kya ssanyu lingi okuba wansi w’obufuzi bwe okusinga okunyumirwa eddembe lyonna ery’omubiri; abanaatwala Kristo yenna, so si kumulondamu ekyo kyokka ekikwatagana n’okumatira kwabwe okw’ekiseera kino; abatayawule Mukama ku Yesu, ne beekolera Kristo waabwe ku bwabwe: tewali n’omu yali ayagadde ddala okusaasira okusonyiwa, nga tayagadde na kusaasira kuwonya. Dawudi asaba omwoyo omuggya, era n’okuwulira okusaasira okusonyiwa (Zabbuli 51).

2. Kino kiraga nti bawabye abo abafuula Kristo okuba obutuukirivu bwokka gye tuli, so si okutukuzibwa, wabula mu ngeri ey’okubalirwa: so nga kitundu kinene eky’essanyu lyaffe okuba wansi wa Mukama ow’engeri eyo, ataazaalibwa ku lwaffe kyokka n’aweebwa gye tuli, naye era okufuga kunaabanga ku bibegabega bye. N’erinnya lye aliyitibwa nti, Wa kitalo, Omuwi w’amagezi, Katonda Ayinzabyonna, Kitaffe ow’Emirembe Gyonna, Omulangira w’Emirembe (Isaaya 9:6-7); ye mutukuza waffe era mulokozi waffe; mulokozi waffe okuva mu buyinza bw’ekibi olw’amaanyi g’Omwoyo we agakola, nga bw’atulokola okuva mu musango gwakyo olw’obulungi bw’okufa kwe. Kale kino kijjukirwe: 1. nti omusingi ogusooka era omukulu ogw’okubudaabudibwa kwaffe gwe guno, nti Kristo nga kabona yeewaayo yekka nga ssaddaaka eri Kitaffe ku lwaffe. Emmeeme eriko omusango esooka kuddukira eri Kristo eyakomererwa, eyafuulibwa ekikolimo ku lwaffe. Eyo Kristo gy’aggya obuyinza okutufuga, eyo gy’ava okutuwa Omwoyo we okuba omukulembeze waffe okututwala eka.

2. Mu bulamu bwaffe, oluvannyuma lw’okuyingira mu mbeera ey’ekisa, bwe tugwa mu kibi kyonna, tulina okujjukira okusooka okuddukira eri okusaasira kwa Kristo atusonyiwe, n’oluvannyuma eri ekisuubizo ky’Omwoyo we atufuge.

3. Era bwe twewulira nga tunyogoze mu kwagala ne mu buvunaanyizibwa, ekkubo erisinga obulungi kwe kwota omuliro guno ogw’okwagala kwe n’okusaasira kwe, mwe yeewaayo ku lwaffe.

4, Era jjukira kino, nti Kristo bw’atufuga, atufuga n’omwoyo ogw’okwagala oguva mu kuwulira okwagala kwe, ebiragiro bye ne bitubeerera ebyangu; atukulembera n’Omwoyo we ow’eddembe, omwoyo ogw’eddembe: abantu be beewaayo kyeyagalire; okuwalirizibwa kw’ateeka ku bantu be kwe kwagala: atusika mpola n’emiguwa egy’okwagala. Naye jjukira era nti atusika n’amaanyi olw’omwoyo ogw’amaanyi, kubanga tekimala okuba n’ensonga n’okuzzibwamu amaanyi okwagala n’okugondera Kristo okuva mu kwagala kwe okwo, kwe yeewaayo ku lwaffe okutuweesa obutuukirivu; naye Omwoyo wa Kristo alina n’okuwangula emitima gyaffe n’agitukuza okumwagala, awatali ekyo ensonga zonna tezandibadde na mugaso. Embeera yaffe erina okukyusibwa, tulina okuba ebitonde ebiggya; abanoonya okwagala okw’omwoyo mu mutima ogutakyusiddwa banoonya eggulu mu ggeyeena. Omwana bw’agondera kitaawe, akikola olw’ensonga ezimusikiriza, era n’olw’obuzaaliranwa obw’omwana obuwa ensonga ezo amaanyi: kya buzaaliranwa eri omwana wa Katonda okwagala Kristo okusinziira ku kigero ky’azzibwamu obuggya, so si olw’okusikirizibwa ensonga kwokka; naye era olw’ensibuko ey’omunda n’omulimu gw’ekisa, ensonga ezo mwe ziggya amaanyi gaazo amakulu; okusooka, tufuulibwa abagabanira awamu obuzaaliranwa bw’obwakatonda, n’oluvannyuma tusikirizibwa mangu era ne tukulemberwa Omwoyo wa Kristo mu mirimu egy’omwoyo.

fields.title: Obufuzi bw’omwoyo obwa Kristo bugattibwa wamu n’okusalawo n’amagezi
fields.body_html:
EKY’OKUBIRI ekivaamu kiri nti obufuzi bwa Kristo mu Kkanisa ye ne mu baana be bufuzi bwa magezi era obutegeke obulungi, kubanga buyitibwa okusalawo, era okusalawo bwe bulamu n’emmeeme y’amagezi. Ekivaamu kino kirina amatabi abiri; 1. Nti obufuzi bw’omwoyo obwa Kristo mu ffe bugattibwa wamu n’okusalawo n’amagezi. 2. Buli awali amagezi ag’omwoyo amatuufu n’okusalawo, eyo era Omwoyo wa Kristo w’aleeta obufuzi bwe obw’ekisa. Ku ttabi erisooka: obulamu obulung’amizibwa obulungi n’amateeka ga Kristo bukwatagana n’ensonga ezisinga amaanyi era ezisinga obugulumivu; kyebava abantu abatukuvu bayitibwa abaana b’amagezi (Lukka 7:31), era basobola okulaga, mu nsonga ne mu bumanyirivu, obutuukirivu bw’amakubo gonna ag’amagezi. Amakubo agakontana nago busirusiru na bulalu. Kyebava Pawulo omutukuvu agamba nti omuntu ow’Omwoyo akebera ebintu byonna, naye tewali n’omu amukebera (1 Abakkolinso 2:15) ebimukwatako, so takeberebwa abo ab’eddaala erya wansi, kubanga tebalina kitangaala na kulaba okw’omwoyo okusalawo; naye ab’engeri eyo tebalekaawo kusala misango, n’okwogera obubi ku bye batamanyi, bavuma ne bye batategeera, bali ng’ensolo obusolo ezitaliimu magezi ezikwatibwa okuttibwa ne zizikirizibwa; era nabo okufaanana ng’ensolo ezo, bagenda kuzikirizibwa (2 Peetero 2:12); bava mu butamanya ne beesogga ekyekubiira n’okuvumirira okw’amangu, nga tebayise mu kusalawo okutuufu, kyebava okusalawo kwabwe kufuuka bwereere. Naye okusalawo kw’omuntu ow’omwoyo, okutuuka ku kigero ky’ali ow’omwoyo, kulinywera, kubanga kukwatagana n’obutonde bw’ebintu: ebintu nga bwe biri mu byo byennyini, bwe biri bwe bityo mu kusalawo kwe. Nga Katonda bw’ali mu ye yennyini omulungi n’ow’ekitiibwa ekitaliiko kkomo, n’ebirala, bw’ali bw’atyo gy’ali; mu mutima gwe awa Katonda obwakatonda bwe n’obulungi bwe bwonna. Nga Kristo bw’ali mu ye yennyini Omutabaganya yekka, era nga Kristo ye byonna, era abeera mu ffe ffenna mu Kkanisa (Abakkolosaayi 3:11), bw’ali bw’atyo gy’ali, ng’amufuula bw’atyo mu mutima gwe. Nga byonna bwe biri ng’ebisasiro, ndyoke ngobolole Kristo bwe bigeraageranyizibwa ne Kristo (Abafiripi 3:8), bwe biri bwe bityo eri Pawulo, omuntu eyatukuzibwa. Nga ekintu ekisingirayo ddala obubi mu ddiini, okuvumibwa olwa Kristo kisingira wala obugagga bw’e Misiri, kubanga yali asuubira empeera, bwe kusinga okuba mu ssanyu ery’ekibi eriggwaawo amangu (Abaebbulaniya 11:26), bwe kiri bwe kityo eri Musa, omuntu ow’okupima okutuufu. Nga olunaku olumu mu mpya zo, kisinga okubeera emyaka olukumi mu bifo ebirala. Njagala okuba omuggazi mu nnyumba ya Katonda wange, okusinga okubeeranga mu weema z’abakola ebibi bwe lusinga olukumi mu bifo ebirala (Zabbuli 84:10), bwe kiri bwe kityo eri Dawudi, omuntu ow’okusalawo okwazzibwa obuggya. Waliwo okukwatagana kw’okusalawo kw’omuntu omulungi n’ebintu nga bwe biri mu byo byennyini, era okusinziira ku njawulo oba okukwatagana Katonda kw’ateeka mu bintu, n’okusalawo kwe bwe kwawukana oba bwe kukwatagana.

Amazima ge mazima, n’obulimba bwe bulimba, n’ekitali kya mateeka si kya mateeka, abantu ka bakirowooze bwe batyo oba nedda. Katonda yateeka enjawulo ey’olubeerera wakati w’ekitangaala n’ekizikiza, ekirungi n’ekibi, ekitonde kyonna ky’ekitayinza kukyusa n’ebirowoozo byakyo; kale tewali kusalawo kwa muntu kwe kipimo ky’ebintu okusukka bwe kukwatagana n’amazima Katonda ge yateeka ku bintu byennyini. Kale olw’okuba okusalawo kw’omuntu ow’amagezi kukwatagana n’amazima g’ebintu, omuntu ow’amagezi ayinza mu ngeri emu okuyitibwa ekipimo ky’ebintu; era okusalawo kw’omuntu omu omutukuvu ow’amagezi kusinga okw’abalala lukumi. Abantu ab’engeri eyo emirundi mingi tebasagaasagana ng’enjuba mu kkubo lyayo, kubanga balowooza, boogera, era babeera mu bulamu nga bagoberera etteeka. Yoswa n’ennyumba ye banaaweerezanga Katonda (Yoswa 24:15), abalala ne bwe bakola ki, era banaatambulira mu kkubo erikontana n’ensi, kubanga okusalawo kwabwe kubatwala mu kkubo erikontana nayo, Kyebava Setaani akyawa nnyo eriiso ly’emmeeme, kwe kusalawo, ng’ayagala okulizikiza n’obutamanya n’ensonga ez’obulimba, kubanga tayinza kufuga mu muntu yenna okutuusa ng’amaze okuggyawo oba okukyamya okusalawo: ye mulangira w’ekizikiza, era afugira mu kizikiza ky’okutegeera. Kale alina okusooka okugobebwa mu kutegeera, amazima nga gawangudde era nga gasimbiddwa mu mmeeme. Kale abo abalabe b’okumanya bayamba Setaani n’Omulabe wa Kristo, obwakabaka bwe nga obwa Setaani bwe bwakabaka bw’ekizikiza, okuzimba entebe yaabwe. Kyebava Kristo yasuubiza nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu alirumiriza ensi olw’ekibi, n’olw’obutuukirivu n’olw’omusango ku nsonga y’omusango (Yokaana 16:8); kwe kugamba, nti amaliridde okuteekawo entebe ey’obufuzi, kubanga mukama omukulu ow’obujeemu, Setaani, omufuzi w’ensi eno asaliddwa omusango olw’Enjiri n’Omwoyo agigenderako; obulimba bwe bwabikkulwa, enkwe ze ne zirekebwa mu lwatu; kyebava Enjiri bwe yabuna, abalaguzi ne basirika, Setaani ng’agwa okuva mu ggulu ng’okumyansa kw’eraddu (Lukka 10:18), abantu ne baggyibwa mu bwakabaka bwe ne batwalibwa mu bwa Kristo (Abakkolosaayi 1:13). Awawangulira obulimba, okubikkulwa kwe kuwangula: tebaliiko gye balaga, kubanga obusirusiru bwabwe bujja kumanyibwa abantu bonna, ng’obwa abasajja abo bwe bwamanyibwa (2 Timoseewo 3:9). Kale okubikkulwa kw’obulimba kukuziyiza, kubanga tewali ayagala kulimbibwa. Amazima ka gaweebwe ebbanga lyonna awatali kuziyizibwa wadde okuziyizibwa, ne Setaani n’abaweereza be ka bakole ekisingayo obubi, tebaliwangula; nga Yeronimo bw’ayogera ku Bapelagiyo ab’omu kiseera kye. Okubikkulwa kw’endowooza zammwe kwe kuwangulwa kwazo, ebivvoola byammwe birabikira ku kutunula okusooka.

Kino kituyigiriza obwetaavu bw’okuba nti okutegeera kunywezebwe n’okumanya okusukkulumye ku butonde, olw’okutambuza obulungi empisa y’Omukristaayo.

Wateekwa okubaawo ekitangaala ekibikkula ekigendererwa ekisukka eky’obutonde, kye tuli Abakristaayo, n’etteeka erisaanira eritulung’amya eri ekigendererwa ekyo, kwe kwagala kwa Katonda mu Kristo, okubikkula by’ayagala gye tuli, n’obuvunaanyizibwa bwaffe gy’ali; era mu maanyi g’okubikkulwa kuno tukola byonna bye tukola, ebiyinza mu ngeri yonna okuyamba ku kubalirirwa kwaffe: Eriiso lisooka kuba eddamu, omubiri gwo gwonna gujjula ekitangaala ng’eky’omusana, olwo omubiri gwonna n’empisa yaffe yonna ne gujjula ekitangaala ng’eky’omusana (Matayo 6:22): bwe kitaba bwe kityo, ffe n’obulamu bwaffe tetuli kintu kirala wabula ekizikiza; empisa yonna ey’Omukristaayo si kintu kirala wabula okumanya okugaayibwa ne kufuuka okwagala, okwegomba, n’ebikolwa. Okugaaya okusooka mu lubuto bwe kutaba kulungi, okw’omu kibumba tekuyinza kuba kulungi: bwe kityo bwe wabaawo ensobi mu kusalawo, eyonoona ebikolwa byonna, ng’ensobi mu musingi bw’eyonoona ennyumba: Katonda tayagala ssaddaaka nzibe za maaso, wadde okuweereza okutaliimu kutegeera (Malaki 1:13), naye ayagala tumwagale n’amagezi gaffe gonna, Abaruumi

12:1, kwe kugamba, n’ekitundu kyaffe ekitegeera, era n’emitima gyaffe gyonna (Lukka 10:27), kwe kugamba, ekitundu ky’emmeeme ekiwulira.

Enteekateeka eno ey’obufuzi bwa Kristo olw’okusalawo ekwatagana n’emmeeme, era Katonda asanyukira okukuuma engeri y’okukola ey’omuntu yekka, kwe kukola by’akola okuva mu kusalawo: ng’ekisa bwe kyesigama ku butonde ng’omusingi gwakyo, bwe kityo enteekateeka y’ekisa ekuuma enteekateeka y’obutonde mu muntu. Kale Kristo aleeta byonna ebirungi mu mmeeme ng’ayita mu kusalawo, era mu ngeri ennungi bw’etyo, nga bangi olw’ensobi ey’akabi balowooza nti obulungi obuli mu bo n’obuvaamu buva mu bo bennyini, so si mu mulimu gw’ekisa ogw’amaanyi. Nga mu bubi, Setaani bw’atukulembera n’obukujjukujju ng’agoberera omukulukusiyo gw’obutonde bwaffe, abantu ne balowooza nti Setaani teyalina mukono mu kibi kyabwe; naye wano ensobi teriimu kabi kanene, kubanga ffe bennyini tuli babi, ne Setaani ayongera bwongezi obubi bw’asanga mu ffe. Naye mu ffe temuli nsigo n’emu ey’obulungi obusukkulumye ku butonde. Katonda tasanga kintu mu ffe wabula obulabe; wabula yawandiika kino kyokka mu butonde bwaffe, okutwalirizibwa okutwaliza awamu eri ekyo kye tusalawo nti kirungi. Kale bw’alibikkula mu bulambulukufu ekirungi mu kintu ekimu ekimu, tukisikirizibwako; era bw’alibikkula ekibi n’okulumiriza, tukyetamwa n’eddembe nga bwe twakiwambatira edda.

Kino kye tuyinza okumanyiramu oba tukola nga bwe tusaanidde oba nedda, kwe kugamba, bwe tukola bye tukola okuva mu nsibuko ez’omunda, bwe tutagwa ku kirungi lwa kuba bwe twakuzibwa bwe tutyo, oba olw’okuba abo be tussaamu ekitiibwa bwe bakola bwe batyo, oba olw’okuba twagala kuwagira ludda, ne tufuula eddiini ekibiina ky’okwekutula; wabula okuva mu kusalawo, bwe tukola ekirungi nga tusoose okukisalawo munda yaffe nti kirungi; n’ekibi kye twewala, nga tusoose okukisalawo nti kibi olw’okusalawo okw’omunda. Omukristaayo omulamu, nga bw’anyumirwa omugabo omulungi, bw’atyo yasooka kugulonda wamu ne Maliyamu, n’anyweza ebirowoozo bye byonna n’okuteesa (Lukka 10:42). Katonda ddala akozesa abantu ab’omubiri mu buweereza obulungi ennyo, naye nga okusalawo kwabwe tekukyusiddwa ddala era nga tebalumirizibwa.
