Akola ng’ayita mu bo, naye si munda mu bo, kyebava tebasiima kirungi kye bakola, wadde okukyawa ekibi kye beewala.

fields.title: Awali amagezi amatuufu n’okusalawo, Kristo w’ateekawo obufuzi bwe
fields.body_html:
ETTABI ery’okubiri liri nti buli awali amagezi amatuufu n’okusalawo, eyo Kristo w’ateese obufuzi bwe; kubanga awali amagezi, gatulung’amya si kutegeera kwokka, naye n’okutereeza amakubo gaffe obulungi; Kristo gy’ayigiriza ng’omulanzi ng’ayita mu Mwoyo we, era nga kabaka ng’ayita mu Mwoyo we awangula omutima okugondera ebyo ebiyigiriziddwa. Kuno kwe kuyigiriza Katonda kwe yasuubiza, bwe kutaba bwongo bwokka obuyigirizibwa, naye n’omutima gwennyini: abantu bwe bataba nga bamanya kyokka kye basaanidde okukola, naye nga bayigirizibwa n’okukikola ddala, tebayigirizibwa kyokka nti basaanidde okwagala, okutya n’okugonda, naye bayigirizibwa okwagala kwennyini, n’okutya, n’okugonda kwennyini. Kristo ateeka entebe ye mu mutima gwennyini, n’akyusa enteekateeka yagwo, n’afuula abantu be abalungi, nga bw’abayigiriza okuba abalungi. Abalangira abalala basobola okukola amateeka amalungi, naye tebasobola kugawandiika mu mitima gy’abantu baabwe (Yeremiya 32). Kino kye kitiibwa kya Kristo eky’enjawulo, afuka Omwoyo we yennyini mu bantu be: ku ye tekubeera Mwoyo ow’amagezi n’okutegeera ne Mwoyo w’okusala ensonga, n’ow’amaanyi ne Mwoyo w’okumanya era n’okutya Mukama Katonda kyokka, naye era ne Mwoyo w’okutya Mukama (Isaaya 11:2). Okumanya kwe tumulinako okuva gy’ali yennyini kumanya okukyusa (2 Abakkolinso 3:18). Omwoyo omu ogwo ogwakaayakanya ebirowoozo, gwe gufuuyira mu by’ayagala ne mu kwegomba okwagala okw’ekisa, era gufuka amaanyi mu muntu yenna. Ng’omuntu ow’ekisa bw’asalawo nga bw’asaanidde, bw’atyo bw’awulira era bw’akola nga bw’asazeewo, obulamu bwe kwe kunnyonnyola kw’omuntu we ow’omunda; waliwo okukwatagana okulungi wakati w’amazima ga Katonda, okusalawo kwe, n’empisa ye yonna. Omutima gw’Omukristaayo guli nga Yerusaalemi we kyali nga kisinga obulungi, ekibuga ekinywevu ekiyimiridde awamu; eyo entebe ez’okusalirako emisango gye zaateekebwa; z’entebe ez’obwakabaka ez’ennyumba ya Dawudi (Zabbuli 122:5): okusalawo kusaanidde okuba n’entebe mu mutima gwa buli Mukristaayo. Si nti okusalawo kwokka kujja kuleeta enkyukakyuka, wateekwa okubaawo ekisa ekikyusa obukyamu n’obuzito bw’okwagala, nga tekunnakkiriza kukolebwako kutegeera. Naye Katonda yagatta bino bwe bityo, nti buli lw’ayakira okutegeera mu ngeri erokola, awa omutima omugonvu era oguweta; kubanga awatali mulimu ku mutima ogukolebwa Omwoyo wa Katonda, gujja kugoberera okwagala kwagwo eri ekyo kye gwegomba, okusalawo ne bwe kunaayogera ki ekikontana: tewali kukwatagana kwa buzaaliranwa wakati w’omutima ogutatukuziddwa n’okusalawo okutukuziddwa. Kubanga omutima ogutakyusiddwa tegukkiriza kusalawo kufundikira mu bukkakkamu n’obutebenkevu ekisinga obulungi: ng’omulwadde, omusujja gwe nga gwonoona obuwoomi bw’akamwa ke, bw’ayagala okusanyusa akamwa ako okusinga okuwuliriza omusawo by’anaayogera. Okusalawo tekulina buyinza ku kwo kwennyini awali okwagala okutawanguddwa, kubanga okwagala n’okwegomba bikuwa enguzi kusale omusango ku lwabyo, amagoba oba essanyu bwe binaavuganya n’ekyo okusalawo kye kulowooza okutwaliza awamu nti kirungi; era kyebava emirundi egisinga kiba mu buyinza bw’omutima, okutegeera kye kunaasalawo era kye kunaamalirizaako mu bintu ebimu ebimu. Ekisa we kitegeddewo omutima, eyo okwegomba okutafugika tekuleeta lufu lw’engeri eyo mu maaso g’okutegeera nti kulemwa okulaba mu kintu ekimu ekimu ekisinga obulungi; n’ebirowoozo ebya wansi ebisibuka mu kwagala okwekka tebikyusa nsonga, wadde okukyamya okusalawo mu kkubo erikontana; naye ekyo ekirungi mu kyo kyennyini kibeera kirungi gye tuli, ne bwe kiba nga kikontana n’ebyaffe eby’ensi.

Okutegeera kino obulungi kulina kye kukola ku bikolwa, era kye kyandeetedde okukinnyonnyola mu bujjuvu: kino kijja kutuyigiriza enkola entuufu ey’okutya Katonda, okutandika n’okusalawo, n’oluvannyuma okusaba Katonda, awamu n’okutangaazibwa, okwagala okutukuvu mu by’ayagala ne mu kwegomba kwaffe, obufuzi obutuukiridde bulyoke buteekebwewo mu mitima gyaffe, era okumanya kwaffe kubeere n’okusalawo kwonna (Abafiripi 1:9), kwe kugamba, n’obumanyirivu n’okuwulira: okusalawo kwa Kristo bwe kuteekebwa mu kusalawo kwaffe, n’okuva awo, olw’Omwoyo wa Kristo, ne kuleetebwa mu mitima gyaffe, olwo kuba mu kifo kyakwo ekituufu ne ku ntebe yaakwo; era okutuusa olwo, amazima tegatugasa, wabula gayamba kutusalira musango. Obulamu bw’Omukristaayo bulamu obw’enteekateeka, era oyo atambulira mu tteeka (Abaggalatiya 6:16) ery’ekitonde ekiggya, emirembe gibeerenga ku bo, n’okusaasirwa, ne ku Isirayiri ya Katonda ye; oyo anyooma ekkubo lye n’ayagala okubeera nga yeetaaya, ng’anoonya eddembe lyonna eri omubiri, alifa (Engero 19:16). Era Pawulo omutukuvu akikakasa: bwe munaagobereranga omubiri, mugenda kufa. Naye bwe munnatta ebikolwa eby’omubiri, muliba balamu (Abaruumi 8:13).

Era tuyiga nti abantu ab’obulamu obufugibwa obubi tebalina kusalawo kutuufu: tewali muntu mubi ayinza kuba mugezi. Era nti awatali Mwoyo wa Kristo emmeeme eri mu kutabukatabuka, nga terina bulungi wadde ekifaananyi, nga byonna bwe byali mu kavuyo nga okutonda tekunnabaawo. Emmeeme yonna eva mu nnyingo zaayo okutuusa lw’ezzibwamu, ye oyo omulimu gwe kwe kuzzaawo ebintu byonna. Ekitundu ky’emmeeme ekya wansi, ekyandibadde kigonda, kye kifuga byonna, era kinyigiriza obutono obwo obw’amazima obuli mu kutegeera, nga bubusibira mu kwegomba okwa wansi; ne Setaani olw’obwonoonefu afuna ebigo byonna eby’emmeeme, okutuusa Kristo, amusinza amaanyi, lw’ajja, n’amugobamu, n’atwala obwannannyini ku maanyi gonna n’ebitundu byonna eby’emmeeme n’omubiri, bibeere ebyokulwanyisa eby’obutuukirivu, okumuweereza; olwo bakama abaggya, amateeka amaggya, Kristo ng’omuwanguzi omuggya akyusa amateeka amakulu aga Adamu ow’edda, n’ateekawo obufuzi bwe.

fields.title: Obufuzi bwa Kristo buwangula
fields.body_html:
EKY’OKUSATU ekivaamu kiri nti obufuzi buno buwangula. Ensonga ze zino :

1. Kubanga Kristo yasooka kuwangula byonna mu ye yennyini, era ye Katonda afuga byonna atenderezebwenga emirembe gyonna, Amiina; kale afuga ekibi, okufa, ggeyeena, Setaani, ensi, n’ebirala (Abaruumi 9:5). Era nga bwe yabiwangula mu ye yennyini, bw’atyo bw’abiwangula mu mitima gyaffe ne mu muntu waffe ow’omunda. Twali tugamba nti omuntu ow’omunda afuula omuntu kabaka oba omunaku, kubanga yasimbibwa mu ffe okusala omusango ku lwa Katonda, oba ng’atuwagira oba ng’atuwakanya; kale obanga omuntu ow’omunda ow’obutonde alina amaanyi bwe gatyo, kiriba kitya bw’anaaba, ng’oggyeko ekitangaala kye, ateekeddwamu ekitangaala ky’amazima ga Katonda? Talirema kuwangula, oba okutusobozesa okuyimusa emitwe gyaffe n’obuvumu, oba okutukkakkanya wansi okusinga bwe twali. Bw’agonda olw’ekisa eri amazima ga Kristo, olwo atunuulira n’obuvumu okufa, ggeyeena, omusango, n’abalabe bonna ab’omwoyo, kubanga olwo Kristo ateeka obwakabaka bwe mu muntu ow’omunda, n’amufuula ng’olusuku lwa Katonda.

Olutalo olusinga obukambwe emmeeme lw’erina luli wakati w’omuntu ow’omunda n’obwenkanya bwa Katonda: kale omuntu ow’omunda, bw’aba amansiddwako omusaayi gwa Kristo, ng’awangudde okulumbibwa okuva mu bwenkanya bwa Katonda, kati obwamalibwa Kristo, aliwangula okuziyizibwa okulala kwonna.

2. Tulwana n’abalabe abakolimiddwa era abasaliddwa omusango; kale bwe batandika okugwa mu maaso g’Omwoyo ali mu ffe, baligwa: bwe banaayimuka nate, banaaba bayimuka bagwe ekigwo ekisinga obunene.

3. Omwoyo ow’amazima, Kristo gw’akwasizza Ekkanisa ye okugiyigiriza, n’amazima g’Omwoyo, ogwo gwe muggo ogw’obwakabaka bwa Kristo, bibeerawo emirembe gyonna; kale emmeeme eyazaalibwa n’ensigo y’Omwoyo etafa (1 Peetero 1:23), n’amazima gano, tegirina kubeera mulamu emirembe gyonna kyokka, naye n’okuwangula byonna ebigiziyiza, kubanga ekigambo n’Omwoyo byombi bya maanyi mu kukola (Abaebbulaniya 4:12); era obanga omwoyo omubi tagayaala mu abo Katonda b’amuwaayo, tetuyinza kulowooza nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu aligayaala mu abo okukulemberwa n’okufugibwa kwabwe kwe kwamukwasibwa. Nedda, nga bw’abeera mu bo, bw’atyo bw’aligobamu byonna ebimujeemera, okutuusa lw’aliba byonna mu byonna.

Eky’omwoyo kya lubeerera; amazima kye kitangaala ky’Omwoyo wa Kristo, mu go gennyini, era nga bwe gasimbibwa mu mmeeme, kale go, n’ekisa kye gakola, ne bwe kiba kitono, biriwangula; ekintu ekitono mu mukono gw’omuntu omuwagguufu kikola ebikulu. Okukkiriza okutono okunywezeddwa Kristo kujja kukola eby’amagero, 4. alina aliweebwa abe na bingi naye atalina, n’ebyo by’alina ebitono birimuggyibwako (Matayo 25:29); okuwangula obwonoonefu bwonna oba okukemebwa kwonna kwe kakalu k’obuwanguzi obw’enkomerero. Nga Yoswa bwe yayogera bwe yalinnya ekigere kye ku bakabaka abataano be yawangula; eno y’engeri Mukama gy’anaakola abalabe bammwe be mulwana nabo (Yoswa 10:25), eggulu lyaffe dda, wabula tulwana okutuusa lwe tulifuna obwannannyini obujjuvu.

5. Kristo nga kabaka aleeta ekitangaala ekiragira mu mmeeme, n’akutamya ensingo, n’agonza omusuwa ogw’ekyuma ogw’omuntu ow’omunda; era w’atandika okufugira, afuga emirembe gyonna, obwakabaka bwe tebulikoma (Lukka 1:33).

6. Ekigendererwa ky’okujja kwa Kristo kwali azikirize ebikolwa bya Setaani, ku lwaffe ne mu ffe: n’ekigendererwa ky’okuzuukira kwali, ng’okututeekako akabonero ak’obukakafu bw’obuwanguzi bwe, bwe kityo: 1. Okuzuukiza emmeeme zaffe okuva mu kufa mu kibi; 2. Okununula emmeeme zaffe okuva mu mitego n’ennaku ez’okufa okw’omwoyo ebigenda n’omusango gw’ekibi; 3. Okuziyimusa nga zibudaabudiddwa okusingawo, ng’enjuba bw’evaayo n’ekitiibwa ekisingawo okuva mu kire ekikwafu; 4. Okutuyimusa okuva mu kuseerera n’okulemererwa okumu okumu, nga tuli ba maanyi okusingawo; 5. Okutuyimusa okuva mu mbeera zonna ez’obuzibu n’ez’ekizikiza ez’obulamu buno; era 6. Ku nkomerero okuyimusa emibiri gyaffe okuva mu nfuufu. Kubanga amaanyi ago gennyini Omwoyo ge yalaga mu kuzuukiza Kristo, omutwe gwaffe, okuva mu nnaku z’okufa, n’eddaala erisingayo wansi ery’okutoowazibwa kwe ; amaanyi ago gennyini agaafunibwa olw’okufa kwa Kristo okuva eri Katonda, kati eyakkakkanyizibwa ssaddaaka eyo, Omwoyo agalaga mu Kkanisa, gwe mubiri gwe, ne mu buli kitundu kyayo kinnakimu. Era amaanyi gano gaweebwa olw’okukkiriza, kwe tulaba, oluvannyuma lw’okwegatta ne Kristo mu mbeera ze zombi ez’okutoowazibwa n’okugulumizibwa, nga tetwafa kyokka wamu ne Kristo, naye nga twazuukira era nga Katonda atutuuzizza mu bifo eby’omu ggulu, okumpi ne Kristo Yesu wamu naye (Abaefeso 2:6). Kaakano ffe, bwe tutegeera nti twafa era twazuukira, era olw’ekyo nga tuwangudde abalabe baffe bonna mu mutwe gwaffe; era bwe tutegeera nti ekigendererwa kye mu bino byonna kwe kutufaananya naye, olw’okukkiriza kuno tukyusiibwa okumufaanana okuva mu kitiibwa okutuuka mu kitiibwa, ekiva eri Mukama waffe, Mwoyo (2 Abakkolinso 3:18), bwe tutyo ne tufuuka abawanguzi ku balabe baffe bonna ab’omwoyo nga ye bw’ali, olw’amaanyi ago ge tuggya gy’ali, ye tterekero ly’amaanyi gonna ag’omwoyo ag’abantu be bonna: Kristo ku nkomerero alituukiriza ekigendererwa kye mu ffe, era okukkiriza kuwummulira mu bukakafu obwo, era obukakafu buno bukola nnyo, nga butukubiriza okwegatta ne Kristo mu bigendererwa bye.

Era bwe kityo bwe kiri ku Kkanisa okutwaliza awamu, olwa Kristo erifuna obuwanguzi bwayo : Kristo lye jjinja eritono eryatemebwa mu lusozi awatali mikono, erimenyamenya ekifaananyi ekyo ekirungi (Danyeri 2:35), kwe kugamba, obufuzi bwonna obukontana, okutuusa lwe lifuuka olusozi olunene, ne lujjula ensi yonna. Bwe kityo ejjinja eryatemebwa mu lusozi, ku nkomerero lifuuka olusozi lwennyini. Kale ggwe ani, ggwe olusozi, alowooza okuyimirira okulwanyisa olusozi luno? byonna birigalamira wansi era biryenkanankana mu maaso gaalwo: alikkakkanya ebirowoozo byonna ebigulumivu ng’ensozi, era alikkakkanya amalala g’omubiri gwonna. Ebisusunku bwe biwakana ne kibuyaga, essubi ekkalu ne liwakana n’omuliro, ekisinziiro bwe kisamba ku nkato, oluggyo bwe luwakana n’omubumbi, omuntu bw’awakana ne Katonda, kyangu okumanya obuwanguzi ludda ki lwe bunaagenderako. Empewo ziyinza okusuukunda eryato Kristo mw’ali, naye teziyinza kulivuunika. Amayengo gayinza okukuba olwazi, naye gakoma ku kwemenyamenya gokka ku lwo.

Obanga kino bwe kiri, lwaki kiri bwe kiti ku Kkanisa ya Katonda, ne ku Bakristaayo bangi ab’ekisa? obuwanguzi bufaanana ng’obugenda ku ludda lw’omulabe.

Okuddamu, jjukira, 1. Abaana ba Katonda emirundi mingi mu bizibu byabwe bawangula nga babonaabona; wano abaana b’endiga bawangula empologoma, n’amayiba gawangula empungu, nga babonaabona, balyoke bafaanane Kristo, eyasinga okuwangula bwe yasinga okubonaabona; wamu n’obwakabaka bwa Kristo obw’okugumiikiriza waaliwo obwakabaka obw’amaanyi.

2. Obuwanguzi buno bujja mpolampola, kale abo banguwa nnyo mu mwoyo abaagala okuwangula amangu ddala nga bakubye ekikonde ekisooka, n’okutuuka ku nkomerero y’embiro zaabwe nga baakatandika: Abayisirayiri baali bakakafu ku buwanguzi mu lugendo lwabwe olw’e Kanani, naye nga balina okulwana okutuusa ku nkomerero. Katonda teyayagala twerabire mangu abalabe ab’ettima Kristo b’atuwangulidde; Tobatta, Ayi Mukama, engabo yaffe, abantu bange baleme kwerabira; mu buyinza bwo obungi, baleke batangetange; n’oluvannyuma obakkakkanyize ddala, abantu bange baleme kwerabira; mu buyinza bwo obungi, baleke batangetange; n’oluvannyuma obakkakkanyize ddala, bw’ayogera omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli (Zabbuli 59:11). Bwe kityo olw’obumanyirivu bw’okutawaanyizibwa kwe tufuna okuva gye bali, tulyoke tukuumibwe mu kutya okugwa wansi w’obuyinza bwabwe.

3. Nti Katonda emirundi mingi akola ng’ayita mu bikontana ; bw’ateesa okuwa obuwanguzi, alikkiriza tusooke kuwangulwa; bw’ateesa okubudaabuda, alisooka kutiisa ; bw’ateesa okuweesa obutuukirivu, alisooka kutusalira musango; oyo gw’ateesa okufuula ow’ekitiibwa, alisooka kumutoowaza ; Omukristaayo awangula, ne bw’aba awanguddwa ; bw’awangulwa ebibi ebimu, afuna obuwanguzi ku birala ebisinga akabi, ng’amalala ag’omwoyo, obulagajjavu, n’ebirala.

4, Nti omulimu gwa Kristo, mu Kkanisa ne mu mitima gy’Abakristaayo, emirundi mingi guddayo emabega, gulyoke gweyongere obulungi mu maaso: ng’ensigo bw’evundira mu ttaka mu biseera eby’obutiti, naye oluvannyuma n’emera obulungi ; era obutiti gye bukoma okuba obukambwe, ekiseera ky’okumulisa gye kikoma okuba eky’ebimuli ebingi ; bwe tutyo tuyiga okuyimirira olw’okugwa, ne tufuna amaanyi olw’obunafu obubikkuddwa; tusimba emirandira egy’ewala olw’okunyeenyezebwa; era ng’ettaala ez’omuliro bwe zaaka okusingawo nga zitambuzibwa, bwe kityo kisanyusa Kristo, olw’eddembe lye, okukuuma obufuzi bwe mu ffe mu ngeri eno. Ka tufube wano okukozesa okukkiriza kwaffe, kulyoke kukwatagane n’engeri Kristo gy’atukolamu: bwe tuwangulwa, ka tukkirize nti tuliwangula; bwe tugwa, ka tukkirize nti tulisituka nate. Yakobo, oluvannyuma lw’okukubwa ekikonde ekyamuleetera okuwenyera, era teyalekera awo kumeggana (Olubereberye 32:24), okutuusa lwe yafuna omukisa ; bwe tutyo ka tulemenga kulekera awo, naye mu birowoozo byaffe tugatte wamu entandikwa, okweyongerayo, n’enkomerero, olwo tulyeraba nga tuli mu ggulu, ewala abalabe bonna gye batasobola kutuuka. Ka twekakase nti ekisa kya Katonda, ne mu mbeera eno etatuukiridde, kya maanyi okusinga okwagala kw’omuntu okw’eddembe mu mbeera ey’obutuukirivu obwasooka, kubanga kati kizimbiddwa ku Kristo, ye eyatandika okukkiriza era y’akutuukiriza, olw’essanyu lye yali alindirira bwe yagumiikiriza omusaalaba, ng’anyooma ensonyi, n’atuula ku luuyi olwa ddyo olw’entebe ya Katonda (Abaebbulaniya 12:2); tuli wansi w’endagaano ey’ekisa okusingawo.

Ekyo abamu kye bagamba ku kukkiriza okusimbiddwa, nti kubeerawo, naye okukkiriza okunafu kuyinza okuggwaawo, kufaanana nga kiwakanyizibwa Ekyawandiikibwa kino: kubanga ng’okukkiriza okusingayo amaanyi bwe kuyinza okunyeenyezebwa, bwe kityo okusingayo obunafu, awali amazima, kusimbiddwa nnyo nti kuliwangula. Obunafu awamu n’okutunula bunaagumira, so ng’amaanyi awamu n’okwekakasa okuyitiridde galemererwa. Obunafu awamu n’okubukkiriza, kye kifo ekisinga okusaanira Katonda mw’atuukiririza amaanyi ge; kubanga okumanya obunafu bwaffe kutugobamu mu ffe bennyini ne kututwala gy’ali, oyo amaanyi gaffe mwe gali.

Kale kiddirira nti obunafu buyinza okubeerawo awamu n’obukakafu bw’obulokozi; abayigirizwa, wadde obunafu bwabwe bwonna, bagambibwa nti mujaguze nti amannya gammwe gawandiikiddwa mu ggulu (Lukka 10:20). Okulemererwa, awamu n’olutalo, mu kutukuzibwa tekusaanidde kunafuya mirembe gy’okuweebwa obutuukirivu kwaffe, n’obukakafu bw’obulokozi. Tekikulu nnyo bubi ki obuli mu ffe, wabula birungi ki; si bwonoonefu ki, wabula tubutwala tutya; si kulemererwa kwaffe okumu okumu kwe kuli, wabula omuguwa n’ekkubo ly’obulamu bwaffe bwe biri: kubanga Kristo okukyawa ekikyamu mu ffe tekumutwala kukyawa bantu baffe, wabula okuwangula n’obuwanguzi obunafu bwaffe bwonna, Abamu oluvannyuma lw’olutalo beewuunyizza obulungi bwa Katonda, nti okukkiriza okutono bwe kutyo era okukankana kwabawanirira mu ntalo ennene bwe zityo, Setaani bwe yali kumpi okubakwata. Era ddala kya kwewuunya, ekisa ekitono nga kiwangula kwenkana wa ewa Katonda okukkirizibwa, ne ku balabe baffe okubawangula, omutima bwe guba omugolokofu. Obulungi bw’Omulokozi waffe omulungi bwe buli bwe butyo, nti asanyukira bulijjo okulaga amaanyi ge mu bunafu bwaffe.

Okusooka, kale, olw’okubudaabudibwa okunene okw’Abakristaayo abaavu era abanafu, ka bamanye nti akasasi okuva mu ggulu, ne bwe kakoleezebwa wansi w’enku embisi ezikaaba era ezinyooka, naye kaliyokya byonna ku nkomerero, Okwagala bwe kumala okukoleezebwa kwa maanyi ng’okufa, obuggya bwakwo buli ng’obusungu obw’emagombe. Kwaka ng’ennimi ez’omuliro, omuliro ogwaka n’amaanyi ennyo, amazzi amangi tegasobola kukuzikiza, era kyekuva kuyitibwa omuliro ogwaka n’amaanyi ennyo, oba ennimi z’omuliro gwa Katonda (Oluyimba 8:6), ogukoleezebwa mu mutima Omwoyo Omutukuvu: obutono obwo obuli mu ffe buliisibwa ensulo ey’olubeerera. Ng’omuliro ogwava mu ggulu mu biseera bya Eriya (1 Bassekabaka 18:38) bwe gumalirawo ddala n’amazzi mu lusalosalo, okulaga nti gwava eri Katonda: bwe kityo omuliro guno bwe gulimalawo obwonoonefu bwaffe bwonna, tewali kubonaabona okw’ebweru, wadde obwonoonefu obw’omunda, obuliguzikiza. Ku makya emirundi mingi tulaba ebire nga bikuŋŋaana okwetooloola enjuba, ng’ebigenda okugikweka, naye enjuba ebimalawo mpolampola, okutuusa lw’etuuka ku maanyi gaayo amajjuvu. Ku ntandikwa, okutya n’okubuusabuusa biziyiza omuliro guno okubuuka, okutuusa ku nkomerero lwe gubisukkulumya byonna, Kristo n’awangula ; olwo n’awagira ebirabo bye eby’ekisa mu ffe. Ekisa kisooka kutuwangula ffe, naffe olw’ekyo ne tuwangula ebintu ebirala byonna ; oba bwonoonefu obuli munda mu ffe, oba okukemebwa okuli ebweru waffe.

Ekkanisa ya Kristo, eyazaalibwa ekigambo eky’amazima, erina okuyigiriza kw’abatume ng’engule yaayo, era erinnyirira omwezi, kwe kugamba, ensi n’ebintu byonna eby’ensi, omwezi nga guli wansi wa bigere bye, ng’alina engule eyaliko emmunyeenye kkumi na bbiri ku mutwe gwe (Okubikkulirwa 12:1); buli mwana wa Katonda awangula ekibi n’okwegomba ensi, era kuno kwe kuwangula okwawangula ensi, kwe kukkiriza kwaffe ensi (1 Yokaana 5:4). Okukkiriza, Kristo kw’asinga okufugiramu, kuteeka emmeeme waggulu nnyo, n’etunuulira ebintu ebirala byonna nga biri wansi wala, nga Omwoyo wa Kristo agiraze obugagga, ekitiibwa, obulungi, n’essanyu eby’engeri esingako obugulumivu.

Kaakano tulemenga kuggwako kubudaabudibwa okugendereddwa, waliwo ebintu bibiri bye tusaanidde okusinga okwetegereza; 1. Oba nga mu ffe muteekeddwamu okusalawo oba obufuzi obw’engeri eyo, ekisuubizo kino eky’obuwanguzi kwe kwakolebwa. 2. Amateeka oba okulung’amizibwa okumu ku ngeri gye tusaanidde okweyisaamu, okusalawo kwa Kristo mu ffe kulyoke kuwangule ddala.

Obujulizi bwe tuyinza okumanyiramu nti okusalawo kwa Kristo mu ffe kwa ngeri ejja okuwangula bwe buno, 1. Bwe tuba tusobola okuva mu bumanyirivu okulaga obutuukirivu bw’amakubo gonna aga Kristo, omubiri n’omusaayi ka byogere kye biyinza okwogera ekikontana, era nga tusobola okukkiriza n’omutima omulungi ekkubo Katonda lye yalonda mu Kristo okututwala mu ggulu, era nga tukyasiima ekigero ky’ekisa ekisingako kye tutannatuukako, ne tukiteekateekera era ne tukiteebereza. Tewali bantu balala basobola kulaga butuukirivu bwa makubo gaabwe, omuntu waabwe ow’omunda bw’azuukuka. 2. Ensonga z’eddiini bwe ziba ensonga ezisinga amaanyi gye tuli, era ne ziwangula okusinga ensonga eziggibwa mu magezi ag’ensi. 3. Bwe tuba abeesigwa bwe tutyo eri ebigendererwa byaffe era abanywevu ku tteeka lyaffe, nga tewali ssuubi wadde okutya ebiyinza okutukyusa okudda mu kkubo eddala, naye bulijjo nga tutunuulira ekikwatagana oba ekyawukana ku tteeka lyaffe. 4. Bwe tuba nga tetuyinza kuwakanya mazima, wabula tugawagira buwagizi (2 Abakkolinso 13:8), kubanga ga muwendo gye tuli okusinga obulamu bwaffe ; amazima tegalina buyinza buno mu mutima gw’omuntu yenna ow’omubiri. 5. Bwe kiba nti, singa twaweebwa eddembe okulonda obufuzi bw’ani bwe twandibeeddemu, naye olw’okusanyukira obufuzi bwa Kristo mu muntu ow’omunda, twandimulonze yekka okutufuga okusinga omulala yenna, kubanga kino kiraga nti tulina endowooza efaanana ng’eya Kristo, abantu abali mu ddembe era abeewaayo kyeyagalire, so si abawalirizibwa mu buweereza bwa Kristo, okuggyako okuwalirizibwa okulungi okw’okwagala. Bwe tuba nga tusanyukira nnyo obufuzi bw’Omwoyo wa Kristo, nti twagala okwewaayo gy’ali mu bintu byonna, kubanga olwo obwakabaka bwe buba bututuuseeko, bye twagala bwe bireetebwa eri by’ayagala; obukyamu bw’ebyo bye twagala bwe butufuula abalungi oba ababi.

6. Obulamu obutegeke obulungi obw’enkola emu, so si obw’okukola ebiseera ebimu n’okulekayo, bulaga omutima ogutegeke obulungi, nga mu ssaawa, ennyondo bw’ekuba obulungi, n’omukono gw’essaawa ne gulaga obulungi, kabonero nti nnamuziga ziteekeddwa bulungi. 7. By’ayagala Kristo bwe bivuganya n’okufiirwa oba okufuna kwonna okw’ensi, naye ne mu kaseera ako, mu nsonga eyo emu, omutima ne gukutama eri Kristo, kabonero ka mazima; kubanga ekigezo ekisinga obutuufu eky’amaanyi g’ekisa kiri mu nsonga ezo ezimu ezisinga okutukwatako, kubanga eyo obwonoonefu bwaffe gye businga okwekulumbaza. Kristo bwe yasemberera ddala omuvubuka (Matayo 10:22), mu njiri, n’afiirwa omuyigirizwa. 8. Bwe tusobola okukola emirimu egisanyusa Kristo, ne bwe gikontana n’omubiri n’ekkubo ly’ensi. Era bwe tusobola okwewangula mu bubi obwo obutonde bwaffe bwe bwegolokera, era bwe bwetuuka nnyo, era obukwatagana n’empisa z’ebiseera, era abalala bwe basibiddwa wansi wabwo; ng’okwagala okwesasuza, okukyawa abalabe, ebigendererwa eby’okwefaako, n’ebirala, olwo kirabika nti ekisa kiri mu ffe okusinga obutonde, eggulu okusinga ensi, era kiriwangula.

Okwongera okutangaaza kino n’okutuyamba mu kwekebera kwaffe, tulina okumanya nti waliwo amadaala asatu ag’obuwanguzi. 1. Bwe tuziyiza, ne bwe tuba tuwanguddwa. 2. Ekisa bwe kisinga, ne bwe kiba nga kiri mu lutalo. 3. Obwonoonefu bwonna bwe buwangulwa ddala. Kaakano bwe tuba n’amaanyi ag’okuziyiza bwokka, era tuyinza okumanya nti obufuzi bwa Kristo mu ffe buliwangula, kubanga ekyogerwa ku Setaani kyogerwa ku balabe baffe bonna ab’omwoyo, Bwe tubalwanyisa, mu kiseera kyabwe balitudduka (Yakobo 4:7); kubanga oyo ali mu ffe, awagira ekisa kye, wa maanyi okusinga oyo ali mu nsi (1 Yokaana 4:4), Era obanga tuyinza okusuubira obuwanguzi olw’okuziyiza kwokka, kiki kye tutayinza kusuubira Omwoyo bw’amala okufuna obuyinza obusinga ?

fields.title: Engeri ez’okuwanguza ekisa
fields.body_html:
KU nsonga ey’okubiri, kwe kugamba, ebiragiro.

Tulina okumanya nti, wadde Kristo yeetisse obuwanguzi buno, abutuukiriza ng’atutendeka okulwana entalo ze; awangulira mu ffe ng’atufuula ab’amagezi olw’obulokozi (2 Timoseewo 3:15): era nga bwe tukkiriza nti Kristo aliwangula, mu kigero ekyo kyennyini tunaafubanga olw’ekisa kye tulyoke tuwangule; kubanga okukkiriza kisa ekiwulize era eky’amagezi: Kristo atufuula ab’amagezi okulowooza n’okupima ebintu, n’oluvannyuma okubisengeka n’okubiteeka mu nteeko, tusobole okwerondera ekisinga obulungi. Gano ge gamu ku mateeka agatuyamba mu kusalawo;

Okusalawo ku bintu nga bwe biyamba oba bwe biziyiza ekikulu: nga bwe byongera oba bwe biziyiza okubalirira kwaffe: nga bwe bitufuula ab’omwoyo okusingawo oba okukendeerako, bwe bityo ne bitusembereza ensulo y’obulungi, Katonda yennyini: nga bwe bitureetera emirembe oba ennaku ku nkomerero, nga bwe bitusiimisa oba obutatusiimisa eri Katonda, era mu ki mwe tunaasinga okwesiimisa gy’ali: era okusalawo ku bintu kaakano nga bwe tulibisalawo oluvannyuma, emmeeme bw’eriba esinga okusobola okusalawo, nga bwe tuba mu kabenje akagwiridde bonna, oba mu ssaawa ey’okufa, emmeeme bw’ekuŋŋaanya ebirowoozo byayo okuva ku bintu ebirala byonna n’ebizza gy’eri yokka. Tunuulira emabega mu bye wayitamu, olabe ekisinga okukwatagana nabyo, ekyali ekisinga obulungi mu biseera byaffe ebisinga obubi. Obanga ekisa kye kisinga obulungi oba kye kyali kisinga obulungi mu kiseera ekyo, kye kisinga obulungi ne kaakano. Era fuba okusalawo ku bintu nga bw’asalawo oyo agenda okutusalira omusango, era nga bwe basalawo abantu abatukuvu abakulemberwa Omwoyo; n’okusingira ddala, nga bwe basalawo abo abatalina kye bagoberera mu mugaso gwonna oguyinza okuva mu nsonga eboogerwako: kubanga ebintu eby’okungulu bizibya amaaso n’ag’abagezi; tulaba ng’abagoberezi b’eddiini ya Paapa basinga okwonooneka mu bintu ebyo ekitiibwa kyabwe, okuwummula kwabwe oba amagoba gaabwe mwe bikwatibwako; naye mu kuyigiriza ku Busatu Obutukuvu, obutakwata ku bintu ebyo, tebaliiko kamogo. Naye tekimala okusalawo okuba okutuufu kwokka, wabula kuteekwa okuba n’okw’amangu era okw’amaanyi.

Kristo w’anyweza obufuzi bwe, ateeka mu muntu okufaayo okukuuma okusalawo nga kutangaavu era nga kuggya, kubanga okusalawo bwe kuba nga kuyimiridde butereevu era nga kunywevu, ensengeka y’emmeeme yonna esigala nga ya maanyi era nga tewangulika. Okusalawo okutuufu mu ffe kugulumiza Kristo, era Kristo alikugulumiza. Ekibi kyonna kiva ku misingi egy’obulimba, oba ku butamanya, oba ku butafaayo, oba ku butakkiriza misingi egy’amazima. Olw’obutalowooza n’obunafu bw’okukkiriza, Kaawa yasooka okuseerera n’ava ku kye yali anywezezza (Olubereberye 3). Kale kirungi okuterekanga emisingi egy’amazima mu mitima gyaffe, n’okugizza obuggya emirundi mingi, olw’amaanyi gaagyo okwagala kwaffe n’ebikolwa byaffe bibeere n’obuvumu obungi. Okusalawo bwe kunywezebwa, ekibi tekifuna we kiyingirira, naye ebirungi bifuna oludda mu ffe olubyaniriza. Ekitangaala eky’amazima ekitukakasa bwe kisigalawo, tetuliyinza kukola kibi na kitono nnyo, wadde okwewala ekibonerezo ekisinga obunene. Nga kuba kumala biseera okutega omutego, ng’ekinyonyi ky’oyagala okukwata kikulaba (Engero 1:17). Emmeeme bw’ekuumibwa waggulu, waba tewali kabi ka mitego wansi; tusooka kufiirwa kitiibwa kye tuwa ebintu nga tetunnasendebwasendebwa mu kibi kyonna.

Era olw’okuba okumanya n’okwagala biyambagana, kirungi okukuuma okwagala kwaffe n’essanyu nga biramu, nga tukozesa buli kisikiriza ekiwooma n’okugumizibwa okuva eri Katonda; kubanga omutima kye gusinga okwagala, ebirowoozo kye bisinga okufumiitirizaako. Abo abasobola okuleeta emitima gyabwe okusanyukira Kristo be basinga okumanya amakubo ge. Amagezi gaagala oyo agaagala. Okwagala kwe kusinga okwaniriza amazima; era amazima bwe gataanirizibwa mu kugaagala (2 Abasessaloniika 2:10), wadde nga ga kwagalibwa nnyo bwe gatyo, galeka omutima ne gatabeeramu nate. Ekkubo eryatera okuwangula lyabadde okusooka okuggyawo okwagala, okwonoona okusalawo; kubanga nga bwe twagala, bwe tutyo bwe tutera okusalawo: kyova kiba kizibu omuntu okuba n’okwagala okungi era n’okuba ow’amagezi mu bintu by’ensi; naye mu by’omu ggulu, okusalawo bwe kuba nga kwasooka okutegeezebwa obulungi, okwagala kwaffe gye kukoma okukula, okusalawo kwaffe gye kukoma okuba okulungi era okutangaavu, kubanga okwagala kwaffe, wadde nga kwa maanyi, tekuyinza kulinnya waggulu kutuuka ku bulungi obw’ensusso obw’ebintu ebyo. Tukiraba mu bajulizi abaafiirira okukkiriza: okuyigiriza okuwooma okwa Kristo bwe kwamala okuwamba emitima gyabwe, tekwasobola kugiggibwamu nate olw’okubonyaabonyezebwa kwonna obukambwe kwe bwasobola okuyiiya. Kristo bw’amala okuwamba okwagala, tewali amujjamu nate. Omuliro ogw’omu mutima guwangula emiriro gyonna egy’ebweru.

3. Era amagezi gatuyigiriza obunafu bwaffe gye buli, n’amaanyi g’omulabe waffe gye gali, ne kituleetera okutya okw’obuggya okutukuuma: kubanga olw’obuggya buno obw’okutya Katonda tukuuma ebisikiriza ebikola era ebikozesa amaanyi nga biri wala n’ekyo ekiri mu ffe ekikkiriza era ekikwata amangu, nga bwe tukuuma omuliro nga guli wala n’obuwunga bw’emmundu. Abo abaagala okuziyiza okuzaalibwa kw’ebiwuka ebyonoona, basooka kuziyiza kuzaala, nga baawula ekisajja n’ekikazi. Obuggya buno bujja kweyongera nnyo nga twetegereza n’obwegendereza ekiyambye oba ekiziyizza embeera ey’ekisa mu ffe: era bujja kutuleetera okwegendereza obutateesa na mubiri n’omusaayi mu ffe ffekka oba mu balala. Kale tuyinza tutya okulowooza nti Kristo alitukulembera okutuuka ku buwanguzi, nga tuteesa n’abalabe be era abalabe baffe.

4. Era Kristo atufuula abegendereza okukozesa amakubo gonna agayinza okuzuukusa n’okukuuma mu ffe ebirowoozo n’okwagala ebiggya; Kristo assa nnyo ekitiibwa mu kukozesa amakubo, ne mu kufaayo kw’atuteekamu, n’atuuka n’okugamba nti okukuumibwa n’obuwanguzi biva ku kufaayo kwaffe okw’okwekuuma. Oyo azaalibwa Katonda yeekuuma (1 Yokaana 5:18); naye si ku bubwe, wabula ku bwa Mukama, ng’amwesigama mu kukozesa amakubo. Tetuba mu mirembe okusinga nga bwe tuli ab’amagezi okwetwala eri buli kakisa akalungi ak’okumanyagana n’abalala, n’ebirala. Bwe tuva mu makubo ga Katonda tuva mu bufuzi bwe, bwe tutyo ne tufiirwa embeera yaffe ennungi, ne twesanga mangu ddala nga tubikkiddwa embeera endala ekontana nayo. Bwe tusemberera Kristo (Yakobo 4:8) mu ebyo by’ateekawo, naye atusemberera.

5. Kuuma ekisa nga kikola: si mpisa ezeebase, .

wabula ekisa ekikola kye kitukuuma. Emmeeme bw’eba mu mulimu ogumu ogw’ensi oba ogwa Katonda, obwonoonefu obuli mu ffe bunyigirizibwa nnyo, n’amakubo ga Setaani ne gaggalwa, n’Omwoyo n’afuna ekkubo eggule okwegaziya mu ffe, era n’ekibinja kya bamalayika abatukuuma kiba kitusemberedde nnyo mu kiseera ekyo; era engeri eyo etera okusinga okuwangula abalabe baffe ab’omwoyo okusinga okubalwanyisa obutereevu. Kiri ku kitiibwa kya Kristo okukuuma abo abali mu mulimu gwe.

Eky’omukaaga, mu biragiro byonna tulina okutunuulira Kristo, omwoyo oguwa obulamu, era ne tumalirira mu maanyi ge: wadde nga tukubirizibwa, nga bwe kyawandiikibwa, banywerere ku Mukama n’emitima gyabwe gyonna (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 11:23), naye tulina okusaba nga Dawudi: Ayi Mukama, kikuumire emirembe gyonna mu birowoozo by’emitima gyaffe, era oteekereteekere emitima gyaffe gy’oli (1 Ebyomumirembe 29:13): emitima gyaffe ku bwagyo gisagaasagana nnyo era tegitebenkera; Ayi Mukama, gatta emitima gyaffe gy’oli tutyenga erinnya lyo (Zabbuli 86:11); oba si ekyo, awatali ye, ebigendererwa byaffe ebisinga obulungi bijja kugwa wansi. Kye kisaba ekisanyusa, olw’okwagala Katonda, okumwegayirira atuwe embeera y’emmeeme eyo gy’ayinza okusanyukira; kale mu kukozesa amakubo gonna, tulina okutuma mu ggulu okwegomba kwaffe n’okwemulugunya kwaffe, eri ye, atuwe amaanyi n’obuyambi, olwo tuyinza okukakasa nti alireeta obwenkanya ne buwangula.

Eky’enkomerero, kiyamba embeera y’emmeeme okumanya embeera gy’esaanidde okubaamu, tulyoke tusengeke emmeeme zaffe bwe kityo; tusaanidde okubeeranga bulijjo nga tusaanira okukolagana ne Katonda, n’okuba n’ebirowoozo eby’omu ggulu nga tuli mu mirimu gy’ensi, n’okukkiriza okugiggibwako, tufune ebiseera olw’ebintu ebisingako; tusaanidde okubeera nga twetegese buli kiseera okuva wano, n’okubeera mu mbeera ey’engeri gye twandisiimye okufiiramu: tusaanidde okuba n’emitima egyetegekedde buli buvunaanyizibwa obulungi, egiggule eri buli kakisa akalungi, era egiggaddwa eri buli kukemebwa, nga tuli bulindaala era nga bulijjo tukutte ebyokulwanyisa: nga bwe tukoma obutatuuka ku bintu bino, bwe tutyo bwe tubeera n’ensonga entuufu okwetoowaza, naye ne tweyongera mu maaso tulyoke tweyongere okwefuga, n’okufuula ebintu bino ebimanyiddwa era ebyagalwa gye tuli; era bwe tusanga emmeeme zaffe nga zigwa wansi mu ngeri yonna, kye kisinga obulungi okuziyimusa amangu ago n’okufumiitiriza okuzuukusa; nga ku kubeerawo kwa Katonda, ku kubalirira okukakali kwe tugenda okukola, ku kwagala kwa Katonda okutaliiko kkomo mu Kristo n’ebibala byakwo, ku bulungi obw’ensusso obw’okuyitibwa kw’Omukristaayo, ku biseera ebitono era ebitali bikakafu eby’obulamu buno: ebintu byonna ebyo ebibba emitima gyaffe nga bwe binaatugasa ekitono ennyo mu bbanga ttono; era nga bwe kiriba naffe emirembe gyonna oluvannyuma, nga bwe tukozesa ekiseera kino ekitono obulungi oba obubi, n’ebirala. gye tukoma okuwa ebirowoozo ng’ebyo ekkubo okukka mu mitima gyaffe, gye tukoma okusemberera embeera y’emmeeme gye tulinyumirwa mu ggulu. Bwe tufuuka abatafaayo kukuuma mmeeme zaffe, Katonda azzaawo okuwoomerwa kwaffe okw’ebintu ebirungi ng’ayita mu bizibu eby’obulumi; bwe batyo Dawudi, Sulemaani, Samusooni, n’abalala, bwe baazzibwawo: kyangu nnyo okukuuma okusinga okuzzaawo.

Naye wadde nga nfuba, ndabika ng’eyalemera mu kifo kimu.

Ekisa, ng’ensigo mu lugero, kikula, nga tetumanyi bwe kikula, naye ku nkomerero Katonda bw’alaba nga kye kiseera ekisinga okusaanira, tujja kulaba nti okufuba kwaffe kwonna tekwabadde kwa bwereere; omuti gugwa ku kutema okusembayo, naye okutema kwonna okwasooka kuguyambako okugwa.

Oluusi obuwanguzi bulwawo kubanga Akani omu tannazuulibwa (Abalamuzi 20:26); oba kubanga tetunneetoowaza kimala, nga Isirayiri bwe yawangulwanga ab’e Benyamini okutuusa lwe baasiiba ne basaba; oba kubanga tulyamu olukwe abatuyamba, ne tutayimirira bulindaala, ne tutagondera mangu ago okusikirizibwa kw’Omwoyo, atujjukiza bulijjo ebintu ebisinga obulungi, singa twakufaako. Omuntu waffe ow’omunda ajja kututegeeza, bwe tumuganya okwogera, nti okwekwatirwa ekisa mu kibi kwe kuli ensonga. Ekkubo ery’okuwangula mu mbeera eno kwe kuba, 1. Okuwangula amalala g’obutonde bwaffe, nga tweswaza ffekka, mu kwatula okw’obwetoowaze eri Katonda; olwo, 2. Okuwangula obutakkiriza bw’emitima gyaffe, nga tukkiriza ekisuubizo ky’okusonyiyibwa; olwo, 3. Nga twesiga obuyambi bwa Kristo, okwolekera ebibi ebyo ebituwangudde; olwo bwe tunaawangula ffe ffennyini tujja kuwangula mangu abalabe baffe bonna; era tuwangule embeera zonna ze tuliyisibwamu.

fields.title: Bonna basaanidde okubeera ku ludda lwa Kristo
fields.body_html:
OBANGA Kristo aliwangula, kale kye kisinga obulungi amawanga n’obwakabaka okwaniriza Omwana (Zabbuli 2), n’okwaniriza Kristo n’eddiini ye; okubeera ku ludda lwa Kristo, n’okwetwala ensonga ye mu nsi ng’eyaabwe, kubanga oludda lwe lwe lulisinga amaanyi ku nkomerero; tuli ba mukisa singa Kristo atuwa ekitiibwa ekyenkanidde awo, okukozesa obuyambi bwaffe okulwana olutalo lwe ng’alwanyisa ab’amaanyi (Abalamuzi 5:23). Eddiini ey’amazima mu ggwanga eri ng’empagi enkulu ey’ennyumba, era ng’omugogo gw’eweema ogunyweza byonna: 2. Bwe kityo ne ku maka, Kristo abeere omufuzi omukulu ow’amaka: era, 3. Buli muntu abeere ng’ennyumba ya Kristo mw’abeera ng’ali waka era mw’afugira; Kristo w’ali, essanyu lyonna liteekwa okugoberera. Kristo bw’agenda, byonna bigenda; obufuzi bwa Kristo mu ebyo by’ateekawo ne mu Mwoyo we we buli, obufuzi obulala bwonna obuli wansi wabwo we bukulaakulanira: eddiini efuuwa obulamu n’ekisa mu mpisa endala zonna ennungi, awatali yo zibeera ng’ekifaananyi ekirungi ekitaliiko mutwe. Amateeka ga Kristo we gawandiikibwa mu mutima, amateeka amalala gonna amalungi we gasinga okugonderwa; tewali anyooma mateeka ga muntu okuggyako abo abasooka okunyooma aga Kristo. Mu bantu bonna, omuntu akulemberwa Kristo y’asinga obulungi; era mu bitonde byonna mu nsi, omuntu akulemberwa okwagala kwe n’okwegomba kwe, oluvannyuma lw’Omulyolyomi, y’asinga obubi. Essanyu ly’ebintu ebinafu liri mu kufugibwa ebisinga amaanyi: kisinga obulungi omuzibe w’amaaso okukulemberwa oyo alaba; kisinga obulungi endiga, n’ebitonde ebirala ebiteesobola, okukulemberwa omuntu; era kisinga essanyu omuntu okukulemberwa Kristo, kubanga obufuzi bwe buwangula nnyo, ne butuwonya okutya n’akabi k’abalabe baffe abasinga obukambwe, era bututuusa ku ssanyu erisinga obunene obutonde bwaffe lye busobola okufuna. Kino kisaanidde okutusanyusa Kristo bw’afugira mu ffe. Sulemaani bwe yatikkirwa engule, abantu ne baleekaana, ettaka ne livuga; ate ffe tusaanidde okusingawo okusanyukira mu Kristo kabaka waffe.

Era n’eri abo emmeeme zaabwe ze twagala ennyo, okufuba kwaffe kubeere nti Kristo afuge ne mu bo; babatizibwe Kristo n’omuliro; obusasi buno bukumibwe mu bo (Matayo 3:11). Abantu bafuba okulabirira omwoyo n’obuvumu, nga bwe babiyita, eby’abo be bakuza, kubanga balowooza nti binaabagasa mu nsonga n’ebizibu ebingi eby’obulamu buno. Woowe, naye ka tulabirire obusasi bw’ekisa mu bo: kubanga omwoyo ogw’obutonde gujja kulemererwa mu bizibu ebinene, naye obusasi buno bujja kubafuula abawanguzi ku bibi ebisinga obunene.

Obanga obwenkanya bwa Kristo buliwangula, kale eddiini ya Paapa, olw’okuba ensengeka ekontana nabwo, eyateekebwawo amagezi g’omuntu okukuuma obugayaavu obw’ekitiibwa, eteekwa okugwa. Era yamala dda okugwa mu mitima gy’abo Kristo be yayakira. Bulimba, era yazimbibwa ku bulimba, ku kusalawo okutasobya okw’omuntu ayinza okukola ekibi n’okusobya, Ekyo ekitwalibwa ng’omusingi gw’amazima bwe kifuuka omusingi gw’ensobi, gye tukoma okukyesigamako, gye tukoma okuba mu kabi.

fields.title: Obufuzi bwa Kristo buliwangula mu lwatu
fields.body_html:
SI kwogerwa kwokka nti obwenkanya buliwangula, wabula nti Kristo alibureeta mu lwatu ne buwangula. Kino we tukiraba nti ekisa kirifuuka ekitiibwa, ne kirabibwa amaaso ga bonna. Kaakano Kristo awangula, era atuuka ku bigendererwa bye, naye mu ngeri emu tekirabika: abalabe be ab’omunda n’ab’ebweru waffe balabika ng’abasinga. Naye alireeta obwenkanya ne buwangula, nga bonna balaba. Ababi kaakano abazibiriza amaaso gaabwe balikiraba ne kibabonyaabonya. Tekiriba mu buyinza bw’abantu ab’enkwe okulaba oba obutalaba kye baagala; Kristo aliba n’obuyinza ku mitima gyabwe; era ng’obusungu bwe bwe bulikwata emmeeme zaabwe amangu ddala nga tebaagala, bw’atyo bw’aliba n’obuyinza ku maaso g’emmeeme zaabwe, okulaba n’okumanya ebyo ebirieyongera okubanakuwaza; ennaku eriba enywezeddwa ku ngeri zaabwe zonna ez’okuwulira, n’okuwulira kwabwe ku nnaku.

Olwo ebisiigo byonna eby’obulimba bye basiiga ku bintu birisangulibwa. Abantu baagala okutwalibwa ng’abalungi, naye ate nga baagala obuwoomi bw’ekibi; tewali kye bawakanya n’omutima gwabwe gwonna okusinga amazima ago agababikkula eri bo bennyini n’eri amaaso g’abalala; okufaayo kwabwe okukulu nga kwe kumanya engeri y’okwesiigasiiga mu maaso g’ensi n’ag’emitima gyabwe. Naye ekiseera kirijja lwe baligobwa mu lusuku luno olwa basirusiru, era gye bakoma okuba ab’enkwe mu ngeri gye baakwekangamu ebintu, gye balikoma okuswala. Kristo, Katonda gwe yalonda okulaga ekitiibwa ekisingayo eky’obulungi bwe obw’ensusso, kaakano abikkiddwa olw’omubiri gwe, ekkanisa, naye ajja mangu okugulumizibwa mu batukuvu be (2 Abasessaloniika 1:10), era talifiirwa kulabisibwa kutangaavu kwa kintu kyonna ku bimwogerwako; era alirangirira eri ensi yonna ky’ali, lwe watalibaawo kitiibwa kirala okuggyako ekya Kristo n’omugole we. Abo kaakano abali ng’olutambi olunyooka, olwo balyakaayakana ng’enjuba mu bbanga (Matayo 13:43), n’obutuukirivu bwabwe bwakaayakane ng’enjuba ey’omu ttuntu (Zabbuli 37:6). Ekifaananyi kya Katonda mu Adamu kyalimu ekitiibwa eky’obuyinza, ebitonde byonna ne bimussaamu ekitiibwa; ate ekifaananyi kya Katonda mu bujjuvu bwakyo kirisinga nnyo okuwaliriza bonna okukissaamu ekitiibwa. Ne kaakano waliwo okutya okw’ekyama okuteekebwa mu mitima gy’abo abasinga obukulu, eri abo be balabamu ekisa nga kyakaayakana, era kyekyava Kerode atya Yokaana Omubatiza; naye kiriba kitya ku lunaku lwabwe olw’okubaleeta mu lwatu, oluyitibwa olunaku abaana ba Katonda lwe baliragibwa? (Abaruumi 8:19). Waliba ebiseera ebisingako ekitiibwa, obwakabaka bw’ensi lwe bulifuuka obwa Mukama Yesu Kristo (Okubikkulirwa 11:15), era alifuga emirembe gyonna; olwo obwenkanya n’amazima biriwangula; olwo Kristo aliwolereza ensonga ye yennyini; amazima tegakyayitibwa bukyamu na kwawukana, so n’obukyamu tebukyayitibwa kuyigiriza kwa Kkanisa ey’awamu; obubi tebukyatambula nga bwekwese era nga bwefudde; obulungi bulirabika mu kumasamasa kwabwo, ne bwakaayakana mu bitangaala byabwo; ebintu biriba nga bwe biri, tewali kyakwekebwa ekitalizuulibwa (Matayo 10:26); obutali butuukirivu tebukyatambulira mu kyama; abakumpanya ab’amaanyi, abalowooza okukweka enteekateeka zaabwe eri Mukama, tebakyatambula nga tebalabika ng’abali mu bire, Nga Kristo bw’atalizikiza kasasi na kamu ke yakuma yennyini, bw’atyo bw’alizikiza ennimi z’omuliro ezisinga okumasamasa ez’endabika ennungi ezitava waggulu.

Singa kino kyakkirizibwa, abantu bandisaddeyo nnyo omwoyo ku bwesimbu, obwo bwokka obunaatuwa obuvumu, ne batanoonya bibikka nsonyi; kubanga okubyesiga, nga bwe kufuula abantu kaakano ab’amalala okusingawo, bwe kutyo bwe kulibaanika oluvannyuma eri ensonyi ezisingako.

Obanga obwenkanya bulireetebwa ne buwangula, kale abo abafugibwanga emitima gyabwe egy’obukuusa, n’omwoyo ogw’obukyamu, balireetebwa mu lwatu ne baswala: Katonda oyo eyagatta ekisa n’amazima n’ekitiibwa, yagatta ekibi n’ensonyi ku nkomerero; amagezi gonna n’amaanyi gonna eg’omuntu tegaliyinza kwawukanya Katonda kye yagatta. Amazima n’okutya Katonda biyinza okulinnyirirwa okumala akaseera, naye ng’abajulirwa ababiri (Okubikkulirwa 11:11), oluvannyuma lw’okuttibwa, bwe baazuukira ne bayimirira; bwe kityo buli kintu ekiva eri Katonda kirinywera ku musingi gwakyo kyokka ku nkomerero. Waliba okuzuukira si kwa mibiri kwokka, wabula n’okw’erinnya ery’ekitiibwa. Tuyinza okulowooza nti oyo eyasuula bamalayika okuva mu ggulu aliganya enfuufu n’emmere y’ebiwuka okutambulira mu kkubo ekyuuse, n’okugenda nga bwe bawangula bulijjo bwe batyo? Nedda; nga Kristo bw’ali ddala Kabaka wa Bakabaka era Mukama wa bakama (Okubikkulirwa 19:16), bw’atyo bw’alibetenta ebitundu byonna eby’ettaka ebimwegolokokerako ng’entamu y’omubumbi (Zabbuli 2:9). Ani eyali amuwakanyizza n’avaayo nga taliiko binuubule? (Yobu 9:4); Nedda, awatali kubuusabuusa obusungu bw’omuntu bulifuuka ettendo lya Kristo. (Zabbuli 76:10). Ekyayogerwa ku Falaawo kiryogerwa ku balabe bonna ab’emputtu, abaagala okufiirwa emmeeme zaabwe okusinga okufiirwa ebyo bye baagala, nti baayimusibwa bwe batyo Kristo yeefunire ekitiibwa mu kuswazibwa kwabwe.

Kale, ka twegendereze tuleme okugoberera amakubo g’abantu abo, enkomerero yaabwe gye tulikankana nayo: tewali musango gwa ntiisa gusinga okugwa ku butonde bw’omuntu, okusinga okuweebwayo eri okusalawo okwonoonefu ku bantu ne ku bintu, kubanga kugwa wansi w’ekikolimo kino: Zibasanze abo abayita ekibi ekirungi n’ekirungi ekibi (Isaaya 5:20).

Baliba batya nga bazitoowereddwa ebikolimo ku lunaku olulala, abo abonoona okusalawo kw’abalala olw’obukujjukujju bw’ebigambo n’olw’okuwaanawaana, nga babuzaabuza, era nga nabo babuzaabuzibwa? Olwo okwemulugunya kwa nnyaffe eyasooka Kaawa kulitandikibwawo, naye nga tekuliiko kye kugasa (Olubereberye 3:13); Omusota gwe gunsenzesenze: Setaani mu gundi ne gundi ansenzesenze; ekibi kinsenzesenze; omutima omusirusiru gunsenzesenze. Kye kimu ku bintu ebisinga obugezi okulowooza ku misingi kwe tuteeka emmeeme zaffe mu kabi. Baliba bantu ba mukisa, abo abalina, olw’ekitangaala kya Kristo, okusalawo okutuufu ku bintu, ne bakkiriza okusalawo okwo okufuga emitima gyabwe.

Emmeeme z’abantu abasinga obungi zibbidde mu biwulizo byabwe, era zitwalibwa endowooza ennafu, ezisibuka mu nsobi z’abantu ab’awamu ne mu bisiikirize by’ebintu. Era Setaani yeetegefu okugaziya ekifaananyi ky’ebirungi eby’ebweru n’ebibi eby’ebweru, n’abifuula binene okusinga bwe biri, n’ebintu eby’omwoyo n’abifuula bitono, ng’abiraga ng’ayita mu ndabirwamu ez’obulimba. Bwe batyo abantu, nga beesiga ebitaliimu, beewangula bokka mu ndowooza zaabwe. Embeera ya nnaku, ffe n’ekyo kye tutwala ng’eky’omuwendo ennyo bwe tulibula awamu, ekyo ekiribaawo ddala nga obwenkanya bwa Kristo bwe bulituuka ku buwanguzi; era omutima gw’omuntu ogutaliimu nga bwe gwagaziyizibwa, okulowooza nti mu bintu by’ensi eno mulimu obulungi bungi okusinga bwe buli, mu kigero ekyo kyennyini emmeeme mw’erigaziyizibwa okuwulira ennyo ennaku bw’eriraba ensobi yaayo. Eno y’enjawulo wakati w’omuntu ow’amagezi atya Katonda, n’omuntu w’ensi abuzaabuziddwa; ekyo omu ky’asalawo kaakano nti tekiriimu, omulala alikiwulira nti bwe kiri ng’ekiseera kiyise. Naye buno bwe butaliimu bw’obutonde bwaffe, nti wadde nga twewala okusinga byonna okulimbibwa n’okusobya mu bintu ebya kaakano, naye mu nsonga ezisinga obukulu tweyagalira obutamanya n’okubuzibwa.

fields.title: Kristo yekka y’akulaakulanya obufuzi buno
fields.body_html:
EKISALIBWAWO eky’okutaano kye kino, nti obufuzi buno buteekebwawo era bukulaakulanyizibwa Kristo yekka; ye aleeta obwenkanya ne buwangula. Tulwana era tuwangula mu buyinza obw’amaanyi ge (Abaefeso 6:10); tuwangula olw’Omwoyo eyafunibwa olw’omusaayi gw’Omwana gw’Endiga (Okubikkulirwa 12:11).

Ye yekka atendeka emikono gyaffe okulwana, era ateekerateekera engalo zaffe olutalo (Zabbuli 144:1), Obutonde, nga bwonooneddwa, buwagira okubeerawo kwabwo, era bujja kwekuuma nga buwakanya obufuzi bwa Kristo. Obutonde, nga butunuuliddwa bwokka, tebuyinza kwesitula waggulu wa bwo okutuuka ku bikolwa eby’omwoyo eby’omutindo n’engeri ey’awaggulu; kale amaanyi aga Katonda aga Kristo geetaagibwa okututwala waggulu w’amaanyi gaffe gonna, naddala mu buvunaanyizibwa mwe tusanga okuziyizibwa okusingako; kubanga eyo si butonde bwokka bwe bulitulemerera, wabula n’ekisa ekya bulijjo, okuggyako nga waliwo okugabirwa okw’amaanyi era okuggya. Mu kusitula omugugu ogusinga obuzito obwa bulijjo, singa amaanyi tegasinga buzito, oyo agusitula aligwa wansi waagwo: bwe kityo eri buli kulumbibwa okw’amaanyi walina okubaawo okugabirwa amaanyi amaggya; nga mu Peetero (Matayo 26:69), bwe yalumbibwa okukemebwa okusinga amaanyi, nga tawaniriddwa era tanyweezeddwa mukono ogusinga amaanyi, wadde nga yalina amaanyi ag’edda, yagwa bubi nnyo. Era bwe tumala okugwa, mu kuyimusibwa kwaffe nate Kristo y’alina okukola omulimu, 1. Ng’aggyawo; oba 2, Ng’anafuya; oba 3. Ng’ayimiriza ebiziyiza ebiwakanya; 4. Era ng’ayongera amaanyi g’ekisa kye mu ffe, okusinga bwe twali nga tetunnagwa; kale bwe tugwa, ne tufuna okubetentebwa olw’okugwa, ka tugende eri Kristo amangu ago atusibe nate.

Kale ka tumanye nti kya kabi okunoonya mu ffe ffekka ekyo kye tuteekwa okufuna okuva eri Kristo. Okuva ku kugwa, amaanyi gaffe gonna gali mu ye, nga aga Samusooni bwe gaali mu nviiri ze (Abalamuzi 16:17); tuli bakozi abali wansi, abatambula nga bwe tutambuzibwa, era abakola nga bwe tusooka okukolebwako, ab’eddembe mu kigero kye tuweereddwamu eddembe, nga tetuli ba magezi oba ba maanyi okusinga bw’atufuula kaakano mu buli kye tukola. Omwoyo we y’akozesa, era y’azzaamu obulamu, era y’assa mu nkola okumanya n’amaanyi bye tulina, oba si ekyo biremererwa ne bibeera ebitaliiko mugaso mu ffe; tukola nga tukolera ku maanyi ag’akaseera ako; kale emyoyo egyesigama ku ye gye gisinga amagezi era gye gisinga obusobozi. Tewali kisinga maanyi okusinga obwetoowaze, obuva mu bwo bwokka; oba ekisinga obunafu okusinga amalala, agesigama ku musingi gwago gwokka: era kino kisaanidde okwetegerezebwa ennyo, kubanga mu butonde tweyagaliza ekika ky’obwakatonda, nga tutandika ebikolwa mu maanyi g’obusobozi bwaffe; so nga Kristo agamba (ng’ayogera n’abatume abali mu mbeera y’ekisa): awatali Nze temuliiko kye muyinza kukola (Yokaana 15:5): tagamba nti musobola okukola akatono, wabula nti tewali kye musobola: ku bwaffe, nga tuwangulwa mangu nnyo? nga tuli banafu nnyo okuziyiza? tuli ng’emimuli eginyeenyezebwa buli mpewo; tukankana olw’oluyoogaano n’ebirowoozo byokka eby’obwavu, eby’obuswavu, eby’okufiirwa, n’ebirala. tugonda amangu ago, tetulina buyinza ku maaso gaffe, ku nnimi zaffe, ku birowoozo byaffe, ku kwagala kwaffe, wabula tuleka ekibi okuyingira n’okufuluma. Tuwangulwa ekibi mangu nnyo? so nga twandiwangudde ekibi nga tukola obulungi. Ebigendererwa ebirungi bimeka ebisibira mu kuzaalibwa, ne bitaba na maanyi kuvaayo? ebyo byonna biraga nti tetuli kintu awatali Mwoyo wa Kristo. Tulaba abatume bennyini bwe baali abanafu, okutuusa lwe baambazibwa amaanyi agava mu ggulu (Matayo 26:69): Peetero yagwa olw’ebigambo by’omuwala, naye oluvannyuma lw’Omwoyo wa Kristo okubakkako, gye baakoma okubonaabona, gye baakoma okuguma okubonaabona: okubudaabudibwa kwabwe kwakula wamu n’ebizibu byabwe; kale mu byonna, naddala mu kulumbibwa okuzibu, ka tuyimuse emitima gyaffe eri Kristo, alina Omwoyo atumala ffenna, mu bwetaavu bwaffe bwonna; era twogere nga Yekosafaati omulungi: Ayi Mukama, Tetumanyi kya kukola, wabula amaaso gaffe gatunuulidde ggwe (2 Ebyomumirembe 20:12): olutalo lwe tulwana lwo, n’amaanyi ge tulwanisa gateekwa okuba gago. Bw’otogenda naffe, tukakasa nti tuliwangulwa. Setaani amanyi nti tewali kiyinza kuwangula Kristo, oba abo abeesiga obuyinza bwe; kale okufuba kwe kuli, engeri y’okutukuumira mu ffe ffekka, ne mu bitonde: naye tulina okukwatanga kino bulijjo mu birowoozo byaffe, nti ekyo ekitandikibwa mu kwekakasa kujja kukoma mu nsonyi.

Engeri Kristo gy’aleetamu obwenkanya ne buwangula, kwe kutulaga obwetaavu bw’okwesigama ku ye: eyo gye kuva okulekebwa mu by’omwoyo, mw’atera okutulekera ffekka, mu kisa ne mu kubudaabudibwa, tulyoke tumanye nti ensulo y’ebyo eri wabweru waffe. Kyekiva ku lusozi, kwe kugamba, mu kunyigirizibwa okw’enkomeredde, Katonda w’asinga okulabika (Olubereberye 22:13). Kyekiva tulokolebwa olw’ekisa ky’okukkiriza, ekitutwala wabweru waffe okwesiga omulala; era nti okukkiriza kukola bulungi nnyo nga kuli kwokka, nga kulina obuwagizi obw’ebweru obusinga obutono. Kyekiva tutera okulemererwa mu ntalo entono, ne tunywerera mu nnene, kubanga mu ntono twesiga nnyo ffe ffennyini, mu nnene ne tuddukira ku lwazi lw’obulokozi bwaffe, olusinga ffe obugulumivu. Era kyekiva tubeera ba maanyi oluvannyuma lw’okuwangulwa, kubanga obwonoonefu obukwese obwali butalabika edda, kaakano buzuuliddwa, era bwe tutyo ne tuleetebwa okukozesa okusaasira okusonyiwa n’amaanyi agawanirira. Ensonga enkulu ey’enteekateeka eno, kwe kumanya nti Kristo y’atuwa byombi okwagala n’okukola, era nga mulimu gw’akola ku bubwe ng’asiima yekka. Kale tusaanidde okukola ebiraga obulokozi bwaffe mu kutya okw’obuggya ne mu kukankana (Abafiripi 2:12), tuleme okumuwa ensonga ey’okuyimiriza amaanyi ge ag’ekisa, n’okutulekera mu kizikiza ky’omutima gwaffe, olw’okutambula awatali kussaamu kitiibwa era n’amalala.

Abo abali wansi w’obufuzi bwa Kristo balina omwoyo ogw’okubikkulirwa, mwe balabira era mwe bawulirira amaanyi aga Katonda nga gabasobozesa mu ngeri ewooma era ey’amaanyi okukuuma okukkiriza, nga bawulira ebikontana nakwo, n’essuubi mu mbeera etaliimu ssuubi, n’okwagala Katonda wansi w’obubonero bw’obusungu bwe, n’ebirowoozo eby’omu ggulu wakati mu nsonga z’ensi n’ebisikiriza ebisika mu kkubo erikontana: bawulira amaanyi agakuuma okugumiikiriza, wabula n’essanyu wakati mu nsonga ez’okukungubaga, emirembe egy’omunda wakati mu kulumbibwa. Kiva wa nti bwe tulumbibwa okukemebwa, ne bwe tuzingizibwa ebizibu, tunywedde, okuggyako ku maanyi ag’ekyama agatuwanirira? Okufuula ekisa ekitono bwe kityo okuwangula obungi obunene bwe butyo obw’obwonoonefu, kino kyetaaga omwoyo ogusinga ogw’omuntu; kino kiri ng’okukuuma omuliro mu nnyanja, n’ekitundu ky’eggulu nga mu ggeyeena. Wano we tumanyira gye tunaggya amaanyi gano, n’oyo gwe tunaazzaako ettendo lyago. Era lye ssanyu lyaffe, nti gakwekeddwa bulungi bwe gatyo mu Kristo ku lwaffe, mu oyo ali okumpi bwe kityo ne Katonda era naffe. Okuva ku kugwa, Katonda tatukwasa bulokozi bwaffe, wabula bwagulibwa era bukuumibwa Kristo ku lwaffe, naffe ne tukuumibwa ku lwabwo olw’okukkiriza, okukolebwa amaanyi ga Katonda, era okukwata ku maanyi ago gennyini: amaanyi ago Pawulo Omutukuvu g’ayogerako mu ngeri ey’ekitiibwa, 1. Nti maanyi manene; 2. Maanyi agasukkiridde; 3. Maanyi agakola era ag’obuyinza; 4. Maanyi ng’ago agaakola mu kuzuukiza Kristo mu bafu (Abaefeso 1:19). Ekisa ekiri ekiweebwayo ekisendasenda bwokka, era nga kiri mu kwagala kwaffe okukyaniriza oba okukigaana, si kye kisa ekitutuusa mu ggulu; naye abantu ba Katonda bawulira omulimu gw’Omwoyo ogw’amaanyi, ogutabikkulira bubikkulizi nnaku yaffe, n’okununulibwa okuyita mu Kristo, wabula ogutuggyamu ffe ffennyini, nga bwe twanunulibwa okuva ku ffe ffennyini, era ne gussa obulamu obuggya mu ffe, era oluvannyuma ne gutunyweza, era ne gutuzzaamu obulamu bwe tuwotoka ne tussa ebiwaawaatiro wansi, era nga tegutuleka okutuusa ku buwanguzi obujjuvu.

fields.title: Obuwanguzi tebufunika awatali kulwana
fields.body_html:
EKISALIBWAWO eky’omukaaga kye kino, nti obufuzi buno obuwangula tebuliba awatali kulwana; tewayinza kubaawo buwanguzi awatali lutalo; mu Isaaya kyogerwa nti, mu bwesigwa alireeta obwenkanya (Isaaya 42:3); wano kyogerwa nti, alisindika obwenkanya ne buwangula. Ekigambo alisindika kirina amakulu ag’amaanyi mu lulimi olwasooka, okusindika n’amaanyi; okulaga nti obufuzi bwe we buli mu mazima, bujja kuwakanyizibwa, okutuusa lw’alisinga. Tewali kiwakanyizibwa nga Kristo n’obufuzi bwe, mu ffe ne wabweru waffe. Era mu ffe kisinga mu kukyuka kwaffe okusooka; wadde ng’obwonoonefu tebuwangula kutuuka ku kufuula omulimu ogw’amaanyi ogw’ekisa ogw’obwereere, naye tewaba busobozi bwokka obw’okuwakanya, wabula n’okwagala okuwakanya, era si kwagala kwokka, wabula n’okuziyiza ddala omulimu gw’Omwoyo wa Kristo, era ekyo mu buli kikolwa, naye nga tewali kuziyiza kuwangula okutuuka ku kufuula omulimu gw’ekisa ogw’obwereere, wabula obwonoonefu ku nkomerero bugondera ekisa.

Waliwo okulafuubana kungi, okuleeta Kristo mu mutima, n’okumuteekerawo entebe ey’okusalirako emisango eyo, waliwo eggye ly’okwegomba okubi erimujeemera. Amaanyi agasingayo ag’okufuba n’obusobozi bw’abantu abasinga obungi gali mu kuziyiza Kristo okufuga mu mmeeme, omubiri gukyafuba okukuuma obufuzi bwagwo, era kyeguva gussa wansi ekitiibwa kya buli ekyo ekigukontana nakyo, ng’ebyo ebirungi Katonda by’ateekawo, n’ebirala. era ne gutwala nga kya muwendo nnyo buli kintu, ne bwe kiba nga kifu era nga kyereere, singa kiwa eddembe ery’omubiri ekkubo.

So tekyewuunyisa obufuzi bwa Kristo obw’omwoyo okuwakanyizibwa bwe butyo; 1. Kubanga bufuzi, era obufuzi bukoma ku kkubo ly’okwagala kw’omuntu, ne bussa ekisiba ku kubungeeta kwakwo; buli kintu eky’obutonde kiziyiza ekyo ekikiwakanya; bwe kityo okwagala okwonoonefu kufuba okumenyawo amateeka gonna, era kutwala nga kya kitiibwa obutatya, era nga kabonero ka mwoyo mutono okutya omuntu yenna, ne Katonda yennyini, okutuusa akabi akatayinza kwewalika lwe kakwata abantu, olwo abo abaatya ekitono ennyo nga tebali mu kabi ne batya nnyo nga bali mu kabi, nga bwe tulaba ku Berusazza (Danyeri 5:6).

2. Bufuzi bwa mwoyo, kale omubiri gukoma okubugumiikiriza: obufuzi bwa Kristo buleeta mu buwulize ebirowoozo n’okwegomba byennyini, ebiva mu mmeeme mu ngeri esinga okuba ey’okumpi era ey’eddembe; wadde ng’omuntu yandibadde n’empisa entebenkevu bwe zityo, obulamu bwe bwonna ne buba nga tebuliiko kumenya mateeka kulabika ebweru okunyiiza, naye eri Kristo, okuba n’endowooza ey’omubiri oba ey’ensi kwe kufa (Abaruumi 8:6); atunuulira endowooza ey’ensi n’okukyawa okusinga okw’omusango gwonna ogumu ogw’enjawulo.

Naye Omwoyo wa Kristo abeera mu abo abakyalina endowooza ey’ensi mu kigero ekimu.

Kya mazima, naye si ng’akkiriza era awagira, wabula ng’awakanya, ng’awangula, era ku nkomerero ng’omuwanguzi: abantu ab’omubiri bandyagadde okugatta Kristo n’omubiri, era bandisiimye okugondera Kristo nga basigazaawo ebimu; naye Kristo talibeera wa wansi wa kwegomba kwonna okwa wansi; era: kale omuntu w’aba nga yeekkiriza mu kwegomba kwonna okw’ekibi, kabonero nti ebisumuluzo tebyakwasibwa Kristo okutufuga.

3. Ate, obwenkanya buno buwakanyizibwa, kubanga busala omusango, n’abantu tebaagala kusalirwa musango n’okunenyezebwa. Kaakano Kristo, mu mazima ge, abawawaabira, abasalira omusango, era abasiba okutuusa ku musango ogw’oluvannyuma ogw’olunaku olukulu. Kale beetwalira okusalira omusango amazima ago ageetaagisa okubasalira omusango, naye amazima galibasinga; omuntu alina olunaku kaakano, Pawulo Omutukuvu lw’ayita olunaku lw’omuntu (1 Abakkolinso 4:3), mw’alinnyira ku ntebe ye, ne yeetwalira okusalira Kristo n’amakubo ge omusango; naye Katonda alina olunaku lw’aligololamu byonna, n’omusango gwe ne gunywera. Era abatukuvu balifuna ekiseera kyabwe, lwe balituula okusalira omusango abo ababasalira kaakano (1 Abakkolinso 6:2). Mu kiseera kino Kristo alifugira wakati mu balabe be, wakati ne mu mitima gyaffe (Zabbuli 110). Kale si kabonero ka mbeera nnungi okusanga byonna nga bisirise, nga tewali kikaayana: kubanga tuyinza okulowooza nti obwonoonefu, obwasooka mu ffe, ne Setaani omusajja ow’amaanyi, akuuma ebigo bingi mu ffe, balikkiriza okuva mu bintu mu mirembe? Nedda, tewali na kirowoozo kimu kya bulungi kizuulibwa ye, nga tegatta na bwonoonefu kukitta nga kizaalibwa. Era ng’obukambwe bwa Falaawo bwe bwali okusingira ddala eri abaana ab’obulenzi, bwe butyo obukyayi bwa Setaani bwolekera okusingira ddala ebimaliriziddwa ebisinga okutya Katonda era eby’obuzira.

Kale kino kye tusaanidde okusuubira bulijjo, nti buli Kristo w’ajja, walibaawo okuwakanyizibwa: Kristo bwe yazaalibwa Yerusaalemi yonna yeeraliikirira; bwe kityo Kristo bw’azaalibwa mu muntu yenna, emmeeme eba mu kasattiro, era byonna kubanga omutima tegwagala kwewaayo eri Kristo agufuge.

Buli Kristo w’ajja aleeta enjawukana, si 1. wakati w’omuntu ne ye yennyini yokka, wabula, 2. wakati w’omuntu n’omuntu, era, 3. wakati w’ekkanisa n’ekkanisa: okutabukatabuka okwo Kristo si y’akuleeta okusinga eddagala bwe liri ensonga y’okutawaanyizibwa mu mubiri omulwadde, amazzi amabi ag’omubiri mwe gali ensonga entuufu: kubanga ekigendererwa ky’eddagala gye mirembe gy’amazzi ag’omubiri. Naye Kristo alaba nga kirungi ebirowoozo by’emitima gy’abantu okubikkulwa, era ye alireetera bangi okugwa n’abalala ne bayimusibwa mu Isirayiri (Lukka 2:34).

Bwe kityo eddalu ery’okuggwamu essuubi ery’abantu libikkulibwa, nti baagala okubeera wansi w’obukulembeze bw’okwegomba kwabwe, era bwe kityo wansi wa Setaani yennyini, okutuuka ku kuzikirira kwabwe okutaggwaawo, okusinga okuteeka ebigere byabwe mu njegere za Kristo, n’ensingo zaabwe wansi w’ekikoligo kye; so nga mu mazima, okuweereza Kristo lye ddembe lyokka ery’amazima, ekikoligo kye kikoligo kyangu, omugugu gwe guli ng’omugugu gw’ebiwaawaatiro eri ekinyonyi, ogukifuula okubuuka waggulu ennyo. Obufuzi bwa Setaani buddu okusinga okuba obufuzi, Kristo mw’awaayo abo abasuula obufuzi bwe, kubanga olwo awa Setaani n’ababaka be obuyinza ku bo, kubanga tebaagala kwaniriza mazima mu kwagala (2 Abasessaloniika 2:10); mutwale, Omuyezwiti, mutwale, Setaani, muzibe amaaso era omusibe, omutwale mu kuzikirira. Abo abeetwalira eddembe erisingayo okukola ekibi be baddu abasingayo, kubanga be baddu abeeyagalidde ennyo; okwagala mu buli kintu kuba kusinga bulungi oba kusinga bubi, abantu gye bakoma okugenda mu maaso mu kkubo ery’obukakanyavu, gye bakoma okubbira mu bujeemu; era gye bakoma: okukontana ne Kristo, nga bakola bye baagala, gye balikoma lumu okubonaabona bye batayagala.

Mu kiseera kino baba basibe mu mmeeme zaabwe bennyini, nga basibiddwa mu mitima gyabwe okutuuka ku musango gw’oyo oluvannyuma lw’okufa, gwe bataakkiriza kubafuga mu bulamu bwabwe. Era si kya bwenkanya nti bamuwulire ng’omulamuzi omukakali okubasalira omusango, oyo gwe bataagala kuba mulamuzi omuteefu okubafuga ?

fields.title: Mugume, mweyongere mu maaso n’essanyu, nga mukakafu okuwangula
fields.body_html:
OKUMALIRIZA, n’okussa ku ffe ffennyini byonna bye twogedde. Tulaba embeera y’abantu ba Katonda: ey’olutalo, naye nga nkakafu era ya ssuubi. Obuwanguzi tebuli ku ffe, wabula buli ku Kristo, eyeetikka okuwangula ku lwaffe, era n’okuwangula mu ffe. Obuwanguzi tebuli mu maanyi gaffe okubufuna, wadde mu balabe baffe okubuziyiza. Singa bwali ku ffe, twandibadde n’ensonga okutya. Naye Kristo alinywereza obufuzi bwe mu ffe, era alitulwanirira ku bwonoonefu bwaffe ; bwe balabe be nga bwe bali abaffe. Kale tubenga n’amaanyi mu Mukama waffe ne mu buyinza obw’amaanyi ge (Abaefeso 6:10); tuleme okutunuulira ennyo abalabe baffe kye bali, wabula ani mulamuzi waffe era omukulembeze waffe; si kye batiisatiisa, wabula ky’asuubiza; abali ku ludda lwaffe bangi okusinga abatulwanyisa. Ani atya atandirwanye, ng’akakasa nti aliwangula? tewali n’omu wano awangulwa, okuggyako oyo atayagala kulwana. N’olwekyo, okuterebuka okubi bwe kutukwata, tuteeke omusango we gugwanira okuteekebwa.

Okuggwamu amaanyi okwava mu butakkiriza ne mu kwogera obubi ku nsi ennungi, okwaleetebwa abakessi, kwaleetera Katonda okulayira ng’asunguwadde nti, Tebaliyingira mu kiwummulo kye. Twegendereze, omwoyo ogw’okuterebuka oguva mu bizibu ebirabika obulabisi ne mu buswavu obusuulibwa ku makubo amalungi aga Katonda, guleme okusunguwaza Katonda n’atuggalira ebweru w’eggulu. Wano tulaba bye tusobola okusuubira okuva mu ggulu. Abaagalwa, kya ssanyu nnyo okutegeera Kristo mu ngeri entuufu, okumanya okwagala, okusaasira n’amaanyi ebyatuterekerwa mu kifuba kya Kristo. Nga bwe bagamba, okukkiriza omusawo kitundu kya kuwona; kale tukozesenga okusaasira kwe kuno n’amaanyi ge buli lunaku, mu ntalo zaffe eza buli lunaku. Mukama Yesu, wasuubiza obutazikiza lutambi olunyooka, n’obutamenya lumuli olubetentefu; kuuma ekisa kyo ggwe kennyini mu nze, tondekera nze nzekka, ekitiibwa kinaaba kikyo. Tuleme okukkiriza Setaani okutulaga Kristo mu ngeri endala okusinga bw’ali eri abo ababe. Kristo tajja kutuleka okutuusa ng’atufudde nga ye, ab’ekitiibwa munda ne kungulu, era ng’atututte mu maaso ga Kitaawe nga tetuliiko kamogo. Nga lino ssanyu ddene mu lutalo lwaffe n’emitima gyaffe egitawulira, okumanya nti tekiriba bwe kityo bulijjo? tulwanenga akaseera katono, era tuliba basanyufu emirembe gyonna. Bwe tunakuwazibwa ebibi byaffe, tulowoozenga nti Kristo kino Kitaawe yakimukwasa, nti talizikiza lutambi olunyooka okutuusa lw’aliwangula byonna. Kino kituteeka engabo mu mikono okugoba obusaale bwonna obw’omuliro bwa Setaani (Abaefeso 6:16): alitulumiriza nti, Oli mwonoonyi munene; ffe tusobola okuddamu nti, Kristo Mulokozi wa maanyi: naye alitulumiriza nti, Tolina kukkiriza, tolina kwagala; weewaawo, waliwo akasasi k’okukkiriza n’okwagala: naye Kristo tajja kukafaako; weewaawo, talizikiza lutambi olunyooka: naye kano katono nnyo era kanafu, kalivaawo ne kafuuka bwereere: nedda, Kristo alikakuuma, okutuusa lw’alireeta obwenkanya ne buwangula. Era ku lw’okubudaabudibwa kwaffe, kino tukirina dda: nti ne mu kusooka kwe twakkiriza, twawangula Katonda yennyini, nga bwe kyandigambiddwa, bwe twakkiriza okusonyiyibwa kw’ebibi byaffe byonna; newakubadde omusango ogwali mu mitima gyaffe, n’obwenkanya bwe obutaliiko kkomo. Kale bwe twawangula ne Katonda, kiki ekiriyimirira okutulwanyisa, singa tuyiga okukozesa okukkiriza kwaffe ?

Nga kino kiswaza nnyo Setaani: okufuba okufuuwa akasasi akanafu kazikire, naye n’atasobola kukazikiza; nti akaweke ka kaladaali kaba n’amaanyi okusinga emiryango gy’emagombe; nti kasobola okusiguukulula ensozi ez’okuziyiza n’ebikemo, Setaani n’emitima gyaffe egijeemu bye bateeka wakati wa Katonda naffe. Abimereki teyagumiikiriza kyogerwe nti yattibwa mukazi (Abalamuzi 9:54); era tekiyinza kulema kubonyaabonya Setaani, omwana omunafu, omukazi, n’omukadde akootakoota okumugoba olw’omwoyo ogw’okukkiriza.

Kale okuva bwe wabaawo okubudaabudibwa okwenkana awo awali amazima amatono ag’ekisa, nti kuliwangula bwe kutyo, tukeberenga emirundi mingi Katonda ky’akoze mu ffe, tunoonyenga ebirungi byaffe era n’ebibi byaffe, era twebazenga Katonda olw’ekisa ekitono ennyo okusinga olw’ekintu kyonna eky’ebweru ; kiriba kya mugaso era kya kubudaabuda okusinga ensi eno yonna, eyita era efuuka bwereere. Weewaawo, twebazenga olw’obuwanguzi obwo obwasuubizibwa era obukakafu, bwe tusobola okwesiga awatali kwekulumbaza, nga Omutume Pawulo bw’akola; Katonda yeebazibwe atuwanguza ffe ku bwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo (1 Abakkolinso 15:57). Laba ennimi z’omuliro mu kasasi, omuti mu nsigo; laba ebintu ebinene mu ntandikwa entono ; totunuulira nnyo ntandikwa, wabula okutuukirira, bwe tutyo tunaabanga n’essanyu mu ffe ffennyini mu kigero ekimu, era nga twebaza Kristo. Era tetusaanye kulowooza nti olw’okuba tetulina kisa kingi, tetulina n’akatono mu ffe; kubanga okukkiriza n’ekisa tebiyimiridde ku kifo kimu ekitayawulwamu, nti atalina kigero gundi talina n’akatono: naye nga bwe wabaawo ebanga eddene wakati w’akasasi n’ennimi z’omuliro, bwe kityo wabaawo obugazi bunene wakati w’ekigero ky’ekisa ekitono ennyo n’ekisinga obunene : era alina ekigero ekitono ennyo ali munda mu kisa kya Katonda ekitaggwaawo; ne bw’aba nga si ttaala eyaka, wabula lutambi olunyooka, Kristo olw’okufaayo kwe okw’ekisa tagenda kukkiriza kuluzikiza. Era bino byonna bye twogedde bisikirize abo abatannaba mu mbeera ya kisa, bajje wansi w’obufuzi bwa Kristo obulungi era obuwanguzi, kubanga newakubadde tulisanga okuziyizibwa kungi, naye bwe tulwana, alituyamba; bwe tunaagwa, alitukuuma ; bwe tunaakulemberwa ye, tuliwangula ; bwe tuliwangula, tukakafu okutikkirwa engule. Era ku mbeera y’Ekkanisa ey’omu kiseera kino, tulaba nga bw’eri mu buyinike, naye tubudaabudibwe nti ensonga ya Kristo eriwangula ; Kristo alifuga okutuusa ng’amaze okussa abalabe be wansi w’ebigere bye (Zabbuli 110:1), si kubalinnyirira kyokka, wabula okumuyamba okulinnya waggulu ennyo mu kitiibwa. Babulooni aligwa, kubanga Mukama Katonda amusalidde omusango, era wa maanyi (Okubikkulirwa 18:8). Obwenkanya bwa Kristo, si mu baana be bokka, wabula ne ku balabe be, buliwangula, kubanga ye Kabaka wa Bakabaka era Mukama wa bakama (Okubikkulirwa 19:16). Katonda tajja kukkiriza bulijjo Omulabe wa Kristo n’abamuwagira okwekulumbaza n’okutabangula mu Kkanisa nga bwe bakola.

Bwe tutunuulira embeera y’Ekkanisa ya Kristo ey’omu kiseera kino, eri nga Danyeri wakati mu mpologoma, ng’eddanga mu maggwa, ng’eryato eritakoma ku kusuukundibwa kyokka, wabula erinaatera okubikkibwa amayengo. Eri wansi nnyo, abalabe ne balowooza nti baziise Kristo mu ntaana ku bikwata ku Njiri ye, era nti eyo gye banaamuziyiza okuzuukira, naye Kristo, nga bwe yazuukira mu mubiri gwe, bw’atyo aliyiringisa amayinja gonna, n’azuukira nate mu Kkanisa ye : Ekkanisa n’ensonga ya Kristo birina obuwagizi butono kyenkana ki leero? okwekobaana okubiwakanya kwa maanyi kyenkana ki? omwoyo gw’Omulabe wa Kristo kaakano gwegulumizza, era gukumba n’obukambwe ; ebintu birabika ng’ebiwanirirwa akaguwa akatono akatalabika. Naye okubudaabudibwa kwaffe kwe kuno, nti Kristo mulamu era afuga, era ayimiridde ku lusozi Sayuuni ng’alwanirira abo abamuyimirirako (Okubikkulirwa 14:1); era amatwale n’obwakabaka bwe birikoonagana, Kristo alifaayo ku baana be n’ensonga ye, okuva bwe kiri nti tewali kirala mu nsi ky’assaako nnyo omwoyo. Mu kiseera kino kyennyini okununulibwa kw’Ekkanisa ye n’okuzikirira kw’abalabe be kukolebwako: tetulaba bintu nga bitambula okutuusa Kristo ng’amaze omulimu gwe, olwo tulyoke tulabe nti Mukama afuga.

Kristo n’Ekkanisa ye bwe baba wansi ddala, baba kumpi okusituka: abalabe be bwe baba waggulu ddala, baba kumpi okugwa.

Abayudaaya tebannayingira wansi w’ebbendera ya Kristo, naye Katonda, eyasendasenda Yafeesi okujja mu weema za Seemu, alisendasenda Seemu okujja mu weema za Yafeesi (Olubereberye 9:27). Obujjuvu bw’Abaamawanga tebunnayingira (Abaruumi 11:25), naye Kristo, eyaweebwa ensi yonna gy’ekoma okuba amatwale ge (Zabbuli 2:8), alikuŋŋaanya endiga zonna Kitaawe ze yamuwa mu kisibo kimu, wabeewo ekisibo kimu n’omusumba omu (Yokaana 10:16).

Abayudaaya abeesigwa baasanyuka okulowooza ku kuyitibwa kw’Abaamawanga: kale lwaki ffe tetwandisanyuse okulowooza ku kuyitibwa kw’Abayudaaya?

Olugendo lw’Enjiri okutuusa kaakano lubadde ng’olw’enjuba, okuva ebuvanjuba okudda ebugwanjuba, era bwe kityo, mu kiseera kya Katonda, luyinza okweyongera ebugwanjuba okusingawo. Tewali kitonde kiyinza kuziyiza lugendo lwa njuba, newakubadde okuziyiza amaanyi g’eggulu, newakubadde okuziyiza empewo okukunta, n’okusingawo tekiyinza kuziyiza maanyi agawangula ag’amazima aga Katonda, okutuusa Kristo lw’aliba ng’amaze okugatta byonna wansi w’omutwe gumu, olwo alibikwasa byonna Kitaawe ; bano be wampa ; bano be bannonze okuba Mukama waabwe era Kabaka waabwe, abaabonaabona nange ; njagala babeere we ndi, bafugire wamu nange. Era olwo Kristo n’akwasa Katonda Kitaawe obwakabaka; Kristo ng’amaze okuzikiriza obufuzi bwonna, n’obuyinza bwonna era n’amaanyi gonna (1 Abakkolinso 15:24).

Kale tuleete emitima gyaffe mu kumalirira okutukuvu, twewaayo ku birungi era tulwanyise ebibi, mu ffe oba mu balala, okusinziira ku kuyitibwa kwaffe, nga tuzziddwamu amaanyi olw’ekyo, nti ekisa kya Kristo n’amaanyi ge biritambula naffe. Kiki ekyandibadde ku mulimu ogwo omunene ogw’okuzzaawo eddiini mu nnaku ez’enkuba ey’oluvannyuma ey’Enjiri, singa abantu tebaali bambadde buvumu obutawangulika okuyitawo ku buli kiziyiza, nga beesigama ku kukkiriza kuno, nti ensonga yali ya Kristo, era nti tajja kwerabira nsonga ye. Luther yakkiriza mu bwesimbu nti emirundi mingi yakolanga ebintu awatali kulowooza, ng’atabudde n’obusungu; naye bwe yakikkiriza, Katonda teyamukwata ku nsobi ze, wabula ensonga bwe yali ya Katonda, n’ebigendererwa bye nga bitukuvu, okutumbula amazima, era nga musajja wa maanyi mu kusaba, era wa maanyi mu kukkiriza, Katonda yamuyitamu n’akoleeza omuliro ogwo ensi yonna gw’etalisobola kuzikiza. Nga okukkiriza kwaffe bwe kuli, bwe kutyo bwe tuzzibwamu amaanyi okutuukiriza buli buvunaanyizibwa; n’olwekyo tunyweze okukkiriza, kulyoke kunyweze ebirabo ebirala byonna eby’ekisa. Okukakasa kuno kwennyini, nti okukkiriza kuliwangula, kye kimu ku bikuleetera okuwangula ddala. Kale kikkirize nti newakubadde emirundi mingi kuba ng’olutambi olunyooka, naye kuliwangula. Bwe kuwangula ne Katonda yennyini mu bigezo, tekuliwangula buli kuziyiza kulala? Tulindeko akaseera katono, era tujja kulaba obulokozi Mukama bw’anaatuleetera (Okuva 14:13), Mukama yeeyolekenga gye tuli nnyo era nnyo mu maaso g’Omwana we Yesu Kristo, era agulumize amaanyi g’ekisa kye mu kukuuma entandikwa ezo ez’ekisa wakati mu bwonoonefu bwaffe, era atukuze okulowooza ku bunafu bwaffe kutuleetere okwetoowaza, n’okulowooza ku kusaasira kwe okw’ekisa kutuzzeemu amaanyi : era atukakase nti okuva bwe yatuyingiza mu ndagaano ey’ekisa, tajja kutusuula olw’obwonoonefu obwo ; obwo bwe bunakuwaza Omwoyo we, era bwe butufuula ab’ekivve mu maaso gaffe ffennyini. Era kubanga Setaani afuba okubikka ekitiibwa ky’okusaasira kwe, n’okuziyiza okubudaabudibwa kwaffe ng’atuggyamu amaanyi, Mukama ayongere kino ku kusaasira kwe okulala, tulyoke tukozese bulungi ekisa kino, era tuleme okufiirwa ekitundu kyonna eky’okubudaabudibwa ekyatuterekerwa mu Kristo. Era asiime okukkiriza amaanyi agawangula ag’Omwoyo we mu ffe okuba obujulizi bw’amazima g’ekisa ekyatandika, n’omusingo gw’obuwanguzi obw’enkomerero, mu kiseera ekyo bw’aliba byonna mu byonna, mu bonna ababe, emirembe n’emirembe. Amiina.
